lines.text: Morty: Hi, it’s you!\rHow about taking a picture\nhere with me as a memento? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0059_D17R1101_00007

lines.label: msg_0060_D18R0101_00000
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: ........................Oh, it’s you.You must be here to catch the
legendary Pokémon to make yourself look strong.That is only a dream.You see, the legendary Pokémon suits a
Trainer like me who has sworn to become the strongest Trainer.A battle with Team Rocket Grunts
is just right for you!

lines.label: msg_0060_D18R0101_00001
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: ...Aw, whatever.\rYou would never be able to catch a\nlegendary Pokémon anyway.\r

lines.label: msg_0060_D18R0101_00002
lines.text:
Eusine: My name is Eusine.I’m on the trail of a Pokémon named
SUICUNE.And you are...?
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}? Glad to meet you.I heard rumors that SUICUNE is here,
so I came to look.Take a look at the basement through
the hole in the floor.There. SUICUNE is down there.I could go downstairs, but I know it
would run away in no time.I know.
I have tried it many times...

lines.label: msg_0060_D18R0101_00003
lines.text: Eusine: There seems to be more than\nmeets the eye with you...

lines.label: msg_0060_D18R0101_00004
lines.text:
Morty: My name is Morty.
I am Ecruteak’s Gym Leader.Because my old friend Eusine is here
on the trail of SUICUNE, I decided to investigate the Burned Tower.Ecruteak has a legend about these
legendary Pokémon: SUICUNE, ENTEI, and RAIKOU.As the Gym Leader of Ecruteak, I must
have a proper understanding of it.

lines.label: msg_0061_D18R0102_00000
lines.text: Eusine: Did you see it?\rSUICUNE raced by like a blur, right in\nfront of my eyes!\rI have been chasing SUICUNE for almost\nten years, but I have never been this\fclose! I’m all choked up!\r

lines.label: msg_0061_D18R0102_00001
lines.text:
By the way...
It was clear to me that SUICUNE took notice of your presence.Ecruteak’s legendary Pokémon are said
to come to people only when they recognize their talents.Perhaps I should be more aggressive
toward SUICUNE...Anyway, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, we will
meet again!

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00000
lines.text: Only one Pokémon can Stroll with you\nin a Pokéwalker...\rI can’t decide which one!

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00001
lines.text: I may not look like it, but I have\nmany Pokéwalkers on me!\fThey make loud noises as I walk.\rMaybe taking a Stroll isn’t as easy as\nI thought...

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00002
lines.text: Pay attention, please!\r...Oops, I have to quit thinking like\na teacher all the time.\rYou must be a Pokémon Trainer.\rSince you’re working so hard,\nI want you to have this.\r

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00004
lines.text: Let a Pokémon hold that Quick Claw.\rSometimes it will strike first\nduring battle.

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00005
lines.text: It’s fun having a Pokémon out of its\nPoké Ball to walk with it,\fbut the Pokéwalker is a whole\fnew dimension.

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00006
lines.text: My mom can’t take my Pokémon and tells\nme not to play with it indoors.\fBut, hey!\rI can keep it in my Pokéwalker.\nThat way, I’m always with it!

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00007
lines.text: I take walks in the park, but I\nnever go into the grass.\rTrainers always want to battle...

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00008
lines.text: PERSIAN: Fufushaa!

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00009
lines.text: Huff, puff, huff...\rI am...out of...breath!\nI’ve been running to try\fand charge the Pokéwalker!

lines.text: William: I got the Pokémon I wanted,\nso I’m very happy.

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00057
lines.text: Benny: You know what?\nI caught a SCYTHER the other day,\fand I still didn’t win...

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00060
lines.text: Barry: You have a better chance to win\nwhen your Pokémon is at a high level.\fBut it seems that there is more\fto winning.

lines.label: msg_0062_D22R0101_00072
lines.text: Kipp: Studying hard on Bug-type\nPokémon doesn’t ensure you’ll win here.

I’m sure you can win!By the way, will you take a

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00000
lines.text: Welcome to Goldenrod’s Radio Tower!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00001
lines.text: Welcome to Goldenrod’s Radio Tower!\r...Or, maybe not.\nI am sorry to tell you this, but no one\fcan visit the tower now.

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00002
lines.text: Um, yes. I have been telling visitors\nto go home as you instructed...

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00003
lines.text: We have a special Quiz campaign!\rAnswer five questions correctly in a\nrow to win a Radio Card!\rWhen you load it into the Pokégear, you\nwill be able to listen to the radio...\fanytime, anywhere!\rWould you like to try our Quiz? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00004
lines.text: The first question!\rCan you check the Town Map with\nyour Pokégear? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00005
lines.text: You are correct.\nThe second question!\rNIDORINA can only be female.\nTrue? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00006
lines.text: You are correct.\nThe third question!\rKurt, the Poké Ball creator, uses\napricots as ingredients? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00007
lines.text: You are correct again.\nThe fourth question!\rIt’s impossible to use a TM on\nMAGIKARP. True? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00008
lines.text: Wow!\nI have only one more question to go.\rIn Professor Oak’s popular show,\nPokémon Talk, is he on with Marie? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00009
lines.text: Bingo! You got it!\nCongratulations!\fHere’s your prize, a Radio Card!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00010
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} can now listen to the\nradio with the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00011
lines.text: Please tune in to our radio shows!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00012
lines.text: Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\fPlease try again!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00013
lines.text: Oh. I see.\nPlease see me if you change your mind.

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00014
lines.text: Whitney: Hi!\nMy name is Whitney!\rI heard about the Quiz to win a Radio\nCard, so I came here to get one...\rBut this Quiz is so hard!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00015
lines.text: Whitney: Wow, you did it!\nI thought the answer to the third\fquestion was surely apricots!\rOops!\nIt’s time to go back to the Gym!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00016
lines.text: Ben is a fabulous DJ!\nHis sweet voice just makes me melt!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00017
lines.text: I love Mary from Pokémon Talk.\rI only know what she sounds like,\nthough!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00018
lines.text:
Who are you?
We have some business going on.I was told not to let anyone pass but
Team Rocket!Do you understand?You are only allowed to come through
when you are wearing the cool black uniform for Team Rocket!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00019
lines.text: Ha! You must be new!\nYou look pretty good in the Team Rocket\funiform!\rGo on ahead!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00020
lines.text: What are you doing?\nGo upstairs and take your position!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00021
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: Hey, Team Rocket!\rStop going around in groups and\ntroubling people. You cowards!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00022
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: ...Huh?
Are you {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}? What are you doing here?No way... You think you’re strong now
that you look like them?That’s foolish!
You shouldn’t wear those things!

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00023
lines.text: What? You!\nYou’re not a newcomer?\fThen battle with me!\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00024
lines.text: You are too powerful.\rYou could spoil our plan.\nI have to inform the others...\r

lines.label: msg_0065_D23R0101_00025
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: I see.
You were trying to be sneaky...Huh!
A typical idea of the meek!No matter.
I’ll let you handle this.I have to defeat the Dragon Tamer...
What’s his name...? Lance!After that...it will be your turn.
Be ready for it!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00000
lines.text: We have recordings of the cries of many\nof the Pokémon that have been found.\rWe must have about 200 kinds.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00001
lines.text: To Trainers, Pokémon are their\nbeloved partners.\rIt’s terrible how Team Rocket is trying\nto control Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00002
lines.text: We run 24 hours a day to broadcast\nentertaining programs.\rI’ll do my best to run around the\nclock, too!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00003
lines.text: The Team Rocket boss has locked\nhimself in.\rBut the Director can open it.\rHe’s up on the fifth floor.\nPlease save him!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00004
lines.text: Is the Director safe?

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00005
lines.text: Thank you, kiddo! You’re the best!\nThis is a token of my appreciation.\r

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received TM11!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00007
lines.text: It’s Sunny Day.\nIt powers up Fire-type moves for\fa while.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00008
lines.text: Oh, your Bag is full.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00009
lines.text: You were simply marvelous!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00010
lines.text: The door is locked...\nYou need a Card Key.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00011
lines.text: It’s the Card Key slot.\r

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00012
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} inserted the Card Key.\r

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00013
lines.text: You should be able to unlock the door\nwith the Card Key!

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00014
lines.text: It’s the Card Key slot.

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00015
lines.text: 3F Personnel

lines.label: msg_0067_D23R0103_00016
lines.text: Pokémon Music with host: DJ Ben

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00000
lines.text: I listened to the radio while I was at\nthe ruins.\rI heard a strange broadcast there.

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00001
lines.text: Mary: Why? Why do I have to suffer\nthrough this?\rMEOWTH, help me!

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00002
lines.text: Mary: Oh! You’re my little savior! Will\nyou take this as my thanks?\r

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00003
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received the Bright\nPowder from Mary!

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00004
lines.text: Mary: When a Pokémon holds it, it\nlowers the opponent’s accuracy.

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00005
lines.text: Nooo! Your Bag is full!

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00006
lines.text: Mary: Please tune in to me on\nProfessor Oak’s Pokémon Talk show.

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00007
lines.text: MEOWTH: Meowth...

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00008
lines.text: 4F Production

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00009
lines.text: 4F Studio 1

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00010
lines.text: Ben: Team Rocket... There is something\nthey lack. It is music!\rMusic enriches people’s heart and soul.\rMusic lovers would never do such\nhorrible things at a place like the\fRadio Tower!

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00011
lines.text: Ben: Do you listen to our music?

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00012
lines.text: Proton, the leader of this Radio Tower\nmission... He is so cool.\r

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00013
lines.text: Who are you?\rIf you are in the way of Proton...\nI mean Team Rocket. I won’t allow that!\r

lines.label: msg_0068_D23R0104_00014
lines.text: Team Rocket and Proton are all I need!\rWho cares about Pokémon?

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00000
lines.text: Ahem, do you hear me?\r...I am the Director.\rWe have decided to broadcast wonderful\nshows to praise Team Rocket!\rEveryone, I don’t want to hear you\ncomplain. Just do a good job to...\r

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00001
lines.text: Yikes!\nI am busy impersonating the...\fWho are you?\r

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00002
lines.text: ...Oh no, it’s you again, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?\r

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00003
lines.text: Petrel: No, no, no! I was pretending to\nbe the Director to influence the entire\fregion to support Team Rocket!\rThis time I won’t hold back!\nGive me all you’ve got!\r

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00004
lines.text:
Petrel: Listen carefully.We stashed the real Director in the
underground warehouse.It’s at the far end of the
Goldenrod Tunnel.I am a nice guy. I will give you the
Basement Key to get to the underground warehouse. Take it with gratitude!

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00005
lines.text:
Petrel: We stashed the Director in the
underground warehouse.It’s at the far end of the
Goldenrod Tunnel.Hahaha...
I doubt a child like you’ll get that far.

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00006
lines.text:
Director: Hello, it is you! You know,
I really love Pokémon.I built this Radio Tower just so I could
express my love of Pokémon.It would be nice if people enjoyed our
programs.

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00007
lines.text: 5F Director’s Office

lines.label: msg_0069_D23R0105_00008
lines.text: Go up for Observation Deck

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00000
lines.text:
Archer: Oh? You managed to get
this far...? You must be quite the Trainer.We intend to take over this
Radio Tower and officially announce our comeback.That should bring our boss Giovanni
back from his solitary training.We are going to regain our
former glory...I will not allow you to interfere with
our meticulous plans!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00001
lines.text: Archer: How could this be...?\rOur dreams have come to naught.\nI was not up to the task after all.\rLike Giovanni has done before me, I will\ndisband Team Rocket here today.\rFarewell...\r

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00002
lines.text:
Director: Oh...!You have already defeated them?
Thank you!Your courageous actions have saved
Pokémon nationwide.You are well worth this.
Please take it!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00003
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Rainbow Wing!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Silver Wing!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00005
lines.text:
There used to be a tower right here.When the tower was replaced with the
Radio Tower, that Rainbow Wing was found at the top of the tower.I heard from a friend from Cianwood City
that you can climb the Bell Tower in  Ecruteak City when you have a Rainbow Wing.I have to get back to my office.
See you!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00006
lines.text:
There used to be a tower right here.When the tower was replaced with the
Radio Tower, that Silver Wing was found at the top of the tower.I heard from a friend from Cianwood City
that you can go down the cave at Whirl Islands when you have a Silver Wing.I have to get back to my office.
See you!

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00007
lines.text: Oh, I almost forgot!\rAccording to my friend from Cianwood\nCity, the legendary Pokémon will not\fappear if you just go up to the top of\fthe Bell Tower with only that\fRainbow Wing.\rApparently there is something else\nyou need... Or something like that.\rI wonder what it was...\rI can’t remember.\r

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00008
lines.text: Oh, I almost forgot!\rAccording to my friend from Cianwood\nCity, the legendary Pokémon will not\fappear if you just go down the cave at\fWhirl Islands with only that\fSilver Wing.\rApparently there is something else\nyou need... Or something like that.\rI wonder what it was...\rI can’t remember.\r

lines.label: msg_0070_D23R0106_00009
lines.text: Are you expecting something?\nThis is what they call Fake Out.\rI really must go back to my office this\ntime. See ya!\r

lines.label: msg_0071_D23R0107_00000
lines.text: Goldenrod City\nRadio Tower Elevator\fNext stop: Observation Deck\r

lines.label: msg_0071_D23R0107_00001
lines.text: Goldenrod City\nRadio Tower Elevator\fNext stop: 5F\r

lines.label: msg_0071_D23R0107_00002
lines.text: You’ve arrived at the Observation Deck.

lines.label: msg_0071_D23R0107_00003
lines.text: You have arrived at 5F.

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00000
lines.text:
Hm? That’s a Pokédex, isn’t it?
May I see it?There are so many kinds of Pokémon.
Hm? What’s this?What is this Pokémon?
It looks like the strange writing on the walls of the ruins.If those drawings are really Pokémon,
there should be many more.I know! Let me upgrade your Pokédex.
Follow me.

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00001
lines.text: Ouch!\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00002
lines.text: Are you OK?\nI was in a hurry and...\fSorry, did I hurt you?\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00003
lines.text: No way!\nCould it be a Pokémon from Sinnoh...\fThe one they call ARCEUS...?\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00004
lines.text: Oh, could it be...?\nARCEUS causing all this...?\rI cannot explain it any other way...\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00005
lines.text: ARCEUS may be the key to solving the\nmystery of the UNOWN and the\fRuins of Alph...?\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00006
lines.text: Can you come to the Ruins of Alph with\nme? Please! You must!\rI am trembling with excitement.\nI think something is about to happen!\r

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00007
lines.text: Ruins of Alph.\rVisitors who are interested in\narchaeology are welcome.

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00008
lines.text: Ruins of Alph.\rFeel free to explore the ruins and\nbecome a fossil professor!

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00009
lines.text: Ruins Research Center

lines.label: msg_0072_D24R0101_00010
lines.text: This is a mysterious hall.\nPlease watch your step.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00000
lines.text: Bravo!\rA promising youth who is about to start\nthe journey of archaeology has\fjust arrived!\r

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00001
lines.text: What? Just a visitor?\nOh, I see...\fYou got me excited for nothing.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00002
lines.text: My staff here at the Ruins Research\nCenter is excellent, and the research\fmakes good progress with absolutely\fno effort on my part.\rIf you have any questions, feel free to\ntalk to my staff!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00003
lines.text: I managed to unravel quite a lot of the\nmystery of UNOWN with your help!\rThank you, thank you.\nThank you, again!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00004
lines.text: The ruins are about 1,500 years old.\nThat’s all we know about them.\rBut it’s not known why they were\nbuilt...or by whom.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00005
lines.text: Wow, did you catch an UNOWN?\nThat’s wonderful!\rCome to think of it... How come we’ve\nsuddenly started to see UNOWN?

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00006
lines.text:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!It was you who solved the stone-panel
puzzle that allowed UNOWN to appear.Those tablets are the key to waking
up UNOWN!Still... Why would anyone make such
a key?

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00007
lines.text:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!If you turn on the radio in the ruins,
you can receive mysterious radio waves!It’s proof that UNOWN communicate
with each other using radio waves!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00008
lines.text:
You have to hear this!
This is a big discovery!There are as many UNOWN as there are
letters in the alphabet!There have been 26 types confirmed.
Why don’t you collect them all?

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00009
lines.text: How do you like the UNOWN Report\nI gave you?\rUNOWN are recorded as you catch them.\nIt is quite useful!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00010
lines.text: You have to hear this!\nThis is a big discovery!\rWe have figured out that UNOWN are in a\ncertain order!\fLet me see your report.\r

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00011
lines.text: There!\nI put the UNOWN in the correct order!\fWe may be able to tell more about them.\r

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00012
lines.text: What?\nYou found a room with UNOWN symbols?\fThat is a big discovery!\rWe will study them right away.\r

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00013
lines.text: You have to hear this!\nThis is a big discovery!\rWe have found two new UNOWN symbols!\rIt means that...\nThere must be two more kinds of UNOWN\fsomewhere...\r

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00014
lines.text:
You have to hear this!
We are learning more and more about the symbols on the floor!...It seems that UNOWN were living at
the ruins with a human clan.It is thought that this clan made the
Pokémon statues underground.The UNOWN were easily scared and
wouldn’t go outside.When more and more people started to
appear around the ruins, the clan that wished to live in harmony with the UNOWN eventually left...Thanks to our research and your
help, we have unraveled so much about their mystery!We have so many things we don’t know
left, of course.Archaeology never ends.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00015
lines.text: I will let you know if I find out\nanything else.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00016
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} opened the UNOWN Report\nand made notes!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00017
lines.text: Thanks to our research and your\nhelp, we have unraveled so much about\ftheir mystery!\rWe have so many things we don’t know\nleft, of course.\rArchaeology never ends.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00018
lines.text: There are odd patterns drawn on the\nwalls of the ruins.\rThey must be the keys for unraveling\nthe mystery of the ruins.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00019
lines.text:
The strange Pokémon you saw in
the ruins?They appear to be very much like the
drawings on the walls there.Hmm...That must mean there are many
different kinds of them...

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00020
lines.text: Huh?\nI seem to be doing nothing?\rCome on!\nI may not look it, but I’m the one who\fdeveloped the UNOWN Report!

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00021
lines.text: Ruins of Alph\nExploration Year 10

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00022
lines.text: Mystery Pokémon\nName: UNOWN\fA total of 26 kinds found.

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00023
lines.text: Ruins of Alph Research Report\rI dedicate this report to the\nResearch Center’s founder,\fProfessor Silktree...

lines.label: msg_0073_D24R0102_00024
lines.text: There are many academic books.\r“Mysteries of the Ancients”\n“Code-Breaking Guidebook”\f“Weathering Ruins”

lines.label: msg_0074_D24R0202_00000
lines.text:
Welcome to this chamber!We are reconstructing ancient Pokémon
stone panels.You can rotate stone-panel pieces by
touching them for a short time.If you touch a piece and slide it,
you can move it around.We think we should be able to put them
back to where they were...

lines.label: msg_0074_D24R0202_00001
lines.text: You reconstructed the stone panel?\rThat’s great!\nWe have an archaeology genius here!

lines.label: msg_0074_D24R0202_00003
lines.text: Nothing happened...

lines.label: msg_0075_D24R0204_00001
lines.text: Nothing happened...

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00000
lines.text:
Did you just come down from above...?So! You must have solved the
stone-panel puzzle!That is wonderful!You seem to have some talent with
archaeology. I will give you this UNOWN Report.It records UNOWN as you capture them.
I am sure it’ll come in handy!

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00001
lines.text: There is a strange presence here...

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00002
lines.text: This is a big room, but there’s\nnothing here.

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00003
lines.text: This place has a mystical quality to it.\r...Or a historic quality...\f...Or an eerie quality...\f...Or an ancient quality...\f...Or a solemn quality...\f...Or a frosty quality...\fIn essence, it feels sort of ethereal.

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00004
lines.text: The ruins have not been robbed, nor\ntampered with. No graffiti, either.\rThings are well preserved.\nSomething here must make people\ffeel they should preserve it.

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00005
lines.text: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00006
lines.text: Hmm.\rI have been studying the ruins for many\nyears, but something feels...\fdifferent.\r

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00007
lines.text: Wow!\rThe UNOWN pictures on the wall...\rIt feels like they’re staring at me!\r

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00008
lines.text: What is this?\nThere is something eerie that is making\fmy legs shiver.\fI can’t stop them!\r

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00009
lines.text: Oh, are you all right?\nYou disappeared right in front of me.\fI was so surprised!\r

lines.label: msg_0076_D24R0205_00010
lines.text: I see.\rThe power of ARCEUS and UNOWN affected\neach other to create a huge energy,\fwhich sent you to the Sinjoh Ruins...?\rUNOWN, the Ruins of Alph, and ARCEUS...\fThe mystery deepens...\rIt has made me even more inquisitive!\rI will one day solve all the mysteries!\r

lines.label: msg_0077_D24R0206_00001
lines.text: Nothing happened...

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00000
lines.text: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00001
lines.text: Hmmm.\nWhen did this appear...?\rI wonder what these symbols mean...\f..................\r

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00002
lines.text: Hey, you!\nLet’s go back to the Research Center!\r

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00003
lines.text: The symbols on the stone panel were\nlike this...\r

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00004
lines.text: OUR FRIENDS LOOK\nUP AND HEARTILY\fCONGRATULATE US\r

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00005
lines.text: I wonder what it means.\nWe need to examine the ruins once again.\r

lines.label: msg_0079_D24R0211_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} opened the UNOWN Report\nand made notes!

lines.label: msg_0090_D26R0101_00000
lines.text:
Kurt: Hey there, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!The guard up top took off when
I shouted at him.But then I took a tumble down the well.I slammed down hard on my back,
so I can’t move.Rats! If I were fit, my Pokémon
would’ve punished them...Ah, it can’t be helped.{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, show them how gutsy
you are in my place!

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00000
lines.text: Kurt: Way to go, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rTeam Rocket has taken off.\rMy back’s better, too.\nLet’s get out of here.\r

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00001
lines.text: Proton: What do we have here?\rI am often labeled as the scariest and\ncruelest guy in Team Rocket...\rI strongly urge you not to interfere\nwith our business!\r

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00002
lines.text:
Proton: Humph...
Team Rocket was indeed broken up three years ago. But we continued our activities underground.A small obstacle like you won’t
be much of a problem for our mission.I advise you to be very afraid of what
is to come!

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00003
lines.text: A SLOWPOKE with its tail cut off...\rHuh? It has Mail. Read it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} read the Mail.\rBe good and look after the house\nwith Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.\f           Love, Dad

lines.label: msg_0091_D26R0102_00005
lines.text: A SLOWPOKE with its tail cut off...

lines.label: msg_0092_D26R0103_00000
lines.text: I’m waiting to see SLOWPOKE’s moment\nof evolution. Through observation,\fI made a new discovery.\rA SLOWPOKE with a King’s Rock often\ngets bitten by a SHELLDER.\rHere, I’ll share a King’s Rock with you.

lines.label: msg_0092_D26R0103_00002
lines.text: I’m going to be like SLOWPOKE.\rI’ll wait patiently so I can see\none evolve.

lines.label: msg_0093_D27R0101_00000
lines.text: People train at this Lighthouse.\rIt’s not easy to climb because of\nall the Trainers.

lines.label: msg_0093_D27R0101_00001
lines.text: In the past, Pokémon used to light\nthe sea around Olivine at night.\rThe Lighthouse was made to pay tribute\nto those Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0094_D27R0107_00000
lines.text:
Jasmine: ...This Pokémon always kept
the sea lit at night....But it suddenly got sick...

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Tower!\rI am your guide to the Single\nand Double Battle Rooms.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00001
lines.text: Would you like to take the\nBattle Room challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00002
lines.text: We hope to see you again!

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00003
lines.text:
The Battle Tower is a facility for Single
or Double Battle challenges.Once entered, your challenge lasts
until you lose.In Single Battle format, you enter with
three Pokémon.In Double Battle format, you enter with
four Pokémon.The battles are held in Battle Rooms,
of which there are many in the tower.In each of the Battle Rooms, seven
Trainers await your challenge.If you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00004
lines.text: Which Battle Room would you like?\nSingle or Double? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00008
lines.text: Please select the Pokémon you wish\nto enter.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00009
lines.text: Your Pokémon must all be different.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00010
lines.text: Held items must all be different.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00011
lines.text: I will now show you to the Battle Room.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00012
lines.text: Congratulations!\nYou’ve beaten all seven Trainers!\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00013
lines.text:
Congratulations!
You’ve beaten the Tower Tycoon!We present you with these Battle
Points in recognition of your talent!{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received
{STRVAR_1 50, 1, 0} BP!

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00014
lines.text: Saving...\nDon’t turn off the power.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00015
lines.text: We hope to see you again.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00016
lines.text: We’ve been waiting for you!\rBefore entering a Battle Room, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00019
lines.text: Excuse me!\rYou didn’t save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\rBecause of that, you have been\ndisqualified from your challenge!\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00020
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Tower!\rI am your guide to the Multi\nBattle Rooms.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00021
lines.text: Would you like to take the Multi\nBattle Room challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00023
lines.text:
The Battle Tower’s Multi Battle Rooms
are for Multi Battles with a partner.To enter, join another Trainer and
compete with two Pokémon each.Inside the tower is a room named the
Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers.There, you can find a Trainer to act
as your partner in the Multi Battles.You can also partner up with a friend
over wireless communications.Once you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a Multi Battle Room.In the Multi Battle Room, seven
tag teams await your challenge.If you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Also, if you are on a tag team with
a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00026
lines.text: Would you like to communicate with\na friend and form a tag team? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00027
lines.text: One Trainer should select\n“BECOME LEADER.”\rThe other Trainer must select\n“JOIN GROUP.” {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00032
lines.text: I’ll direct you to your Multi Battle\nRoom now.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00033
lines.text: Both Trainers have chosen the\nPokémon {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0}.\rPlease confer with the other Trainer\nand choose different Pokémon.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00034
lines.text: Both Trainers have chosen the Pokémon\n{STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0} and {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0}.\rPlease confer with the other Trainer\nand choose different Pokémon.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00035
lines.text: I will now show you to the Battle Salon.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00036
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Tower!\rI am your guide to the Wi-Fi Battle\nRooms.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00037
lines.text: Would you like to take the Wi-Fi\nBattle Room challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00038
lines.text:
The Battle Tower’s Wi-Fi Battle Rooms
are places to conduct battles over Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.As a result, you will be battling
Trainers from around the world.Inside the Battle Tower, there are
many Battle Rooms.In each of the Battle Rooms, seven
Trainers await your challenge.If you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.Depending on how you do, you may
even become the room’s leader!Also, the Wi-Fi Battle Rooms are
operated on a ranking system.Trainers will go up in rank if they
keep winning Wi-Fi Battles.Contrarily, their rankings could go
down if they lose consistently.To raise your rank, keep winning,
especially against tougher Trainers.If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.

{STRVAR_1 0, 7, 0}, {STRVAR_1 0, 8, 0},{STRVAR_1 0, 9, 0}, {STRVAR_1 0, 10, 0},

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00110
lines.text: Thank you so much for participating!\nPlease come again!

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00111

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00113
lines.text: We look forward to your next visit.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00114
lines.text:
You can call me the Judge.Heheh, it’s actually not my real name,
but that’s what everyone calls me.It’s because of this weird power I
have. It’s a gift, really.I can discern--judge you can say--the
overall potential of individual Pokémon.If you’d like, I could judge the
intriguing potential of your Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00115
lines.text: If you’d like, I could judge the\nintriguing potential of your Pokémon.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00116
lines.text: ...Oh.\nYou don’t need me to judge. I get it.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00117
lines.text: Judge an Egg?!\nThat’s a tall order even for me.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00118
lines.text: I see, I see...\rThis Pokémon’s potential is decent all\naround.\rThat’s my determination, and it’s final.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00119
lines.text: I see, I see...\rThis Pokémon’s potential is above\naverage overall.\rThat’s my determination, and it’s final.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00120
lines.text: I see, I see...\rThis Pokémon has relatively superior\npotential overall.\rThat’s my determination, and it’s final.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00121
lines.text: I see, I see...\rThis Pokémon has outstanding potential\noverall.\rThat’s my determination, and it’s final.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00122
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its HP.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00123
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its Attack stat.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00124
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its Defense stat.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00125
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its Sp. Atk stat.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00126
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its Sp. Def stat.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00127
lines.text: Incidentally, I would say the best\npotential lies in its Speed stat.\r

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00128
lines.text: It’s rather decent in that regard.\nThat’s how I judged it.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00129
lines.text: It’s very good in that regard.\nThat’s how I judged it.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00130
lines.text: It’s fantastic in that regard.\nThat’s how I judged it.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00131
lines.text: It can’t be better in that regard.\nThat’s how I judged it.

lines.label: msg_0096_D31R0201_00132
lines.text: A Ribbon will be awarded to the\nparticipating Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00000
lines.text: Please find a partner from the Trainers\nthat are gathered here.\r

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00003
lines.text: Riley: The partners I have now?\rWell, my {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0}’s nasty with its\n{STRVAR_1 6, 1, 0}.\rAnd there’s my {STRVAR_1 0, 2, 0}, which\nis a sure hand with {STRVAR_1 6, 3, 0}.\rWould you like to team up with me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00004
lines.text: Riley: ...Oh, is that so?\nThat’s too bad.

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00005
lines.text: Riley: Ahaha, thanks.\nI’ll be waiting for you.\r

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00006
lines.text: Cheryl: I have {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0} that\nis very good with {STRVAR_1 6, 1, 0}\rand {STRVAR_1 0, 2, 0} that likes to\nshow off its {STRVAR_1 6, 3, 0}.\rWill you team up with me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00007

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00008

Buck: Yo, are you looking to team
up? Let me tell you what I’ve got.My {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0}’s first-rate
with {STRVAR_1 6, 1, 0}.And my {STRVAR_1 0, 2, 0} is the best when

{STRVAR_1 6, 1, 0} well...And my {STRVAR_1 0, 2, 0} likes to use

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00016
lines.text: Mira: Oh, OK.\nLet’s go another time!

lines.label: msg_0099_D31R0207_00017
lines.text: Mira: OK! I’ll wait for you!\n{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, don’t be long!\r

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00000
lines.text: Battle Tower... It’s so tall!\nI wonder how many times my height it is?

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00001
lines.text: All the places in the Battle Frontier\nlet you team up with a friend!\fThat’s so cool, don’t you think?\fI wish I had a friend to team up with...

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00002
lines.text: I am the super Idol in Johto!\rI’ve come all the way to the\nBattle Frontier to promote my\flatest song!\rBut...\rEverybody seems to be a\nPoké Maniac here!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00003
lines.text: Fishing won’t keep me calm since I came\nto know about the Battle Frontier.\fWhen I go fishing, I find myself quitting\fearly and coming here.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00004
lines.text: The place I like best among the five\nfacilities here would be the\fBattle Castle, because you can see\fLady Caitlin there!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00005
lines.text: What makes me the most happy being\na Trainer?\rThe fact that Pokémon will always bring\nme lots of friends!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00006
lines.text: Just like people go through different\nthings they can learn from, Pokémon\flearn different things from battles.\rBehind every experience, there is a\nstory. Isn’t that right, dear?

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00007
lines.text: All experiences lead to a tale.\nI’m not wrong, am I, dear?

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00008
lines.text: I’ve come to the Battle Frontier to\nget a job!\rThanks to my previous job, I’m good\nat cooking, cleaning, and laundry!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00009
lines.text:
To be strong is to be weak.
To be weak is to be strong.Somebody told me that before.
I don’t quite understand it yet, but it sounds deep.I’ll just give myself some time
to figure it out.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00010
lines.text: Watching these people who care so much\nabout Pokémon makes me feel ashamed\fof my selfishness.\rI’ll try and face my Pokémon for real!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00011
lines.text: I wonder how many years it’s been since\nI first met a Pokémon? ...Forty-nine!\rOh, I lost the page that kept track of\nhow many years, days, and hours...\rCould it be my Pokémon nibbling on it?

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00012
lines.text:
Trainers care about Pokémon
as the battle progresses.In return, Pokémon repay that trust
by using moves the best they can.What you see in a battle is the trust
between people and Pokémon.This may seem obvious, but it’s actually
incredibly amazing!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00013
lines.text:
You cannot try anything if you are
afraid of losing battles.But!Getting into a battle knowing you have
no chance of winning will only make your Pokémon suffer.That’s not courage!
Truly good Trainers know the balance between courage and cautiousness.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00014
lines.text: If you want to graduate from being\na so-so Trainer, mark my words!\rThe Pokémon’s type!\rThe moves to be learned!\rThe items to be held!\rYou can’t overlook a single detail.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00015
lines.text:
When people win a battle, some laugh
at their opponent.Some brag about his or her strengths.Some even start to dance around 
claiming he or she is number one in the world.I respect people who win and then
care about their opponent.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00016
lines.text:
Have you heard of the Brains of the
Battle Frontier?There are five facilities in the
Battle Frontier.At every one, you can win your way
through to challenge the bosses called the Frontier Brains. They’re out-of-this-world tough!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00017
lines.text: Allowing us to enjoy battles,\nhelping us work,\ftaking us to places far away,\for just being good friends...\rPokémon are so deep.\nI wanna be like Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00018
lines.text: At the Battle Factory, you have to\nkeep winning with rental Pokémon.\rI may not stand a chance at other\nfacilities, but I may go all the\fway here!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00019
lines.text:
The Battle Hall is where Pokémon battle
one-on-one for as long as they can.Even my MAGIKARP has a shot at
number one!Wow!Just the thought of it makes
me excited!

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00020
lines.text: Life is full of ebbs and flows.\nI’ll keep my inflatable tube close.\rI could call it the wisdom I gained\nin the last five years of my life.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00021
lines.text: Welcome to the Exchange Service\nCorner!\rWould you like to trade in your BP\nfor some prizes? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00022
lines.text: Please come back any time you want!\n

lines.text: You put away the {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}\nin the {STRVAR_1 18, 1, 0} Pocket.\r

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00034
lines.text: Battle Tower\nNever Lose! Keep Winning!

lines.text: Battle Hall\nLet Each Pokémon Seek No. 1

lines.text: Battle Castle\nManage Battles with Castle Points

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00037
lines.text: Battle Arcade\nWhere Events Sway Outcomes

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00039
lines.text: A Trainer who just caught a Pokémon.\nThat’s what this statue represents.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00040
lines.text: “Boastful of Capture”...\nThat seems to be the title.

lines.label: msg_0100_D32_00041
lines.text: This...!\nA scale model of the Battle Frontier.

lines.label: msg_0101_D32FS0101_00000
lines.text: Some Trainers rely on a Pokémon’s\npotential alone. But you can use items\fand medicines to help improve a\fPokémon’s capabilities.

lines.label: msg_0101_D32FS0101_00001
lines.text: Mountain climbing and Pokémon are\nsimilar in a sense.\rThey both come down to potential!\rI do not rely on items or medicines\nbut rather potential and training\ffor battle!

lines.label: msg_0102_D32PC0101_00000
lines.text: The karate uniform is the uniform\nof fighters!\rThere is nothing better suited for\ngoing to the Battle Frontier than this!

lines.label: msg_0102_D32PC0101_00001
lines.text:
Some people are surprised to see a
small girl like me at the Battle Frontier all by herself.It’s not like I have to battle myself,
you know?

lines.label: msg_0102_D32PC0101_00002
lines.text: My lifelong hobby has been\nbattling using Pokémon.\rA battle after breakfast,\na battle after lunch,\fand after dinner...\fI just take a bath and go to bed.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rThis is your first visit?\nRight this way, please!\r

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00001
lines.text:
Oh! You have a Vs. Recorder!
How nice!We upgrade Vs. Recorders for first-time
visitors for Battle Frontier use.I’ll borrow yours for a moment.Let’s see... Slide open this part here,
and ticka-tacka-kachunk there!All done!
Here you go.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Vs. Recorder was\nupgraded.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00003
lines.text: Our other staff will be pleased to\nexplain how the individual facilities\fof the Battle Frontier operate.\rI can go over general topics.\nDo you have any questions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00004
lines.text: Which topic should I explain? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00005
lines.text:
The Battle Frontier has five facilities
dedicated to battling.At the Battle Tower, the objective is
to beat seven Trainers in a row.At the Battle Hall, you may keep battle
records of individual Pokémon.At the Battle Factory, you must win
consecutive battles with rentals.The Battle Castle forces Trainers to
manage Castle Points to advance.And finally, the Battle Arcade is where
random luck triggers events.You can try any of these facilities!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00006
lines.text:
The battles at the five Battle Frontier
facilities are held under special rules.First and foremost, no Exp. Points
can be earned.Consequently, the Pokémon battling
here will not level up.If the Level 50 rule is chosen,
Pokémon of higher levels will be temporarily reduced to Lv. 50.Pokémon under Lv. 50 will be entered
without an upward level adjustment.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00007
lines.text:
Battle Points are usually referred to
as BP.BP are points that are used only in
the Battle Frontier.BP are awarded for meeting certain
performance goals at the various Battle Frontier facilities.BP can be exchanged for prizes at
the Exchange Service Corner.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00008
lines.text: The Exchange Service Corner is\ncomprised of two tents straight\fahead past here.\rThere, you may exchange your BP for\na wide variety of prizes.\rPlease do visit it!\r

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00009
lines.text: The Performance Monitor shows Trainer\ndata, such as the previous record and\fthe best record to date.\rYou will find one near the reception\ncounter in each facility.\r

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00010
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00017
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rShould I explain how the\nBattle Tower works? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00018
lines.text: The Battle Tower is the building at the\nback of the Battle Frontier.\rThe object here is to enter a team of\ndifferent Pokémon and battle on until\fyou lose.\r

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00019
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00020
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rShould I explain how the\nBattle Factory works? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00021
lines.text:
The Battle Factory is at the upper-
right corner of the Battle Frontier.There, you engage in a knockout
tournament with rented Pokémon.The goal is to keep winning for
as long as possible.Every time you win a match, you may
trade one of your Pokémon for one of the opponent’s Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00022
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00023
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rShould I explain how the\nBattle Hall works? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00024
lines.text:
The Battle Hall is at the upper-left
corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, you enter one Pokémon of your
choosing for one-on-one battles.The objective is to keep your winning
streak going as long as possible.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00025
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00026
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rShould I explain how the\nBattle Castle works? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00027
lines.text:
The Battle Castle is at the lower-left
corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, you are provided with Castle
Points, CP, that you must manage.The CP are used for healing Pokémon,
renting items or Berries, and so on.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive while managing your CP.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00028
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00029
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rShould I explain how the\nBattle Arcade works? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00030
lines.text:
The Battle Arcade is at the lower-right
corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, a game board is activated
before every match.Depending on what comes up on the
game board, an event takes place.Some events will be good to the
challenger, while others won’t be.The challenger may even avoid having
to battle at all.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive as long as possible.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00031
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your visit!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00032
lines.text: The Battle Frontier is up ahead!\nI have explored places all over the\fworld, but nothing compares to the\fexcitement I feel right now!\rWhat kinds of Trainers will I see?\nWhat battles will I experience?\rIt’s a whole new adventure for me!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00033
lines.text:
The five facilities of the Battle
Frontier are...Tower.Hall.Castle.Factory.And Arcade.How do you make an acronym out of
that? THCFA?Rearrange those letters, maybe?
FATCH! CHAFT!...Nope! Nothing works!
Didn’t anyone think of this?!

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00034
lines.text: The Vs. Recorder is sure nifty!\rChecking the Frontier Record\nwill tell you how much BP you have.

lines.label: msg_0103_D32R0101_00035
lines.text:
My dream is to battle Palmer of the
Battle Tower.I want to record it for posterity on
my Vs. Recorder.But I left my Vs. Recorder
at home... I’m heartbroken!

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00000
lines.text: Wait for meeee!!\r

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00001
lines.text: Oh my!\nI fell asleep and ruined my chances\fof being the first to arrive here...\rStupid, stupid me...\nSob...sob...

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00002
lines.text: Stupid, stupid me...\nSob...sob...

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00003
lines.text:
Click, click, click...
Oh! It is you!I’ve gotten over being first all
the time.Now I’m counting the number of people
coming to the Battle Frontier. Of course no one asked me to. It’s just a hobby.

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00004
lines.text:
I can’t stop shivering!I told my family that I would conquer
the Battle Frontier when I left home...But now I’m here, and somehow I
can’t stop shivering!What am I gonna do if I get beaten
to a pulp?

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00005
lines.text: ...You look quite young.\r...\n...\rI will pull myself together and\nchallenge the Battle Frontier...\fMaybe!\r

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00006
lines.text: I will pull myself together and\nchallenge the Battle Frontier!\r...\nOr I might not!\r

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00007
lines.text: Finally!\nI’m here at the Battle Frontier!\rWhen a Pokémon battle on the road\ndoesn’t satisfy you any longer, you\fhave to come to the Battle Frontier!\rWouldn’t you agree?

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00008
lines.text:
Normally, choosing which Pokémon is all
there is to a Pokémon battle.But when you change certain rules or
limitations, the battle suddenly becomes even more fun.And this place you can have such fun...
is called the Battle Frontier!

lines.label: msg_0104_D32R0102_00009
lines.text: This Is the Battle Frontier\rCome, Proud Trainers\nAim for the Top!

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Factory!\rI am your guide to the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rPlease be aware that these challenges\nare designed for a single Trainer.\r

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00001
lines.text: Which challenge would\nyou like to take? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00002
lines.text:
At the Battle Factory, you may take
Single or Double Battle challenges using rental Pokémon.Once entered, your challenge lasts
until you lose.After each win, you may trade a rented
Pokémon for one of the opponent’s.The Level 50 option starts you off with
Pokémon that only know weak moves.The Open Level option gives you access
to Lv. 100 Pokémon with powerful moves from the start.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00003
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Factory!\rI am your guide to the Multi Battle\nchallenge.\rPlease be aware that this challenge\nrequires two Trainers.\r

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00004
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nFactory Multi Battle challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00005
lines.text:
You may team up with a friend for a
Multi Battle challenge using rental Pokémon.Both partners will be provided with two
rental Pokémon each.Once entered, you and your partner
conduct Multi Battles until you lose.After each win, you or your partner
may trade a single rented Pokémon.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).The Level 50 option starts with rental
Pokémon that only know weak moves.The Open Level option lets you rent
Lv. 100 Pokémon with powerful moves from the start.Please note: a Battle Factory Multi
Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00006
lines.text: We hope to see you again!

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00007
lines.text: Which challenge level would you like\nto play? Level 50 or Open Level? {YESNO 0}

Don’t you think?

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00028
lines.text: They tell you about the next Trainer\nyou’ll face? That’s really nice.\rYou know, you can prepare for it\nonce you know what kind of Trainer\fthe next one is!

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00029
lines.text: It’ll help you choose a Pokémon when\nyou remember what kind of Pokémon\fthe other Trainer had and what moves\fthey used.

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00030
lines.text:
This is a place to battle with rental
Pokémon, right?It is a good chance to try Pokémon
you’ve never trained.You’ll learn about new Pokémon
while having exciting battles!What more could you want?

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00031
lines.text:
Do you have a lot of Pokémon?I’m not too proud to say this, but...
I have only a few!But there is nothing to worry about.
Do you know why?This facility, the Battle Factory, has
you use rental Pokémon for battles!

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00032
lines.text: So you have to battle with Pokémon\nyou just met instead of with your\fcherished Pokémon you’ve always\fbattled with?\rOh, I don’t know if I could...\nWill they be nice to me...?\fI’m a little worried.

lines.label: msg_0107_D32R0301_00033
lines.text: All the Trainers gathered at the\nBattle Frontier are nice,\fpleasant people!\rI’m patrolling here on duty, but\notherwise I would love to change\fmy uniform to participate!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI am your guide to the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rPlease be aware that these challenges\nare designed for a single Trainer.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00001
lines.text: Which challenge would you\nlike to take?{YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00002
lines.text:
At the Battle Hall, you may take Single
or Double Battle challenges alone.For the Single Battle challenge, you
enter one Pokémon of at least Lv. 30.The Double Battle Challenge requires
you to enter two of the same kind of Pokémon that are at least Lv. 30 each.Winning-streak records are kept for
individual kinds of Pokémon.That makes it possible for any kind of
Pokémon to aim for no. 1.When you enter the Hall, you will be
asked to choose the type and rank of the Pokémon you want to battle.If you manage to win ten matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00003
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI am your guide to the Multi Battle\nchallenge.\rPlease be aware that this challenge\nrequires two Trainers.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00004
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nHall Multi Battle challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00005
lines.text:
You may team up with a friend for a
Multi Battle challenge using the same kind of Pokémon that are at least Lv. 30 each.When you enter the Hall, you will be
asked to choose the type and rank of the Pokémon you want to battle.If you manage to win ten matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).Please note: a Battle Hall Multi Battle
challenge can’t be interrupted.

lines.text: Want to raise strong Pokémon\nbut have no clue which one to pick...?\rFor those Trainers who feel this way,\nthe Battle Factory is truly a place\fworth visiting!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00025
lines.text: You are quite right.\rThey say life is an endless series of\nlearning opportunities.\rThis place is the best for learning\nabout Pokémon battles and about\fother Trainers...

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00026
lines.text: Aaaaand--bam!\nAaaaaaaaaand--bam!\rI don’t have Pokémon yet, so I’m\npracticing throwing Poké Balls!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00027
lines.text: Grandma, yoo-hoo! Grandma!\nI’ve come to trade Accessories!\fI’ve got somethin’ just for my grandma!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00028
lines.text: Oh, thank you, my dear...\rYou’re so cute and strong and nice...\nI’m lucky to have a grandchild like you.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00029
lines.text:
That little girl over there with
her grandma...I happen to know that little girl is
incredibly strong...Looks can sometimes be deceiving.

lines.text: The Battle Hall Multi Battle challenge\nrequires both partners to enter the\fsame kind of Pokémon.\rPlease confer with your friend and\nchoose the same kind of Pokémon.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00058
lines.text: CHALLENGE

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00059
lines.text:
Do you eat your favorite dish first or
leave it for later?At the Battle Hall, it’s better to start
with the types that your Pokémon do not like. Why?Because the opposition goes up in
level as you progress!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00060
lines.text: That opulent stage!\rYour streaks of winnings are kept per\neach kind of Pokémon.\fEvery Pokémon can get up there.\rDon’t you think it’s wonderful\nyou can aim for the top with\fany Pokémon?

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00061
lines.text: Slow...\rMy SLOWBRO is a cutie, but he’s even\nbattled the Brain here.\rThe Brain will take your Pokémon on at\nthe same level, to be fair.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00062
lines.text: SLOWBRO: ...Slow?

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00063
lines.text: Here is a tip!\rYou should try the Battle Hall with\nnot just your favorite Pokémon,\rbut different kinds of Pokémon\nif you want to build your\foverall record as well.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00064
lines.text: At the Battle Hall, if it’s the same kind\nof Pokémon, you can enter different\fones and still keep your record.\rYou may want to have different ones\nknowing different types of moves.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00065
lines.text:
You know how HOPPIP has two types--
Grass and Flying?That means it can appear as a
Grass type and as a Flying type.Me?You could think of me as...
a “Lighthearted” type and a “Beautiful” type, I guess.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00066
lines.text: A piece of advice...\rAt the Battle Hall, the opposing\nPokémon are matched in level to yours.\rThat way, you can choose any of your\nPokémon without worrying about\ftheir levels.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00067
lines.text: The Battle Hall lets you keep the\nwinning-streak records.\fThat’s neat, huh?\r...Wait a sec!\rMy friend and I can start challenges\nwith identical conditions and see who\fcan stretch their win streak\fthe longest.\fThat’s even more fun!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00068
lines.text: I keep track of the total number of\nwins from your longest Single Battle\fwin streaks at the Battle Hall.\rTo explain, I add only the longest win\nstreaks of each kind of Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00069
lines.text: When your total win-streak record hits\ncertain figures, you will earn BP as\fa reward.\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your total win-streak\nrecord is presently {STRVAR_1 55, 1, 0}.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00070
lines.text: Your total win-streak record has\nreached {STRVAR_1 55, 2, 0}.\fHere is your BP reward.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00071
lines.text: When your total win-streak record\nreaches {STRVAR_1 55, 3, 0}, you will earn BP.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00072
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received {STRVAR_1 53, 4, 0} BP!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00073
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your total win-streak\nrecord stands at {STRVAR_1 55, 1, 0}.\r

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00074
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your total win-streak\nrecord stands at {STRVAR_1 55, 1, 0}.\r...My goodness!\nThat’s a fantastic record!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00075
lines.text:
Winston: The Battle Hall’s been kind of
boring lately.There haven’t been any dazzling
challengers who can electrify crowds.The kind of challenger who can beat the
Brain... Aren’t there any around?

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00076
lines.text: Winston: Let me take a wild guess.\nAre you getting into the Battle Hall?\fIt’s addictively fun, huh?\rThe more you win, the more kinds of\nPokémon you get to see, too.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00077
lines.text:
Winston: ...
...Oh, sorry for staring!I saw you on stage the last time.
You’ve got some star quality.I think I’m going to keep an eye on you.
There’s real charisma there.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00078
lines.text: Winston: I check you out every time\nyou get up on stage.\rYou’re fun to watch, let me tell you.\rNow I’m always looking forward to\nseeing the combo of you and your\fPokémon on stage.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00079
lines.text:
Winston: Hey, there!
What are you going to do this time?Which Pokémon are you going for a
record with next?When I get to thinking about that,
I get too wound up to sleep at night.That’s why I’ve been sleeping in lately!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00080
lines.text: Winston: Awesome!\nSeriously awesome!\fYou’re beyond awesome, even!\rThe love you show so many Pokémon...\nIt’s no easy feat, I can tell ya!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00081
lines.text:
Winston: I’ve never seen Pokémon
battle as enjoyably as yours do.You’re the first of a kind for me as
Trainers go.You know, I brag about you to everyone
who’s willing to listen.I was saying that you’re going to be a
star before you even got a record!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00082
lines.text:
Winston: Go, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, go!
Go, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, go!I’m thinking up some dance steps and
cheers I can do to support you.If you want to see them, you’ll need to
keep working on your records!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00083
lines.text: Winston: You’re phenomenal.\nAll the battles you waged on stage...\fAll those moments of glory...\rYour star burns so bright and huge!\nI can barely open my eyes around you!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00084
lines.text:
Winston: The love for Pokémon you
exhibited at the Battle Hall is as infinitely deep as it is wide...You can count on me, Winston, to be
your lifelong fan.Just as you love Pokémon, I love you
as the Pokémon superstar!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00085
lines.text:
Serena: It’s about the Battle Hall...
It hasn’t excited me lately.There’s been no gorgeous sort of
challenger who can dazzle me.The kind of challenger who can make me
a fan... Aren’t there any around?

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00086
lines.text:
Serena: Um... Excuse me?If you don’t mind me asking, are you
getting into the Battle Hall?It’s fun in an engrossing way, isn’t it?
Did you know?The more you win, the more kinds of
Pokémon appear.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00087
lines.text: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rI watched you when you were on stage.\nIt made me feel all tingly seeing you.\rUm... You won’t mind if I cheer for you\nfrom now on, will you? Please, may I?

lines.text: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rI cheer for you the best I can.\rI can’t get up on stage with you, but\nI want to lend my support to your\fPokémon and you for trying so hard.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00089
lines.text:
Serena: Um... Excuse me?Can you tell me what kind of Pokémon
you’re going for a record with next?When I start thinking about that, I get
sort of all choked up.I have trouble sleeping at night when
I get that way.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00090
lines.text: Serena: Um... Excuse me?\rFantastic! It’s fantastic!\nYou’re fabulously fantastic!\rThe love you show so many Pokémon...\nIt must take extraordinary effort.

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00091
lines.text:

battle as enjoyably as yours do.You’re the first Trainer ever who’s
done that.I... I brag about you to all my friends.
I hope you don’t mind.I tell them I wish I could be as
wonderful a Trainer as you!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00092
lines.text:

giddy and...

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00093
lines.text: Serena: You’re so inspiring to me.\rAll the glory you earned while battling\nso often on that shining stage...\rJust seeing you makes me feel all\nhappy inside. ♫

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00094
lines.text:
Serena: Your Pokémon love that you’ve
shown at the Battle Hall is as infinitely deep as it is wide...It’s amazing, but you love every kind of
Pokémon there is.I love you for being so amazing and
dedicated!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00095
lines.text: Lyra: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\nI love watching you battle here.\rCause...\nyou have fun whether you win\for lose!

lines.text: Ethan: The Battle Hall is great for\nPokémon fans like me!\rI get to see so many new kinds of\nPokémon I’ve never seen.\rIt’s so cool!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00097
lines.text: Mom: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI couldn’t help checking up on you!\rEveryone is working hard, but I have\nto say you look more delighted than\fanyone else!\rOh, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, that’s right!\rI should go to the Department Store\nin Goldenrod and buy some useful\fitems for you on the way home!

lines.label: msg_0108_D32R0401_00098

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Castle!\rI am your guide to the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rPlease be aware that these challenges\nare designed for a single Trainer.\r

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00001
lines.text: Which challenge would you\nlike to take? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00002
lines.text:
At the Battle Castle, you may take a
Single or Double Battle challenge.Here, you are provided with Castle
Points (CP) that you must manage.The CP are used for healing Pokémon,
renting items or Berries, and so on.CP are earned by winning matches.
The amount varies by how you win.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive while managing your CP.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00003
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Castle!\rI am your guide to the Multi Battle\nchallenge.\rPlease be aware that this challenge\nrequires two Trainers.\r

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00004
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nCastle Multi Battle challenge? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0109_D32R0501_00005
lines.text:
You may team up with a friend for a
Multi Battle challenge.Both Trainers are provided with Castle
Points (CP) that must be managed.The CP is used for healing Pokémon,
renting items or Berries, and so on.Trainers can use their CP on not only
their own Pokémon, but also their partner’s.Both Trainers earn CP by winning
matches.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive while managing your CP.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).Please note: a Battle Castle Multi
Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Battle Arcade!\rI am your guide to the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rPlease be aware that these challenges\nare designed for a single Trainer.\r

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00001
lines.text: Which challenge would you like\nto take?{YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00002
lines.text:
At the Battle Arcade, you may take a
Single or Double Battle challenge.Here, a game board is activated
before every match.Depending on what comes up on the
game board, an event takes place.Some events will be good for the
challenger, while others won’t be.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive as long as possible.During your challenge, any items held by
your Pokémon will be kept in storage.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.If you don’t save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.Please be aware of that!

Multi Battle challenge.Here, a game board is activated
before every match.Depending on what comes up on the
game board, an event takes place.The events may have great impact on
the match’s outcome, good or bad.The objective is to keep a winning
streak alive as long as possible.During your challenge, any items held by
your Pokémon will be kept in storage.If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).Please note: a Battle Arcade Multi
Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00046
lines.text: The game board is like your life.\rIt goes round and round\nas your fortune goes up and down...\fHow did that sound?\rIt almost made some kind of sense,\ndidn’t it?

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00047
lines.text: There’s an aspect of luck in\nPokémon battles...\rThe Battle Arcade reminds me of that,\ndecisively. Very decisively...

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00048
lines.text: What quality is most needed here?\nIs it strength?\fWisdom?\fLuck?\fNo. The answer is...flexibility.\fThat’s what my gut tells me.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00049
lines.text:
Do you know what I mean by
“stop on the spot”?It’s the skill of stopping the
game board at the right time!But, remember... If you don’t stop it in 30 seconds,
it will stop by itself.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00050
lines.text: I thought I was fully prepared with my\nprized Pokémon, but I had to swap them\fand use my opponent’s instead!\fI need to rethink all my strategies.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00051
lines.text: I chose Pokémon that are good at\nattacking.\fBut my opponent went for speed!\rNext time, I’ll try Pokémon with\nsuperior speed.

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00052
lines.text: There are advantages to be gained from\n“stop on the spot” skills!\rBut there’s a lot of fun in letting the\nunknown hand of luck decide...

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00053
lines.text: The game board shows better choices\nthe greater the wins you achieve...\rCould this board be alive...?

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00054
lines.text: Did you figure this one out?\rParalyzing events here won’t\naffect Ground-type Pokémon.\rYou should tell everybody!

lines.label: msg_0110_D32R0601_00055
lines.text: I’ll tell you something.\rPoisoning or freezing events can be\nmade ineffective.\r...If the Pokémon’s type or ability\nprotects it from such status problems.\rMight be worth knowing!

You’ll come to appreciate Team Rocket’s true power soon enough.Enjoy yourself while you can...
Hee hee hee...

Are you a newcomer, too?We had to recruit new members for the
Radio Tower mission. Then we ran out of uniforms.I heard this studio has some, so I
decided to “borrow” one.Since you are here, why don’t you
change as well?

lines.label: msg_0117_D37R0102_00037
lines.text: Look at you! Pretty good!\rOh, but you shouldn’t try to scare\npeople walking around looking\flike that, OK?

lines.label: msg_0117_D37R0102_00039
lines.text:
Ooh, your Pokémon are so very
charming! How enchanting!If you dress up your Pokémon here,
make it a sight to behold!Then I will even hang a picture of one
in the other room!You will do this, won’t you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0117_D37R0102_00040

lines.label: msg_0117_D37R0102_00041

and put it up beside me!If you mix your records with others,
you can get their photos, too!I think it will be much easier if 
you will just try! {YESNO 0}

they control the transmitter.They may even be able to control
Pokémon using a special signal!You’re the only one I can call on.
Please save the Radio Tower... and all the Pokémon nationwide!

lines.text: Hey!\rI am the Karate King!\nI train alone here in the cave!\rYou!\nBattle with me! Hwaaarggh!\r

lines.label: msg_0124_D40R0104_00000
lines.text:
A long time ago, the Whirl Islands used
to be one large island.There were two countries fighting over
the island back then.LUGIA, the guardian of the island, got
upset and cast lightning bolts to tear the island into four pieces, then disappeared into the deep end of the waterfall basin...I will let you through if you bring the
Silver Wing, which is said to have fallen from LUGIA.But the true challenge is whether
LUGIA will appear in front of you.What LUGIA has longed for is the
invisible trust between people and Pokémon...Or the person who can restore such
a relationship...

lines.label: msg_0124_D40R0104_00001
lines.text: LUGIA, the Pokémon of the island, hid\nitself deep in the end of the waterfall\fbasin, and no one has seen it since...\rIf anyone who could restore deep trust\nbetween people and Pokémon were to\fcome here with something linked to\fLUGIA, it may show itself for such\fa person...

lines.text: You are quite a remarkable Trainer\nfor your age...

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00000
lines.text: Zuki: That’s right.\nThis is where we welcome LUGIA.\rWhen the dance we practiced many days\nbecomes one with the sound of the\fTidal Bell we entrusted with you, then\fLUGIA shall come out from deep within\fthe waterfall basin once again!\r

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00001
lines.text: This is all we can do for you...\nWhat you do now is entirely up to you...

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00002
lines.text:
That is indeed LUGIA...
The guardian of these islands from ancient times...So many have tried again and again,
only to fail...{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, your heart in complete
harmony with the Tidal Bell has finally allowed it to appear...

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00003
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, don’t you see?\rLUGIA... It must have been waiting for\nsomeone like you all this time.\fWouldn’t you agree...?

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00004
lines.text: LUGIA: Gyaaas!\r

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00005
lines.text: You’ve done a great job. Say hello to\nProfessor Elm for us.

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00006
lines.text:
You have not only made LUGIA appear,
but you also caught it...You are so wonderful.
There is nothing more for us to say.Take good care of yourself in
your journey...

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00007
lines.text: If that is what you believe, we will not\ntry to convince you otherwise.\rStill, if you wish to see LUGIA once\nmore, perhaps you can come back here\fafter all has been settled...

lines.label: msg_0125_D40R0107_00008
lines.text: I think once you turn your back to it,\nLUGIA will not come back for\fsome time...\rIf you want to see LUGIA, perhaps you\ncan come back here after all\fhas been settled...

lines.label: msg_0127_D42R0101_00000
lines.text: Whoa! You startled me there!\rI had my BlackGlasses on, so I didn’t\nnotice you at all.\rWhat am I doing here?\rHey, don’t you worry about it.\nI’ll give you a pair of BlackGlasses, so\fforget you saw me, OK?\r

lines.label: msg_0127_D42R0101_00002
lines.text: BlackGlasses up the power of\nDark-type moves.

lines.label: msg_0127_D42R0101_00003
lines.text: You don’t have room for this...

lines.label: msg_0128_D43R0103_00000
lines.text:
Hold it....Are you going to challenge the
Pokémon League?Victory Road is at its end, for sure.But did you notice...?
You didn’t see any real Trainers on the way, did you?Man, they were all spineless!Well, the fact that you have come this
far means you’re not one of them.But!Your journey ends here!Because...right here, right now...
I will crush you!

lines.label: msg_0128_D43R0103_00001
lines.text:
..................I haven’t given up on becoming the
greatest Trainer...I’m going to find out why I can’t win and
become stronger...When I do, I will challenge you.I’ll beat you down with all my power.
...Humph! You keep at it until then.

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00000
lines.text: Wait!\r

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00001
lines.text: Clair: I’m sorry about this.\nHere, take this as my apology.\r

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00003
lines.text: That contains Dragon Pulse.\rWell, Dragon Pulse is a kind of er...\nnever mind!\rIt’s huge energy of some kind.\nIf you don’t want it, you don’t\fhave to take it.\r

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00004
lines.text: Oh? You don’t have any room for this.\rI’m going back to the Gym, so make\nroom, then come see me there.\r

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00005
lines.text:
What’s the matter?
If you are headed to the Pokémon League, go back to New Bark Town and Surf along Route 27.Your face...is telling me you have
some unfinished business...Come on!Whatever you have to face from now,
don’t you dare give up!If you do, I’ll feel even worse
about having lost to you! Give it your all.

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00006
lines.text: Dragon Shrine\rA shrine revering the Dragon Pokémon\nsaid to have lived in Dragon’s Den.

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00007
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: ...
What? {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?Yeah, I am training my Pokémon here.
You can laugh at me now...But it needs to be done.
My Pokémon aren’t ready to beat you. I can’t push them too hard now.I have to be disciplined to become
the greatest Pokémon Trainer...

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00008
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: ...\rWhew...\rLearn to stay out\nof my way...

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00009

{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: ...What?
Are you here to make fun of my training?Humph!
I took my time coming all the way here,but the Master won’t tell me anything,
and he’s making a big deal out of it...So I decided to train my Pokémon
here instead.

I was in a bit of a hurry then.Sorry for that.
But...I always welcome challengers!Hey!
How about a Double Battle?

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00021

lines.label: msg_0129_D44R0102_00024
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nCome to my side!\fWe’ll beat Lance together!\r
