lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00000
lines.text: Hm... Good to see you here.\fNo need to explain why you came.\rClair sent you here, didn’t she?\fThat girl is a handful...\rI am sorry, but I must test you.\rNot to worry, you are to answer only\na few questions.\fReady?\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00001
lines.text: What are Pokémon to you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00002
lines.text: What helps you to win battles? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00003
lines.text: What kind of Trainer do you\nwish to battle? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00004
lines.text: What is most important for\nraising Pokémon? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00005
lines.text: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon.\nWhich is more important? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00006
lines.text: Hm... I see...\nYou care deeply for Pokémon.\rVery commendable.\fThat conviction is what is important!\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, don’t lose that belief.\rIt will see you through at the\nPokémon League.\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00007
lines.text: Hah? I didn’t quite catch that...\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00008
lines.text: What was it you said?

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00009
lines.text: Oh, I understand...\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00010
lines.text: So how did it go?\rI guess there’s no point in asking.\nYou did fail?\f...\f...What? You passed?\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00011
lines.text: {SIZE 200}That can’t be!{SIZE 100}\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00012
lines.text: You’re lying!\nEven I haven’t been approved!\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00013
lines.text: Clair!\rThis child is impeccable,\nin skill and spirit!\rAdmit defeat and confer the\nRising Badge!\r...Or must I inform Lance of this?\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00014
lines.text: I... I understand...\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00015
lines.text: Here, this is the Rising Badge...\nHurry up! Take it!\r

Have you heard of LUGIA?It is a Pokémon said to have lived
around Whirl Islands once... ...Never mind.Just mad words of the old.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00024
lines.text: It’s been quite some time since a\nTrainer has gained our Master’s\frare approval.\rIn fact, not since Master Lance.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00025
lines.text: You know young Master Lance?\rHe looks so much like our Master\ndid in his youth.\fIt’s in their blood.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00026
lines.text: Hm... Good to see you here.\rYour arrival is most fortunate.\nI have something for you.\rTake this DRATINI as proof that I\nnow know your worth.\r

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00027
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nDRATINI from the Master!

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00028
lines.text: Hm? Your party is full.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00029
lines.text: Dragon Pokémon are symbolic of\nour clan.\rYou have shown that you can be\nentrusted with one.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00030
lines.text: Clair appears to have learned an\ninvaluable lesson from you.\rI thank you as her grandfather.

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00031
lines.text: A boy close to your age is in\ntraining here.\rHe is much like Clair when she was\nyounger. It is a little worrisome...

lines.label: msg_0130_D44R0103_00032
lines.text: Give a nickname to the\nDRATINI you received? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0131_D45R0102_00000
lines.text: ...\rI don’t know why you have come here.\rAnyway, I have to warn you that\nthis is not a place for kids like you.\r

lines.label: msg_0131_D45R0102_00001
lines.text: You have a certain look...\rIt reminds me of the kid who stood in\nfront of me three years ago...\fYou have the same eyes...\r...\rI’m on my way to Goldenrod City to\nanswer the call and join my team.\fAre you going to get in my way?\r

lines.label: msg_0131_D45R0102_00002
lines.text: ...\nThis is the Radio Tower.\fThis is the Radio Tower.\fWe are pleased to declare\fTeam Rocket’s revival.\f...Giovanni?\f...Can you hear us?\fWe have finally made it!\f...\r

lines.label: msg_0131_D45R0102_00003
lines.text: My old associates need me...\rWe will not repeat the failure of three\nyears ago!\r{COLOR 1}Team Rocket{COLOR 0} will be born again, and I\nwill rule the world!\r

a waste...?How can a kid like you manage to
destroy my dream once again?The precious dream of Team Rocket has
become little more than an illusion...

lines.text: Did you have fun?\nPlease come again!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00010
lines.text: I am sorry.\nYou don’t have enough money.\rI hope you will drop by again.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00011
lines.text: Owner!\nYou don’t have enough money.\rI hope you drop by again.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00012
lines.text: I am sorry.\nThere is no room left in the PC!\rPlease come back after you have made\nsome room.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00013
lines.text: Owner!\nThere is no room left in the PC!\rPlease come back after you have made\nsome room.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00014
lines.text: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe Safari Zone? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00015
lines.text: Welcome, Owner!\nShould I explain the Safari Zone? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00016
lines.text:
At the Safari Zone, you can enjoy a
Safari Game where you are given {STRVAR_1 51, 1, 0} Safari Balls to try to catch Pokémon.When you have run out of Safari Balls,
the game is over.When you see a Pokémon, you can choose
to throw Bait or Mud.If you throw Bait, Pokémon tend to stay
but will become more difficult to catch.If you throw Mud, it will become easier
to catch, but the Pokémon may flee.Have fun at the Safari Zone!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00017
lines.text: Have fun at the Safari Zone!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00018
lines.text: Warden Baoba has something important\nto share with you!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00019
lines.text: This is the Area Customizer.\nWhat would you like to know about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00020
lines.text: The Safari Zone has six Areas.\rPlains Area...\nPeak Area...\fand so on.\rThe Area Customizer allows you to\nchange the combination of these Areas.\rWhat would you like to know? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00021
lines.text:
Check out the machine, and you’ll see
the Area Customizer screen.The lower window shows the current
Safari Zone setting.Select an Area with the A Button to
swap it with another.What would you like to know? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00022
lines.text: When you select an Area, then select\nSwap, you will see 12 new Areas.\rSelect one of them by highlighting it and\npressing the A Button.\rWhat would you like to know? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00023
lines.text: When you select an Area, then select\nOrder, the Area type will not change,\fbut the location can now be changed.\rWhat would you like to know? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00024
lines.text: Different Areas have different Pokémon\nliving in them, so when you change\fAreas, you will see different Pokémon.\rPlease do try the different Areas!\nWhat would you like to know? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00025
lines.text: I am sorry, but this can’t be used yet.\nWarden Baoba has a great plan for this\fmachine...or so he says. But even we\fdon’t know what it is. It’s a secret.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00026
lines.text: Please enjoy the Area Customizer!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00027
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} turned on\nthe Area Customizer!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00028
lines.text: It is still under development.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00029
lines.text:
Hi, I have been waiting for you!
What do you think?This is a brand-new Safari Zone.
By the way...I just had an idea.
Would you like to take the Owner Aptitude Test? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00030
lines.text:
Right on!
Let me explain how the test works. It’s very easy.All you have to do is to catch one
GEODUDE at the Safari and show it to me.They are in the grass closest to the
entrance. It shouldn’t take long before you catch one.Good luck!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00031
lines.text:
Wow, I never thought anyone
would decline!You can become the Safari Zone Owner,
don’t you see?Owner...
It’s got a nice ring to it, doesn’t it?You should try the test! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00032
lines.text:
Oh, wonderful!
You’ve caught a GEODUDE! You’ve passed the first test...................Huh? Didn’t I tell you that there are
two tests?That’s right!
Becoming an owner is not that easy.The second test is...
Well, I am still preparing for it.I will let you know once it’s ready.
You need to wait just a little. I will call you with the Pokégear.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00033
lines.text: Show me the GEODUDE once you’ve\ncaught one.\rThey are in the grass closest to the\nentrance. It shouldn’t take long.\rGood luck!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00034
lines.text:
I’ve been waiting for you!
The test is ready.This time can you catch a SANDSHREW
and show it to me?Sounds easy, right? Not really!
SANDSHREW will not appear with the current Safari Zone setting.And that’s where this comes in handy!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00035
lines.text:
This sophisticated, high-tech machine
lets you customize Safari Zone Areas. I call it the Area Customizer!You want to know how it works,
don’t you? It’s a...secret!Well, you shouldn’t have trouble
operating it. Just talk to the staff next to me!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00036
lines.text:
I almost forgot!I was in the middle of explaining
the second test, wasn’t I?You will not see SANDSHREW
with the current Safari Zone Areas,so you have to use the Area Customizer
to change them.SANDSHREW live in the desert!
Good luck!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00037
lines.text: You did it!\rYou caught a SANDSHREW!\nI knew you could do it.\rYou’ve passed the test!\nYou are now the Safari Zone Owner!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00038
lines.text: I’ve always wanted to see young people\nplaying at the safari!\rI thought I might get some new ideas.\nThat should help you complete your\fPokédex.\rThat’s what I have been thinking.\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00039
lines.text: By the way, though you are now the\nSafari Zone Owner, would you kindly\fcontinue to pay admission?\fWe have our reasons.\rDon’t be upset. I’ll keep thinking about\nhow I can create new fun ways to\fhelp you complete your Pokédex.\rGo have fun at the Safari Zone!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00040
lines.text: I will let you know as soon as I come up\nwith something new, using the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00041
lines.text: Show me the SANDSHREW once you’ve\ncaught one. SANDSHREW live in the\fdesert! Good luck!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00042
lines.text: Slow down.\rOnce the next test is ready, I will call\nyou using the Pokégear.\rGive me some time, OK?

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00043
lines.text:
Hi, I have been waiting for you!I had an epiphany!
A new attraction!I’ve decided to call it...
Object Arrangement!This is going to be fun!
You can place objects on the field as you play at the Safari Zone!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00044
lines.text: Not only that, but the types of\nPokémon you see will change depending\fon the types of objects you place.\rIsn’t it amazing?\nI will call you using the Pokégear if\fsomething else comes up!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00045
lines.text: I will explain Object Arrangement.\nWould you like to know anything? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00046
lines.text: I will explain Object Arrangement.\nFeel free to ask me any questions.\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00047
lines.text:
There are many objects you can place
anywhere as you walk around the Safari Zone, except on stairs and grass where Pokémon appear!You also want to remember that you can
place up to 30 objects in an Area.Would you like to know anything
else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00048
lines.text:
It is easy to place objects. All you
have to do is make sure that the spot in front of you is clear.If it’s empty, you can select
an object.Some objects are large and may need a
large space.Would you like to know anything
else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00049
lines.text: If you want to remove an object, just\nwalk up to it and check it. The objects\fyou have placed will glow in the dark.\fIt should help you at night.\rWould you like to know anything\nelse? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00050
lines.text:
There are many different objects.
Ones that look like grass, like trees, like boulders, like water, and other types of objects...Try placing different objects. The
number of objects placed in an Area is shown in the Area Customizer on the top screen.There will be more objects to come,
as I’ll keep adding more.Would you like to know anything
else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00051
lines.text:
The types of Pokémon you see will
change depending on the types of objects you place.The Safari Zone is also changed
at that point. Try placing different types of objects.Would you like to know anything
else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00052
lines.text: Beware!\rOnce you’ve swapped Areas, the\nobjects you placed will all be removed.\rWould you like to know\nanything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00053
lines.text: I hope you enjoy it!\nGo, and have fun!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00054
lines.text: Welcome to {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Safari Zone!\rFor just $500, you can play the\nSafari Game.\rYou can roam the wide-open Safari Zone\nand catch what you like.\fWould you like to play? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00055
lines.text: That’ll be ${STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0}, please!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00056
lines.text: OK.\nPlease come again!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00057
lines.text: Here are your Safari Balls.\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00058
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received {STRVAR_1 51, 1, 0} Safari Balls.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00059
lines.text: We’ll call you when you run out of\nSafari Balls.\rWell, I’ll wish you the best of luck!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00060
lines.text: You don’t have your friend’s\nSafari Zone.\fSorry, but you cannot enter here.\rPlease talk to the attendant next\nto me.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00061
lines.text: You still have time left. Are you sure\nyou want to leave the Safari Zone?

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00062
lines.text: Certainly.\rPlease return any Safari Balls\nyou may have remaining.\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00063
lines.text: Did you have fun?\nPlease come again!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00064
lines.text: I am sorry.\nYou don’t have enough money.\rI hope you drop by again.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00065
lines.text: Owner!\rThis is the Safari Zone Link\nreception counter.\rYou can exchange Safari Zones here.\rWould you like to link with your\nfriends to exchange Safari Zones? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00066
lines.text: This is the Safari Zone Link\nreception counter.\rYou can exchange Safari Zones here.\rWould you like to link with your\nfriends to exchange Safari Zones? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00067
lines.text: Would you like to save the game?

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00068
lines.text: There is already a saved file.\nIs it OK to overwrite it?

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00069

lines.text: Please decide which of you two\nwill become the group leader.\rThe other player must then choose\n“JOIN GROUP.” {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00072
lines.text: Choose the player to exchange\nSafari Zones with. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00073

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00074

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00079

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00081
lines.text: You are about to receive a Safari Zone.\nPlease wait.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00082
lines.text: You have received\n{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Safari Zone!\r

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00083
lines.text: The Safari Zone Link is finished!\rPlease come to the reception counter\nnext to you.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00085

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00089
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} saved the game.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00091
lines.text: The Safari Zone Areas have\nbeen swapped.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00092
lines.text: This is the reception for the\nSafari Zone Link.\r...Or should I say...is going to be.\rWe’re still not ready.\nPlease come back later.

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00093
lines.text: Owner!\nThis is the Safari Zone Link reception.\rWould you like to know about the\nSafari Zone Link? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00094
lines.text: This is the Safari Zone Link reception.\rWould you like to know about\nthe Safari Zone Link? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00095
lines.text:
You can exchange Safari Zones with your
friends using the Safari Zone Link.You will be able to play in their
Safari Zone!Areas and Pokémon will be different.
Beware!The Safari Zone you receive will 
disappear after 24 hours or if you receive another Safari Zone.To your right is the reception for the
Safari Zone Link.To your left is the reception to play in
your friend’s Safari Zone.Enjoy the Safari Zone Link!

lines.label: msg_0135_D47R0101_00096
lines.text: OK! Enjoy the Safari Zone Link!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00000
lines.text:
Did you know?
They are constructing a Safari Zone just around the corner.They say it’ll be really fun!
You will see many different kinds of Pokémon, and it’s all you can catch!There is no reason not to go, right?
I’m so looking forward to the Safari Zone!Finish the construction already!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00001
lines.text:
Did you know? There’s a Safari Zone
just around the corner.It’s really fun!
You will see many different kinds of Pokémon, and it’s all you can catch!There is no reason not to go, right?
Just around the corner.It won’t take too long.
Why don’t you drop by? Won’t you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00002
lines.text: All right!\nIt’s just over there.\rGo up the stairs, and you’ll be outside.\nThen it’s only a few paces away!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00003
lines.text: It’s such a good deal, you know?

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00004
lines.text: See? The Safari Zone was fun?\nNo need to say anything!\fYour face says it was really fun!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00005
lines.text: What?\nYou want to go to the Safari Zone, too?\rIt’s still under construction.\nPlease come back later.

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00006
lines.text: I appreciate that everybody is looking\nforward to it. But the lady at the\freception seems a bit too dramatic...\fDon’t get your expectations too high!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00007
lines.text:
Chuck: Hey, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
Good to see you again! But I never expected to see you around here.Could it be...that you are on the way
to the Embedded Tower?The Embedded Tower is a huge tower
piercing the sky.It is said to have something to do with
the mythical Pokémon that stretched the seas and that Pokémon that widened the lands.But the tower no longer is standing.

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00008
lines.text: Chuck: The way to the Embedded Tower\nis harder than you can imagine.\rYou need to use Rock Climb\nas well as Surf.\r

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00009
lines.text: Chuck: I see! So you’ve defeated all\nthe Gym Leaders in Kanto as well!\rThen there’s nothing to worry about.\nBelieve in yourself and walk your path.\rYahaha!\r

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00010
lines.text: Everything Is Thrilling!\nExplore to Find Wild Pokémon!\rWarden Baoba’s Safari Zone\nComing Soon!

lines.label: msg_0136_D48R0101_00011
lines.text: Everything Is Thrilling!\nExplore to Find Wild Pokémon!\rWarden Baoba’s Safari Zone\nUp and Running!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00000
lines.text: Muhaha!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00001
lines.text:
I feel it!The twinkle in your eyes!
The twinkle of friendship!You’re quite something.
Your {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0} is quite a Pokémon!It’s ready to participate in the
Pokéathlon, bud!Most of all, your solidarity with and
trust of Pokémon makes me believe in infinite potential!All right. Follow me!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00002
lines.text: What do you think?\nThis is the Pokéathlon Dome!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00003
lines.text: Pokéathlon is a sports festival for\nTrainers and Pokémon!\rInside the Dome are various challenges\nawaiting Trainers and Pokémon to test\ftheir friendship.\fWhy don’t you try it?\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00004
lines.text:
You’re amazing, bud!
This is a pleasant surprise!To see a Pokéathlete with strong
potential is such a pleasure! I’m glad I held the Pokéathlon here in Johto....My name is Magnus.
We shall meet again, bud.Magnus: See you, young Pokéathlete!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00005
lines.text:
I feel it!The twinkle in your eyes!
The twinkle of friendship!You’re ready to participate in the
Pokéathlon, bud!Most of all, your mutual trust and
teamwork with Pokémon makes me believe anything is possible!All right. Follow me, bud!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00006
lines.text: Hmmm...\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00007
lines.text: Running and jumping and...\nThere are so many events for Pokémon\fto choose from. Which one should I try?

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00008
lines.text: ODDISH: Odd! Odd!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00009
lines.text: There is more to Pokémon than battling!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00010
lines.text: MEOWTH: Nyaah!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00011
lines.text: It’s not good at battles...but no\nPokémon can beat it at running, thanks\fto the walk we take every morning!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00012
lines.text: Huff huff!\nEveryday training is the sure way\fto glory!\rDashing 1,000 times!\nThat’s my goal for now.\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00013
lines.text: What’s your goal?\nHaving a goal lets you enjoy life more.

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00014
lines.text:
............
Oh, you have done the dash 1,000 times?I thought it was basically impossible,
but you make me feel courageous.Thank you!
Please take this!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00015
lines.text: I’ve become your fan! I would run\nanywhere for you!\fI’ll be supporting you!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00016
lines.text: PIDGEY: Po po!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00017
lines.text:
Have you heard of Aprijuice?Pokémon can increase their Performance
with food and drink.Aprijuice is a drink developed from
nutrition research to improve Performance.If you let your Pokémon drink it before
a Pokéathlon event, it will show its true potential!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00018
lines.text: SLOWBRO: Whick!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00019
lines.text: Each Pokémon has its unique traits.\rA true Pokéathlete knows them and lets\nthe true Performance of his or her\fPokémon emerge!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00020
lines.text: MACHOP: Machao!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00021
lines.text: Oh!\nThey look good today!\rThey weren’t so well yesterday, but\nwe’ll win today for sure!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00022
lines.text: SLOWPOKE: Moah!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00023
lines.text: FARFETCH’D: Teree!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00024
lines.text: PSYDUCK: Guack!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00025
lines.text: Energy drink!\nWelcome to the Aprijuice stand!\rAre you giving your Pokémon Aprijuice?\nI can explain anything you\fneed to know about it! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00026
lines.text: Energy drink!\nWelcome to the Aprijuice stand!\rHuh? What’s that confused look about?\nYou don’t know about Aprijuice?\fThere, take this!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00027
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Apriblender!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00028
lines.text: You put away the Apriblender\nin the Apricorn Box.\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00029
lines.text:
When you have the Apriblender, you can
make Aprijuice to let your Pokémon show their true potential!It’s so easy to make! All you have to
do is to put Apricorns in the Apriblender. Put in as many as you can!The more, the merrier!
Then you walk!You can run if you want...
98...99...100 steps!Here! Then you open it, give it to your
Pokémon, or drink it yourself.You can buy Aprijuice here.
Why don’t you try and see how it works?Do you have any more questions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00030
lines.text: Aprijuice improves a Pokémon’s\nPerformance! Pokémon have strengths\fand weaknesses.\rBut there is no need to worry. Give it\nAprijuice, and you can max out its\fPerformance!\rYou will need it!\rDo you have any more questions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00031
lines.text:
Choose from the three Apriblenders.The labels tell you what kind of drink
it is. Different drinks have different effects.You should use them to suit the event
you want to participate in. That’s how to make a top Pokéathlete.But remember this!
If your Pokémon’s Performance is maxed out, you cannot make it higher.You should check your Pokémon’s
Performance before you give it Aprijuice.Do you have any more questions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00032
lines.text: Charge yourself with friendship!\nGet in the know about Aprijuice!\fPick one from the shelf!

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00033
lines.text: So discerning of you!\n{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s {STRVAR_1 8, 1, 0}!\fOnly ${STRVAR_1 53, 2, 0}! Quite a bargain! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00034
lines.text: Thank you!\nWhich Pokémon do you want to give it to?\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00035
lines.text: Charge yourself with friendship!\nCome back again when you want more!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00036
lines.text: That’s a pity!\nCome back when you want to win!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00037
lines.text: Oh, you don’t have enough money!\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00038
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s {STRVAR_1 8, 1, 0}!\nOnly ${STRVAR_1 53, 2, 0}! Quite a bargain! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00039
lines.text: Hi! What can I do for you?\r

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00040

lines.label: msg_0137_D49_00049
lines.text: The Pokéathlon Dome\nThe Place for True Pokéathletes!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00048
lines.text:
Hello. Oh, you must be new here.
Welcome to the Athlete Shop!Have you and your Pokémon
been exercising?Flying sweat!
Breathing in unison! Newborn friendship!We support your Pokéathlete lifestyle.
The Athlete Points you have earned can be used here for prizes.Let me say this again.
Welcome to the Athlete Shop! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00049
lines.text: Welcome to the Athlete Shop! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00050
lines.text: We are closed for the day.\nPlease come back tomorrow for\fa whole new set of prizes!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00051
lines.text: Thank you, please come again.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00052
lines.text:
The scores in the Pokéathlon...
The proof of your friendship with your Pokémon, so to speak, give you Athlete Points.You can trade them here for
various prizes.Score as much as possible and come back
here for prizes!Is there anything else I can do
for you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00053
lines.text:
Welcome!This is the place we keep the Pokéathlon
database.Using the Data Card at the monitor
next to me will allow you to check your records.Some are cool, and some are...
embarrassing!Please make good use of it.Would you like to buy a Data Card
that contains Pokéathlon records? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00054
lines.text: Welcome!\rThe Data Card, which contains\nPokéathlon records, is sold here.\rWould you like to buy a Data Card? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00055
lines.text: Giggle!\nThe truth is, I know a lot about you!\fLet me see...\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00056
lines.text: You’ve participated in\nthe Pokéathlon...\f{STRVAR_1 51, 0, 0} times!\fGiggle!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00057
lines.text: You’ve participated in\nthe Pokéathlon...\fWow, over 100 times!\rBravo!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00058
lines.text:
As I just demonstrated, the Pokéathlon
database seems to know everything. Doesn’t that interest you?You can exchange your Athlete Points
for a Data Card and check your records using the monitor next to me.Please make good use of it.
Is there anything else I can do for you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00059
lines.text: Thank you. Please come again!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00060
lines.text: Hello, Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rAre you working on breaking your own\nrecords? You can check your records\fat the monitor next to me.\rCheck it out from time to time!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00061
lines.text: We have run out of Data Cards.\nBut don’t be disappointed.\rThere are more Data Cards to come!\nI will make sure to get them for you.\fPlease come back later.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00062
lines.text:
We have run out of Data Cards.
But don’t be disappointed.There are more Data Cards to come...
Or not!You have collected all the Data Cards!
Wonderful!You are a true Pokéathlete,
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!Please continue to work on breaking
your own records!Thank you for coming!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00063
lines.text: So they have ten events?\n...Which Pokémon should I choose?

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00064
lines.text: There are five Pokéathlon courses!\rThey are divided into Speed, Power,\nStamina, Jump, and Skill.\rYou have to choose your Pokémon\ncarefully according to the course.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00065
lines.text: Some Pokémon are good at Speed events.\nSome are not. You need to form a team\fwhose members can help one another.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00066
lines.text: If you go on, you’ll see the\nMuseum of Pokéathlete Records.\rI will someday be a Pokéathlete holding\na record there!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00067
lines.text: The score you achieve in the Pokéathlon\nwill become Athlete Points, and you can\fexchange them for prizes.\rYou may be the last team to finish, but\nyour score will still count!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00068
lines.text: “Hurdle Dash”\rMany Hurdles await your Pokémon!\nBe faster and more precise than\feveryone else! Jump over the Hurdles\fand aim for number one!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00069
lines.text: “Pennant Capture”\rPennants are hidden on the beach.\nFight over them and come back with as\fmany Pennants as you can!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00070
lines.text: “Circle Push”\rThe time has come to show off your\nPokémon’s Power!\fPush them away and stay in the Circle!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00071
lines.text: “Block Smash”\rA mountain of Blocks awaits\nyour Pokémon!\fUse its Power to smash them all!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00072
lines.text: “Disc Catch”\rDiscs are thrown at you. Jump and\ncatch them in the air!\rDon’t get cornered by others.\nCatch as many as you can!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00073
lines.text: “Lamp Jump”\rYou never know how high you’re going\nto bounce! Use your Pokémon’s Jump\fand Skill to score!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00074
lines.text: “Relay Run”\rKeep running until you can’t run\nany more! Three Pokémon work together\fto achieve victory!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00075
lines.text: “Ring Drop”\rPokémon tackle! Go beyond your Stamina\nlimit and stay in the Ring!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00076
lines.text: “Snow Throw”\rOn an incredibly cold playfield,\nmillions of balls of Snow await!\rAim and throw!\nTime it right to show your skill!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00077
lines.text: “Goal Roll”\rPut your heart into hitting the ball!\nAttack! Defend your Goal!\rAim for the other Goals!\nWho gets the victory?

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00078
lines.text: Work with your Pokémon. Believe in them,\nand help them believe in you! Believe in\ftheir potential. Let the friendship lead\fyour team to victory!\rThe Pokéathlon is always with you!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00079
lines.text: Charge your energy with friendship!\nGive Aprijuice to your Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00080
lines.text: Whitney: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! Are you here\nfor the Pokéathlon? Me, too!\rI have been so excited since its\nconstruction. It is close to Goldenrod\fCity, you know?\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00081
lines.text:
Huh?Were you going to participate in
the Pokéathlon looking like that?You’re not prepared at all, are you?So...
Are you a medium or a small? You look more like a medium...OK!
I’ll get you a jersey that suits you!You want to look your best if you’re
going to participate in the Pokéathlon, don’t you?Wait right there!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00082
lines.text: This is just right for you!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00083
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received a jersey!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00084
lines.text:
You look perfect.
Now that you are ready, I will...Oh, no!
Where are my Pokémon?I have to go back.
See ya!

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00085
lines.text: The vending machine is for participants!\nYou can even use your\fAthlete Points. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00086
lines.text: Which drink would you like? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00087
lines.text: Clang!\rA can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0} dropped down.\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00088
lines.text: Clang!\rBonus! Another can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}\ndropped down.\r

lines.text: Not enough money...

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00090
lines.text: Not enough points...

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00091

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00102
lines.text: Welcome to the Museum Shop!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00103
lines.text: Wow, you have such good eyes! Can\nI tell you about my last dream? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00104
lines.text: Hmmm... My discerning eyes must have\nbecome weak...

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00105
lines.text:
I used to love Jump events.The record I have from when I was fully
active as a Pokéathlete is 998 jumps!Just two more!
All I had to make was two more!I had to retire due to my age...
Could I ask you to jump 1,000 times for me?

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00106
lines.text: Well, the record may make you dizzy.\nBut you’re still young.\fYou can do it!\rI’ll just sit and wait.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00107
lines.text: Oh! You!\nIt is so wonderful of you!\fYou have jumped 1,000 times.\rThank you so much!\nThis is just a token of my appreciation.\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00108
lines.text: I’m now your fan. I’m old as you see,\nbut I will support you no matter what.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00109
lines.text: You know what?\nI have tackled over 500 times finally!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00110
lines.text: Haha!\nYou’re doing fine, but not as good\fas me. I wonder if any Pokéathlete\fcould be better at tackling than me.\fSigh...

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00111
lines.text: You know what?\nI have tackled over 1,000 times!\fFinally!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00112
lines.text: You know what? I’ve finally tackled\nover 2,000 times! I bet no one can\fbreak this record easily!\r

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00113
lines.text:
......!
No! That’s not right! Your record beats mine?Nooooo!
...OK. You win.I admit complete defeat.
Please take this.

lines.label: msg_0138_D49R0101_00114
lines.text:
Whew!
It’s strange, but I feel great.I do regret that I lost, but it made
me know where I am.I understand that there are many
Pokéathletes better than me.This is where I begin to grow again!
Keep up the good work!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00000
lines.text:
Young Pokéathlete!
Hello!...Running out of energy?
Hello, again!Good!
My name is Maximo!I am the Pokéathlon MC!
Nice to meet you!I’ll be there for you when you
need to know anything about the Pokéathlon.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00001
lines.text: Maximo: Hello!\rI’ll be there for you when you\nneed to know anything about\fthe Pokéathlon.\r

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00002
lines.text: Do you have any questions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00003
lines.text: Which course do you want to\nknow about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00004
lines.text: Which event do you want to\nknow about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00005
lines.text:
Let me explain the Pokéathlon!It’s the connection between Pokémon
and Pokéathletes.It is friendship itself!
...What?You don’t get it?
OK. I won’t be as brief this time.You are to form a team of three
Pokémon to compete in ten different events!The friendship between Pokémon and
Pokéathletes is tested!That is what we call friendship!
Do you understand what I mean?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00006
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Hurdle Dash” for you.
It is an event to test your speed.Your Pokémon needs to jump
when the Hurdle comes near.If it jumps at the right time,
it will go over the Hurdle!The total time of the three Pokémon
gives you the event score.This is an event for speedy Pokémon
that move quickly like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00007
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Pennant Capture”
for you.Your Pokémon grab Pennants on
the beach.Grabbing Pennants doesn’t add to
your score.You have to come back with
the Pennants.This is an event for speedy and skillful
Pokémon that move like I do!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00008
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Circle Push” for you.
Your Pokémon push others to try and stay in a Circle.You will get points as long as your
Pokémon stay in a Circle.The total time of the three Pokémon
gives your score.This is an event for powerful Pokémon
with stamina that are strong like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00009
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Block Smash” for you.
You smash Blocks as the name suggests.The number of Blocks you smash
will be the score you’ll get.It’s so simple, isn’t it?This is an event for powerful Pokémon
that are strong like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00010
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Disc Catch” for you.
Your Pokémon jump and catch Discs that come flying toward them.The longer you wait before they catch
the Discs, the more points you get. The total points will decide the score.This is an event for powerful and jumpy
Pokémon that move like me!Do you understand what I mean?
OK, do you have any other questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00011
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Lamp Jump” for you.
Your Pokémon bounce to jump high and touch as many Lamps as they can.The more Lamps they touch, the more
points you get.The total points will decide the score.This is an event for jumpy Pokémon
that are jumpy like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00012
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Relay Run” for you.
Your Pokémon run in turns as far as they can in 90 seconds.The distance of the Relay will decide
the score.This is an event for speedy Pokémon
with stamina... Ones just like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00013
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Ring Drop” for you.
Your Pokémon try to knock other Pokémon out of the Ring.A tackle gives you one point.
A stomp on another Pokémon gives you two points.If your Pokémon knock another Pokémon
off the Ring, making them drop, you get ten points.This is an event for Pokémon with
stamina just like I have!Do you understand what I mean?
OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00014
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Snow Throw” for you.
Snow Throw may not ring a bell but... how about a Snowball fight?The more your Pokémon hit other
Pokémon with Snow, the higher the score will be.This is an event for powerful and
skillful Pokémon... Ones just like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00015
lines.text:
I’ll explain “Goal Roll” for you.
Your Pokémon try to roll the ball into the Goals of the other Pokémon teams.Most balls will give you one point.Gold-colored balls will give you
two points.The number of points will decide
your rank, and that decides the score.This is an event for powerful and
skillful Pokémon... Ones just like me!Do you understand what I mean?OK, do you have any more questions?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00016
lines.text: Young Pokéathlete!\rDon’t forget to do your Pokéathlon\nstretches before exercise!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00017
lines.text:
Me? Are you interested in me?
Hahaha! Oh, don’t be shy.Some people call me the “big brother”!But really, the big brother is...
... ... my twin brother!The “big brother,” as they say, is
really the younger brother.So this “big brother” has a
bigger brother...Do you get what I mean?

lines.text: RATTATA: Ratta.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00019
lines.text: RATTATA: Grrrr.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00024
lines.text: The Pokéathlon is all about scores.\rNo one knows who’s going to win\nuntil the last moment!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00025
lines.text:
Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} is
always splendid!I can’t take my eyes off
that Pokéathlete!...
Wait... Wow! Is that really you?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00026
lines.text: Aprijuice for victory!\rYour Pokémon can show their\ntrue Performance potential!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00027
lines.text: Aprijuice for victory!\rWhat drink do you use,\nPokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?\rI’ll buy what you buy!\fI’m a big fan!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00028
lines.text: Er... I...I will try to win at every\ncourse with MAGIKARP!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00029
lines.text: Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rEr... How...how can I win at every\ncourse with MAGIKARP?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00030
lines.text: I will break my personal record\nat Hurdle Dash!\rOK, which Pokémon should\nI choose...?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00031
lines.text: Y-y-you’re Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI have no clue how I could possibly\nreach where you are!\fYou are the Pokéathlon itself!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00032
lines.text: Wow!\nThat guy over there is Magnus,\fthe Pokéathlon owner!\rI heard he once beat a MACHAMP at\narm wrestling. Could it be true?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00033
lines.text: Yikes!\nPokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI am a huge fan of yours!\nOh my...what should I do?\fCan you give me an autograph?

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00034
lines.text: Arrgh!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00035
lines.text: Arrgh!\nPokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rYou make me feel young again!\fI’ll root for you!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00036
lines.text: Yeek!!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00037
lines.text: Oh my!\nIt’s Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rYou look just like my son.\fI’m rooting for you.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00038
lines.text: Oh my!\nIt’s Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rYou look just like my daughter.\fI’m rooting for you.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00039
lines.text: My boyfriend’s a Pokéathlete.\rBut he’s so shy about it that I root\nfor him behind a column so he won’t\fspot me!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00040
lines.text: Don’t you think he’s so cool dripping\nsweat just like his Pokémon?\rNot that he even compares to the great\nPokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, though.

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00041
lines.text: Participate in the Pokéathlon to\nreduce stress.\fThat’s the way to go!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00042
lines.text: Don’t you dare underestimate your mom.\nThe look on her face when she was\fselling things at a bargain...\rIt still gives me shivers!\r

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00043
lines.text: Every father longs to be a hero to\ntheir son.\rThe Pokéathlon...\nDo I want to take it up?\rJust you wait and see, Son!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00044
lines.text: Ahh... My son!\nI’m so sad to hear that.\rLet me hear you say you want to be\nlike your dad...\r

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00045
lines.text: My mom will finally participate.\rI was starting to worry because she\nnever exercises.\r

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00046
lines.text: I’ll grow up to be a great\nPokéathlete like you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00047
lines.text: I’m cheering for you!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00048
lines.text: Are you Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?\rFor real?\nI can’t believe it!\n

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00049
lines.text: I’m watching intently!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00050
lines.text: Are you Pokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?\rTap... Tap... Tap...\rI can’t believe it! I touched my hero!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00051
lines.text: I didn’t expect so many rather old\nladies like me participating.\fMaybe I can join them.\rIt may be a chance to get close to\nmy hero--Pokéathlete Jet!\fHahaha!

lines.label: msg_0139_D49R0102_00052
lines.text: Yeek!!\rPokéathlete {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nEvery time you are in the game,\fmy daughters’ eyes stay wide open!\rCould I ask for an autograph?\f...No no!\rNot for me. It’s for my daughters.\nHa ha!

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00000
lines.text: This is the “Solidarity” room.\rIt is to show the solidarity of Pokémon\nand people, as well as the history\fof the Pokéathlon.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00001
lines.text: Only the Pokéathletes who have\ncome in first in five of the courses\fare allowed here.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00002
lines.text: This is the “Trust” room.\nPlease go ahead.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00003
lines.text: The Pokéathlon does go way back.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00004
lines.text: When you win a course,\nyou receive a Medal!\fI’ve got to win at every course!\r

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00005
lines.text: I heard that Pokéathletes with great\nrecords are going to have their shoes\fdisplayed at the museum!

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} checked\nthe course record!\r

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00007
lines.text: It is an old wall painting.\rOne person and three Pokémon\nseem to be learning something\ffrom looking up at the sky.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00008
lines.text: It is an old, worn scroll.\r“Pokéathlon Myth\rWhen a disease took over the entire\nisland, one human and three Pokémon\fovercame ten obstacles to spread the\fword about the cure.”

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00009
lines.text: It’s an old scroll.\r“The Beginning of Pokéathlon\rTo commemorate the friendship of the\nperson and three Pokémon that\fconveyed the words of the cure, people\fstarted to tell of their achievement.”\r...\nThe commemorating eventually took the\fform of ten games to compete in, just\flike the obstacles in the legend...”

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00010
lines.text: RATTATA: Ffft!

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00011
lines.text: RATTATA: Kooar!

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00012
lines.text: ZUBAT: Quuooh.

lines.label: msg_0140_D49R0104_00013
lines.text: “Pokéathlon Almanac”\rThere are many Pokéathletes and\nPokémon Medalists shown in\fthe photos.\n

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00000
lines.text: This is the “Trust” room.\rIt is to show the mutual reliance\nbetween Pokémon and people.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00001
lines.text: Only the Pokéathletes who have\ncome first in five courses with\fone Pokémon are allowed here.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00002
lines.text: This is the “Potential” room.\nPlease go ahead.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00003
lines.text: To win Medals with different kinds of\nPokémon, it is essential to believe in\fyour Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00004
lines.text: I would love to see my own shoes here!

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00005
lines.text: This Dome contains so many\nother Domes...

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} checked the Medal!\r

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00007
lines.text: Those who have participated in the\nPokéathlon 50 times are commemorated\fhere for their never-yielding spirits.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00008
lines.text: It’s your jersey with\nyour autograph!

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00009
lines.text: Those who have dashed 5,000 times\nare commemorated here for their\fachievement in breaking the\flegendary record.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00010
lines.text: Cool shoes!\nAnd they’re your model!

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00011
lines.text: Those who have switched 200 times\nare commemorated here for great\fteamwork and their bond with\ftheir Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00012
lines.text: It’s a cool flag!\nAnd it’s yours!

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00013
lines.text: Pokéathlon Medals...\rThose are the proof of the hard work\nof both Pokéathletes and Pokémon.\rThose Pokémon that have won all five\nMedals are called “Medalist Pokémon”\fto commemorate the trust they’ve\fearned from their Pokéathlete.

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00014
lines.text: ABRA: ...\n...\f...\rIt must be asleep!

lines.label: msg_0141_D49R0105_00015
lines.text: DRATINI: Achoo!

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00000
lines.text: This is the “Potential” room.\nIt is to show the infinite potential\fof both Pokémon and people.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00001
lines.text: Only the Pokéathletes who have held\nthe best record in every event\fare allowed here.\rContinue your hard work toward\nbreaking every record there is.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00002
lines.text: This is the “Friendship” room.\nPlease go ahead.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00003
lines.text:
You are quite a Pokéathlete to
come here!But you still have a long way
to become the Top Pokéathlete.Shall I show you some special
techniques? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00004
lines.text: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nDo you have anything else\fyou want to know about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00005
lines.text: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nDo you have anything else\fyou want to know about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00006
lines.text: About which course? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00007
lines.text: Which event would you\nlike to know about? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00008
lines.text: In Hurdle Dash, timing is everything.\rYour Pokémon will pick up speed\nif you let them wait until the last\fmoment before they jump the Hurdles.\r

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00009
lines.text: Pennant Capture...\rThis event is not only about the\nPennants on the beach, but also\fthe ones other Pokémon have collected.\rIf you bump into them from behind,\nthey will be knocked down and your\fPokémon will grab their Pennants.\rThat’s the way experts fight.\r

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00010
lines.text:
The key is to push other Pokémon out
of the Circles...which may be obvious.Actually, your Pokémon can push harder
if you pick the right moment to tell them to push.So you might be able to push back
powerful Pokémon if you give frequent instructions to push.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00011
lines.text:
Block Smash is not just about smashing.Did you ever notice that sometimes
there are small cracks in the Blocks?Well, if you can hit those cracks,
they break real fast!If you can aim at cracks in a row,
your Pokémon will feel great and they’ll show great potential.One more thing...When you make them switch,
flick your Pokémon upwards for a quicker switch.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00012
lines.text: Disc Catch is about how long you can\nwait until you catch the Discs.\rBird Pokémon can move around in the\nair, so it’ll be easier to catch Discs\fif you form a team of bird Pokémon.\r

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00013
lines.text: Lamp Jump is not only about jumping.\rThere are three Pokémon bouncing\ntogether, so one Pokémon can’t jump\fwell if another comes down right when\fthe other wants to go up in the air.\rLetting them jump at the right time\nis the key.\r

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00014
lines.text:
Relay Run requires well-timed switching.Did you notice that Pokémon start to
sweat a little when they become tired?It also indicates they have slowed down
a lot.You shouldn’t allow them to sweat.Switching before they start to sweat,
that is the key.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00015
lines.text:
It’s not easy to aim for the top
by just tackling a lot in Ring Drop. Do you know what a “Body Attack” is?I call it a Body Attack, anyway...Your Pokémon can actually jump
as it moves forward.If you can let your Pokémon
Body Attack others, you can drop them off the Ring altogether!

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00016
lines.text:
Snow Throw is not just about smashing.Are you making sure the Snowballs
are big?Bigger Snowballs have a better
chance of making other Pokémon fall down.You can also block other Snowballs
from hitting your Pokémon by having your Pokémon hold on to some Snowballs.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00017
lines.text:
Goal Roll requires the skills of
a Pokéathlete.The situation changes every second,
but stay calm as you instruct your Pokémon.Positioning is key.I recommend keeping one at your own
Goal to protect it--one in the middle of the field for flexibility and one in front of the Goal you want to roll the ball into.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00018
lines.text: I hope you’ll become a Top Pokéathlete.\nGood luck!

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00019
lines.text: Those who have won at the Pokéathlon\n100 times are commemorated here for\ftheir achievement of creating the new,\flegendary record.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00020
lines.text: It is a cool Pokégear to commemorate\nyour 100th victory in the Pokéathlon.\rThat is your model!\nIt is a special Pokégear with\fthe Pokéathlon logo in the back.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00021
lines.text: Those Pokéathletes who have come in\nfirst in every event at the Pokéathlon\f50 times are commemorated here for\ftheir overwhelming might and the\farrival of a new legend.

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00022
lines.text: It’s an awesome Poké Ball to\ncommemorate your 50th victory\fin every Pokéathlon event.\rIt’s your model Poké Ball!\nThe engraving reads, “Stay on Top.”

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00023
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} checked\nthe event records.\r

lines.label: msg_0142_D49R0106_00024
lines.text: DODRIO: Keewn!

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00000
lines.text: Magnus: Oh, gosh!\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00001
lines.text: You are...!\nIt is indeed you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rOutstanding!\nQuite an achievement for you\fto come up here, bud!\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00002
lines.text: This is the “Friendship” room.\rIt was built to commemorate the\nsolidarity, trust, and potential\fof Pokémon and people and\fto hope for the eternal friendship\fbetween Pokémon and people.\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00003
lines.text: Congratulations!\rThis room is only for those true\nPokéathletes who have earned\freal friendships with Pokémon!\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nYou are a true Pokéathlete, bud!\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00004
lines.text: Having said that...\nthis is also the moment\fof a new beginning...\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00005
lines.text: That’s right, bud!\nYou have just heard a new starting\fsignal. Your challenge continues\ffor a whole new height and to become\fthe legendary Pokéathlete!\rTake a look at this statue.\nYou may be looking at your goal...\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00006
lines.text:
Magnus: This is the “Friendship” room.
It is the last of all. It’s the room where eternal friendship between people and Pokémon is pledged....But this is not your goal, bud.Each room has Trophies to earn,
but you can aim for any new height.It is entirely up to you whether
you get there or not...That’s right!Your true goal is not something
anyone else can decide for you, bud.{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
You can overcome any difficulties with your friendship with your Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00007
lines.text: It’s your statue!\r

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00008
lines.text: The statue of the Pokémon\nyou’ve shared your journey\fwith, helping each other and\fcultivating your friendship!

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00009
lines.text: It is the statue of a Medalist Pokémon.\rDo you want to replace it with another?

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00010
lines.text: You can place a statue of a\nMedalist Pokémon that has\fearned five medals.\rDo you want to place a statue?

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00011
lines.text: It is the statue of a Medalist Pokémon.\rDo you want to replace it with another?

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00012
lines.text: You can place a statue of a\nMedalist Pokémon that has\fearned five medals.\rDo you want to place a statue?

lines.label: msg_0143_D49R0107_00013
lines.text: It is the statue of a Medalist Pokémon.\rDo you want to replace it with another?

lines.label: msg_0144_D50R0101_00000
lines.text: If you see a fork in the road inside\na cave, most likely one way is right and\fthe other leads to a dead end.\fBut people can’t help trying both.\rDo you want to go up the ladder\nor go down the ladder?

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00000
lines.text: Well, hello!\rIt’s so freezing, isn’t it?\rFor a youngster like you to be\ninterested in the Sinjoh Ruins is\fnot something we see every day.\rTake a look at them.\rFrom the design of the pillars at the\nSinjoh Ruins, you can see that the\fcultures of Sinnoh and Johto\fhave blended.\r

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00001
lines.text: What was I thinking?\rWe don’t need to be standing here.\nWhy don’t you come to the cabin\faround the corner for more discussion?\r

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00002
lines.text:
By the way, we happen to have a person
at the cabin.Any Trainer should know who she is.
The famous Trainer from Sinnoh!She is traveling around to study
myths and ancient ruins. Isn’t that something?

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00004
lines.text: Cynthia: Bring your ARCEUS only.\rOther Pokémon may get blown away by\nthe strong power lingering at\fthe ruins.\r

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00005
lines.text:
Cynthia: It seems your ARCEUS is
resonating in harmony with the Ruins.It might just be me but I can
feel that... we are surrounded by strong power.The answer lies inside the ruins.The place that has been waiting for
its rightful owner, the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}...

lines.label: msg_0145_D51R0101_00007
lines.text: The Sinjoh Ruins

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00000
lines.text:
Cynthia: This is the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}. The
mythical stage built to show respect for ARCEUS.It is said that people used to
celebrate its magnificent might with music and dance.Some people in Johto still pass down
this tradition.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00001
lines.text:
Cynthia: This is the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}. The
mythical stage built to show respect for ARCEUS.It is said that people used to
celebrate its magnificent might with music and dance.Some people in Johto still pass down
this tradition.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00002
lines.text: Cynthia: The {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0} allows a\nsingle ARCEUS and nothing else to\fget on the stage...\rIf you wish to go up there, you have\nto deposit your other Pokémon in\fa PC Box at the cabin.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00003
lines.text: Cynthia: Bring your ARCEUS instead.\rAny other Pokémon may get blown away\nby the strong power lingering\fat the ruins.\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00004
lines.text: Cynthia: This is where one might say,\n“The lead enters the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}\fat last.”\rAll my study of ruins and Pokémon\nmythology in Sinnoh may have been\fto bring you up on this stage\fhere today...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00005
lines.text: Cynthia: Depicted on the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}\nare the Pokémon that shaped\fthis world.\rThe circle in the middle is ARCEUS,\nthe origin of it all...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00006
lines.text: Cynthia: According to an ancient\ndocument, time, space, and antimatter,\for what combined we call the world,\fshall be born when ARCEUS stands\fon the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}.\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00007
lines.text: Cynthia: This is the pattern that\nrepresents PALKIA, the master of\fspace and dimensions...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00008
lines.text: Cynthia: This is the pattern that\nrepresents DIALGA, the guardian\fof time...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00009
lines.text: Cynthia: This is the pattern that\nrepresents GIRATINA, the ruler of\fthe world that is on the opposite side\fof ours, the world of antimatter...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00010
lines.text:
Cynthia: ARCEUS has accepted you as
a Trainer.ARCEUS, having shaped the world,
is said to show you a glimpse of its true power.The power of possibly making life
appear out of nothing...

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00011
lines.text: Cynthia: It seems that something\nwill happen when you choose one\fof the circles...\rYou’ll want to be well prepared.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00012
lines.text: Cynthia: Once you are ready, choose a\ncircle and stand in the middle of it.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00013
lines.text: Cynthia: So you choose DIALGA,\nthe guardian of time? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00014
lines.text: Cynthia: So you choose PALKIA, the\nmaster of space and dimensions? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00015
lines.text: Cynthia: So you choose GIRATINA,\nthe ruler of the Distortion World? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00016
lines.text: Cynthia: That shining sphere...\nCould it be...an Egg?\rDid we just witness the very moment\nan Egg was brought to this world?\fA moment no one has ever seen?\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00017
lines.text:
Cynthia: An Egg is the cradle of every
being. This planet itself is an Egg in a sense...Life that comes from an Egg will
come to an end in due course... to begin anew...That may be what ARCEUS
wanted to show us.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00018
lines.text: Cynthia: That was...?\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00019
lines.text: Cynthia: We seem to be surrounded by\nthat strong power again...!\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00020
lines.text: Cynthia: Of course... ARCEUS!\rSo the source of the power I’ve felt\nwas ARCEUS!\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00021
lines.text: Cynthia: What is now the {COLOR 1}Sinjoh Ruins\n{COLOR 0}was built to honor ARCEUS by the\fSinnoh people...\rIt’s an icebound temple that has been\nwaiting for ARCEUS for hundreds\fof years...\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00022
lines.text: Cynthia: This is the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}.\rIt is designed to bring out the power\nARCEUS possesses.\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00023
lines.text: Cynthia: ARCEUS is described in\nmythology as being the origin of\feverything and the source of\fall beings.\rIt is said that the power of ARCEUS\nis released on the {COLOR 1}Mystri Stage{COLOR 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00024
lines.text: Cynthia: The {COLOR 1}Sinjoh Ruins{COLOR 0} are what\nremains of a temple built to show\frespect for ARCEUS.

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00025
lines.text: The mysterious round object\ntook the shape of a Pokémon!\r

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00026
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} obtained\nthe {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0}!

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00027
lines.text: Will you choose DIALGA? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00028
lines.text: Will you choose PALKIA? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00029
lines.text: Will you choose GIRATINA? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00030
lines.text: This place does not seem to respond...

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00031
lines.text: It seems that only a single ARCEUS\ncan stand here...

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00032
lines.text: Would you like to give a nickname\nto the {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0}? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0146_D51R0201_00033
lines.text: It seems it no longer responds\nto this ARCEUS...

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00000
lines.text:
Cynthia: My name is Cynthia.
I am a Pokémon Trainer.The {COLOR 1}Sinjoh Ruins{COLOR 0} remind me of Sinnoh,
where I come from.Initially, I thought it was because
it snows a lot here as well.But that was not it.A long time ago...people came from
Sinnoh to live here.They must have built a temple here
while longing for home.That’s why we call these the
{COLOR 1}Sinjoh Ruins{COLOR 0}...

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00001
lines.text: Cynthia: You are...\fa Pokémon Trainer?\rI can sense strong power coming\nfrom your Poké Ball...\r

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00002
lines.text:
Cynthia: I wouldn’t assume you managed
to get here by yourself.This is a heavy-snowfall area where
the snowbound land freezes you to the core...Talk to the old man if you wish to go
back. ABRA should be able to take you where you come from.

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00003
lines.text: Cynthia: I feel a familiar presence...\nThe power of DIALGA...\fPALKIA...\for could it be GIRATINA?\rIt’s similar, but not quite the same...\r

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00004
lines.text: Cynthia: Have you got time?\rCan you come to the {COLOR 1}Sinjoh Ruins{COLOR 0}\nwith me?\rCall it a Trainer’s intuition.\rWhen you and your Pokémon step onto\nthat stage, something will happen.\r

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00006
lines.text:
Cynthia: The snowbound ruins make
me wonder...Time and space change, and we with
them. We leave some things behind and give each other company...Sinnoh, Johto...
When you feel you’re close to understanding the whole world, you are merely drowning in your own miniscule perception.

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00007
lines.text:
A long time ago, people used to draw
life from Pokémon and also give their lives to those Pokémon...That shows that people and Pokémon
used to be more closely bonded with each other.When people moved from place to place,
the myths and legends of Pokémon and their power would also be carried with those people.That’s how myths and legends from each
region are blended with each other.The ancient ruins here have inherited
the legends from both the {COLOR 1}Ruins of Alph{COLOR 0} in Johto and the {COLOR 1}Spear Pillar{COLOR 0} in Sinnoh.That is proof that people from Johto
and Sinnoh blended together as a group.

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00008
lines.text:
ARCEUS is said to have come out of
an Egg.Johto people believe that Pokémon Eggs
are the vessels of life, and thus something astounding.Places far from each other can share
similar myths and legends...That’s quite interesting, isn’t it?

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00009
lines.text: Well, hello!\nWe meet again!\rCynthia has gone back to Sinnoh.\fShe is the Sinnoh League Champion.\rShe studies various ruins despite her\ntight schedule.\rHow wonderful she is!

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00010
lines.text: You seem so out of place, not even\nknowing why you are here.\rDo you want my ABRA to use a\nspecial power to take you home? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00011
lines.text: OK. OK.\nPicture your house in your mind...\r

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00012
lines.text: OK... OK...\nThe best of luck to you!

lines.label: msg_0147_D51R0301_00013
lines.text: ABRA: Aabra...

lines.label: msg_0148_D52R0101_00000
lines.text: GROUDON: Grrgggrrrrah!\r

lines.label: msg_0148_D52R0101_00001
lines.text: GROUDON disappeared...

lines.label: msg_0148_D52R0101_00002
lines.text:
Well, hello!
That was something you don’t see every day!That Pokémon is GROUDON,
a legendary Pokémon in the Hoenn myth about the shaping of that region.I see...The Embedded Tower was built
by the people from Hoenn.

lines.label: msg_0148_D52R0101_00003
lines.text:
The Tower that binds together
the sea, the land, and the sky...GROUDON was not the only Pokémon
described in the Hoenn myth...This place may still be hiding
its secrets...

lines.label: msg_0148_D52R0101_00004
lines.text: The knowledgeable Pokémon Professor\nmay be able to tell you more when you\fshow him GROUDON.\rPhew!\rThere are so many connections between\nPokémon and myths.\rSee you around.\r

lines.label: msg_0149_D52R0102_00000
lines.text: KYOGRE: Gyararoooah!\r

lines.label: msg_0149_D52R0102_00001
lines.text: KYOGRE disappeared...

lines.label: msg_0149_D52R0102_00002
lines.text:
Well, hello!
That was something you don’t see every day!That Pokémon is KYOGRE,
a legendary Pokémon in the Hoenn myth about the shaping of that region.I see... I see.The Embedded Tower was built
by the people from Hoenn.

lines.label: msg_0149_D52R0102_00003
lines.text:
The Tower that binds together
the sea, the land, and the sky...KYOGRE was not the only Pokémon
described in the Hoenn myth...This place may still be hiding
its secrets.

lines.label: msg_0149_D52R0102_00004
lines.text: The knowledgeable Pokémon Professor\nmay be able to tell you more when you\fshow him KYOGRE.\rPhew!\rThere are so many connections between\nPokémon and myths.\rSee you around.\r

lines.label: msg_0259_P01R0301_00007
lines.text: Whoa! Excuse me. I was in a hurry!\rMy granddaughter is missing!\rShe’s just a wee girl. If you see\nher, please let me know!\r

lines.text: Here’s your cabin.\rIf your Pokémon are hurt, take a\nnap in the bed.\fThat will heal them.

lines.label: msg_0259_P01R0301_00010
lines.text: Most passengers are Trainers.\rThey’re all itching to battle in\ntheir cabins.

lines.text: Captain, play with me, please?\rI’m bored! I want to play more!\r

lines.text: This little girl keeps asking me to play\nwith her.\rOuch! Please don’t stretch my ear!

lines.label: msg_0260_P01R0302_00005
lines.text:
Thank you for playing with her.You may think being a Captain
is a somewhat easy job, but it’s actually quite demanding.That little passenger has gone out
of the room.She can’t get off the ship, so she
must be hiding somewhere around here.

lines.label: msg_0260_P01R0302_00006
lines.text: How do you like S.S. Aqua’s ride?\rShe practically skates across\nthe waves.

lines.label: msg_0260_P01R0302_00007
lines.text:
Long time no see.
How are you doing?The S.S. Aqua is as smooth as she
can be!By the way, I found this mysterious
thing when I went to Sinnoh the other day.Now that we’ve met again,
I would like you to have it.

lines.label: msg_0260_P01R0302_00008
lines.text: Your Bag is full.\rYou must like the {STRVAR_1 8, 1, 0} a lot.

lines.label: msg_0261_P01R0303_00004
lines.text: Zzz... Zzz...\rWh-what?\nI’m awake, of course...\rZzz... Zzz...

lines.text:
What? You’re saying I was asleep?
Show some respect!A crewman on duty would never
be so unmindful as to take a nap in a place like this!I resent your implication!
I challenge you!

lines.label: msg_0261_P01R0303_00006
lines.text: Losing to you has woken me up.\nI will mend my ways and work hard.\rCan you keep it a secret that I was\ntaking a nap here?\fPlease don’t tell the Captain.\r

lines.label: msg_0262_P01R0306_00000
lines.text: I see.\rSo you are playing hide-and-seek\nwih my granddaughter.\rI guess there is no need to worry\nas long as she’s on the ship!

lines.text: Oh, hello...\rMy granddaughter is still missing.\nIf she’s on the ship, that’s OK.\rShe’s an energetic child, so she may be\nbothering someone. That worries me...

You may meet people on the second
floor of a Pokémon Center for trades or Colosseum battles.You may register such people as
friends in your Pal Pad.You may also manually register friends
by entering their Friend Codes into your Pal Pad.Would you like me to repeat that? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0312_00012
lines.text: The Pokéathlon is a sports festival in\nwhich you and three Pokémon compete in\fthree events.\rThe Pokéathlon has a variety of events\nto accommodate different aspects\fof Pokémon.\rPlease come join us with three Pokémon!\r

lines.label: msg_0312_00013
lines.text:
The Supreme Cup is a special course
only for the top Pokéathletes from all over the world.You will earn more points than usual
when you win a Supreme Cup!Please, challenge the
top Pokéathletes!

lines.label: msg_0312_00014
lines.text:
The Speed Course consists of three
events that require good Speed Performance.“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles to be number one!“Pennant Capture”
Capture Pennants quickly!“Relay Run”
Show your teamwork!When you win, you will be awarded
the Speed Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Speed
for these events.

lines.label: msg_0312_00015
lines.text:
The Power Course consists of three
events that require good Power Performance.“Block Smash”
Smash all the Blocks!“Circle Push”
Push them out while you stay in!“Goal Roll”
Drive them out and roll the balls toward the Goal!When you win, you will be awarded
the Power Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Power
for these events.

lines.label: msg_0312_00016
lines.text:
The Stamina Course consists of three
events that require good Stamina Performance.“Ring Drop”
Blow them away and stay on the Ring!“Relay Run”
The Stamina of all three is key!“Block Smash” Smash away as long as your
Stamina holds!When you win, you will be awarded
the Stamina Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Stamina
for these events.

lines.label: msg_0312_00017
lines.text:
The Jump Course consists of three
events that require good Jump Performance.“Lamp Jump”
Jump to the sky and hit Lamps!“Disc Catch”
Jump and catch flying Discs!“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles cleanly!When you win, you will be awarded
the Jump Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Jump
for these events.

the Skill Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Skill
for these events.

lines.label: msg_0312_00037
lines.text:
Oh no! It seems like you don’t have
enough Pokémon.In order to participate in the
Pokéathlon, you need to have at least three Pokémon.The Pokéathlon brings together all
kinds of Pokémon from all over.The more, the merrier! Please, bring a
bunch of Pokémon and you’ll see.

lines.label: msg_0312_00038
lines.text:
Welcome. This is the reception for the
Link Pokéathlon.Oh, my!
This is your first time, isn’t it?If that’s true, then please head over
to the “Single” reception.If you go to the right from here, it’s
the middle counter.You can get information about the
Pokéathlon and decide on a course.

lines.label: msg_0312_00039
lines.text:
The Link Pokéathlon is a sport festival
in which you join with three of your Pokémon to compete in four events.Your friends can join the same events
to compete.The Pokéathlon has a variety of events
to accommodate many of the different aspects of Pokémon.Please bring your friends to the
Link Pokéathlon.

lines.label: msg_0312_00040
lines.text:
The Speed & Jump Course consists of
four events that require good Speed and Jump Performance.“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles to be number one!“Lamp Jump”
Take the Lamps quickly!“Disc Catch”
Catch the Discs rapidly!“Relay Run”
Superb Speed is highly required!When you win, you will be awarded
the Speed Medal and the Jump Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good
Speed and Jump for these events, and bring your friends as well.

lines.label: msg_0312_00041
lines.text:
The Jump & Skill Course consists of
four events that require good Jump and Skill Performance.“Lamp Jump”
Show your skill in jumping to touch the Lamps!“Disc Catch”
Jump and catch the Discs!“Pennant Capture”
Show your moves and collect Pennants!“Snow Throw”
Aim with accuracy!When you win, you will be awarded
the Jump Medal and the Skill Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good
Jump and Skill for these events, and bring your friends as well.

lines.label: msg_0312_00042
lines.text:
The Skill & Power Course consists of
four events that require good Skill and Power Performance.“Goal Roll”
Aim at the Goal and shoot!“Snow Throw”
Steady, aim, and fire away!“Pennant Capture”
Show your moves and collect Pennants!“Block Smash”
Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!When you win, you will be awarded
the Skill Medal and the Power Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good
Skill and Power for these events, and bring your friends as well.

lines.label: msg_0312_00043
lines.text:
The Power & Stamina Course consists
of four events that require good Power and Stamina Performance.“Block Smash”
Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!“Circle Push”
Push them away and stay in the Circle!“Goal Roll”
Keep rolling until your energy runs out!“Ring Drop”
Drop them off the Ring and stay on top!When you win, you will be awarded
the Power Medal and the Stamina Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good
Power and Stamina for these events, and bring your friends as well.

lines.label: msg_0312_00044
lines.text:
The Stamina & Speed Course consists
of four events that require good Stamina and Speed Performance.“Relay Run”
Both Stamina and Speed are key!“Ring Drop”
Drop them from high while you survive!“Hurdle Dash”
Over you go! Aim for number one!“Circle Push”
Push them away and stay in the Circle!When you win, you will be awarded
the Stamina Medal and the Speed Medal.Choose three Pokémon with good Stamina
and Speed for these events, and bring your friends as well.

lines.label: msg_0312_00045
lines.text:
The Master Course is a difficult course
that offers different events every time.Teams must do their best to get
through the course, no matter what it may be!You won’t receive any medals for a
Master Course.However, you will receive twice as many
Athlete Points.By all means, get your friends together
and give it a try.

lines.label: msg_0335_R06R0201_00000
lines.text:
Welcome to Saffron City, home of the
Magnet Train!...That’s what I’d normally say, but
the Magnet Train isn’t running now.It’s not getting any electricity
because there’s something wrong with the Power Plant.

lines.label: msg_0335_R06R0201_00001
lines.text: The Magnet Train is the most famous\nthing about Saffron.

lines.label: msg_0336_R07_00000
lines.text: There is a notice!\r...Uncouth Trainers have been holding\nbattles in the Underground Path.\rBecause of rising complaints by local\nresidents, the Underground Path has\fbeen sealed indefinitely.\f           Signed, the Celadon Police

lines.label: msg_0336_R07_00001
lines.text: It won’t open!\rIt’s locked...

lines.text: Did you hear about the accident at\nthe Power Plant?\rIt’s located in the east, close to\nLavender Town.

lines.label: msg_0337_R07R0101_00001

lines.text: A Pokémon Center near a cave?\nThat’s mighty convenient.

lines.label: msg_0342_R10PC0101_00001
lines.text: The last time I came by the Power\nPlant, I heard somebody screaming,\f“Oh no, it must be a thief!”\rI think it was the Manager’s voice.

lines.label: msg_0342_R10PC0101_00002
lines.text: I hear Team Rocket got back together\nin Johto but fell apart right away.\rI didn’t know anything about that.

lines.label: msg_0342_R10PC0101_00003
lines.text: You can’t see it from here, but there’s\na Power Plant south of this\fPokémon Center!

lines.text: Rt. 10\nRock Tunnel ahead

lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00003
lines.text: Manager: My beloved generator!\rKeep pumping the electricity out to\nprovide a pleasant life for Kanto!

lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00004
lines.text: We’ll have to beef up our security\npresence so something like this will\fnever happen again!

lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00005

lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00006
