lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00007
lines.text: Since the generator’s been fixed, the\nManager has been cheerful.

lines.label: msg_0344_R10R0201_00008

lines.text: Staff Mottos:\r1. Electricity is not infinite.\n2. Conserve wherever possible.\f3. Watch out for each other.\f4. Idle hands are not allowed.\f5. Wear shoes with rubber soles.\f6. The Manager is awesome.

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00000
lines.text: A thief broke into the Power Plant...\nWhat is the world coming to?

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00001
lines.text: I just got word from Cerulean.\nIt appears that a shady character has\fbeen loitering around.\r

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00002
lines.text: Could I ask for your cooperation?\rThe shady character was hanging around\nthe Cerulean Gym...\r

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00003
lines.text: Could I ask for your cooperation?\rThe shady character was hanging around\nthe Cerulean Gym...

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00004
lines.text: Someone made off with a part that’s\nessential for the generator.\rWithout it, the new generator’s\nuseless!

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00005
lines.text: This Power Plant had been abandoned in\nthe past.\rWe got it back up and running to provide\npower to the Magnet Train.

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00006
lines.text: The Power Plant’s Manager is up ahead.\rBut since someone wrecked the\ngenerator, he’s been both sad and,\fat times, furious...\rSometimes he would burst out laughing\nout of desperation.\fWe’ve had to go through so much...

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00007
lines.text: The Magnet Train consumes a lot\nof electricity.\rIt can’t move if the new generator\nisn’t operating.

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00008
lines.text: I collect Pokémon.\nDo you have a DUGTRIO?\rWant to trade it for my MAGNETON? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00010

lines.label: msg_0345_R10R0202_00012

lines.text:

something!Who would dare steal a part from the
generator?I spent so much time fixing it!
If I catch him, he’s going to see what I can do with my Charge Beam!

my beloved generator?You found it?
Thank you so much!Now, all I have to do is...
attach this part here...

lines.label: msg_0373_R29_00017
lines.text: Lyra: There you are!\r

lines.label: msg_0373_R29_00018
lines.text: Ethan: There you are!\r

lines.label: msg_0374_R29R0101_00000
lines.text: You can’t climb ledges.\rBut you can jump down from them to\ntake a shortcut.

lines.label: msg_0374_R29R0101_00001
lines.text: Different kinds of Pokémon appear\npast here.\rIf you want to catch them all,\nyou have to look everywhere.

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00000
lines.text: Go, RATTATA!\rTackle!\r

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00001
lines.text: What? This is a big battle!\fLeave me alone!\r

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00002
lines.text:
A Pokémon can use its moves as long
as the moves still have PP.When a move has no PP remaining, that
Pokémon cannot use that move.Then you should take your Pokémon to
the Pokémon Center.

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00003
lines.text:
A Pokémon can use its moves as long
as the moves still have PP.When a move has no PP remaining, that
Pokémon cannot use that move.Then you should take your Pokémon to
the Pokémon Center.

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00004
lines.text: I’m not a Trainer.\rBut if you look one in the eyes,\nprepare to battle.

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00005
lines.text: Hey, kiddo!\rHow in the world can you be so\noblivious to my eye-catching house?\fHold it right there!\r

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00006
lines.text:
When you follow that path up north,
you will see Mr. Pokémon’s house.But before you go, let me finish what
I have to say.Do you...have any Apricorns? Apricorn trees bear fruit once a day. I have one of those trees, too!Apricorns are really something.
You can make Poké Balls and other things.They are quite useful.I have a feeling this is meant to be,
because I have something for you!

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00008
lines.text: With that Apricorn Box, you can carry\nso many Apricorns.\rYou’ll be a decent Apricorn collector!\r

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00009
lines.text: Rt. 30\nSouth to Cherrygrove City

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00010
lines.text: Mr. Pokémon’s House\nStraight Ahead!

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00011
lines.text: Mr. Pokémon’s House

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00012
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rNo stealing other people’s Pokémon!\rPoké Balls are to be thrown only at\nwild Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0375_R30_00013
lines.text:
Oh! You’re wearing the Running Shoes.They make you feel like you are flying,
don’t they?But beware of wild Pokémon and
Trainers!When you run, the noise will
attract them.

lines.label: msg_0376_R30R0101_00000
lines.text:
People usually come to my house
looking for Mr. Pokémon’s house. You did mean to visit my house, right?How kind of you!
Do you...have any Apricorns? Apricorn trees bear fruit once a day. I have one of those trees, too!Apricorns are really something.
You can make Poké Balls and other things.They are quite useful.I have a feeling this is meant to be.
I’m so happy that I’ll give you this!

lines.label: msg_0376_R30R0101_00002
lines.text: With that Apricorn Box, you can carry\nso many Apricorns.\fYou’ll be a decent Apricorn collector!

lines.label: msg_0376_R30R0101_00003
lines.text: Hey, collector of Apricorns!\rHave you noticed that Apricorn colors\nare different from tree to tree?\rTry to remember what color Apricorn\nyou get from each tree!

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00000
lines.text: You must be {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\rIt was I who sent an email\nto Professor Elm earlier.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00001
lines.text: You must be {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\rIt was I who sent an email\nto Professor Elm earlier.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00002
lines.text: This is what I want Professor Elm\nto examine.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00003
lines.text:
A friend of mine from Ecruteak gave
it to me.I bet you can’t find this kind of
Egg in Johto.I thought Professor Elm might be able
to tell what this is.“He’s the best when it comes to the
research of Pokémon evolution.”That’s a quote from the famous
Professor Oak.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00004
lines.text: You are returning to Professor Elm?\rHere. Your Pokémon should have\nsome rest.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00005
lines.text: Sorry to trouble you, having you go\nback and forth.\rBut please make sure to hand it to\nProfessor Elm!

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00006
lines.text: Life is delightful!\nAlways, new discoveries to be made!

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00007
lines.text: Kimono Girls? What’re you talking\nabout? I don’t know such people.\fHee hee...\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00008
lines.text:
Professor Oak: And with that...I’m Professor Oak, a Pokémon
researcher!So you’re {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!I was just visiting my friend
Mr. Pokémon.I heard you were running an errand
for Professor Elm, so I waited here.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00009
lines.text:
Professor Oak: And with that...I’m Professor Oak, a Pokémon
researcher!So you’re {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!I was just visiting my friend
Mr. Pokémon.I heard you were running an errand
for Professor Elm, so I waited here.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00010
lines.text:
Professor Oak: Oh! What’s this?
A rare Pokémon!I see!
You must be helping Professor Elm’s research! I think I understand why Professor Elm gave you that Pokémon.You will treat your Pokémon with love
and care, it seems.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00011
lines.text:
Professor Oak: ...Ah!You seem to be dependable.
How would you like to help me out?See? This is the latest version of
the Pokédex.It automatically records data on
Pokémon you’ve seen or caught.It’s a high-tech encyclopedia!
I’d like you to have it.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00012
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received the Pokédex\nfrom Professor Oak!

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00013
lines.text:
Go meet many kinds of Pokémon and
complete that Pokédex! But I’ve stayed too long.I have to get to Goldenrod for my
usual radio show.{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I have a feeling that
this is not the last time we’ll meet...Let’s exchange numbers
just to be on the safe side.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00014
lines.text:
Go meet many kinds of Pokémon and
complete that Pokédex! But I’ve stayed too long.I have to get to Goldenrod for my
usual radio show.{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I have a feeling that
this is not the last time we’ll meet...Let’s exchange numbers
just to be on the safe side.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00015
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Professor Oak\nin the Pokégear!\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00016
lines.text:
Hm? That Red Scale! What’s that?
A red GYARADOS? That’s rare! I... I want it...{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, would you
care to trade it?I can offer this Exp. Share I got
from Professor Oak. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00017
lines.text:
Hm? That Red Scale! What’s that?
A red GYARADOS? That’s rare! I... I want it...{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, would you
care to trade it?I can offer this Exp. Share I got
from Professor Oak. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00019
lines.text: Arrgh, I reckon yer Bag’s full.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00020
lines.text: That’s disappointing.\nThat happens to be very rare.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00021
lines.text: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI have something I want you to have\nand was just about to send an email\fto Professor Oak.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00022
lines.text: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rI have something I want you to have\nand was just about to send an email\fto Professor Oak.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00023
lines.text: The thing is...\nA friend of mine from Hoenn\fcame over to give this to me.\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00024
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Blue Orb!\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00025
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Red Orb!\r

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00026
lines.text:
That Orb has something to do with
the ancient ruins located past Cianwood City, called the Embedded Tower.But only a handful of Trainers can
reach there...That’s where you come in.Professor Oak thinks highly of you,
and you are the proud Champion after all.I’m sure you can solve the mystery
of the Orb and the secret of the ruins.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00027
lines.text: The Embedded Tower is past Cianwood,\nsomewhere in the Cliff Cave.\rOr so I heard.\rOr so I remember.\rOr so I believe!

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00028
lines.text: It’s packed with foreign magazines.\rCan’t even read their titles...

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00029
lines.text: It’s a big computer.\nHmm. It’s broken.

lines.label: msg_0377_R30R0201_00030
lines.text: A whole pile of strange coins!\fMaybe they’re from another country...

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00000
lines.text: ...Hnuurg ...Huh?\rI walked too far today looking\nfor Pokémon.\rMy feet hurt and I’m sleepy...\rIf I were a wild Pokémon, I’d be\neasy to catch...\r...Zzzz...

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00001
lines.text: ...Hnuurg! ...Huh?\rI feel like reading some words\non a piece of paper or something...\r...Zzz...\n...!!\r

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00002
lines.text: Huh? What?\nWhat about that Pokémon?\fI don’t have any mail.\rZzz...

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00003
lines.text: This Mail isn’t for me.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00004
lines.text: Oh, hey! I got an email!\r...\nHuh?\fI don’t know this Pokémon.\fI’ll just let you take care of it.\r

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00005
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} handed over the Pokémon\nholding the Mail.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} handed over the Mail.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00007
lines.text:
Let’s see...“Thank you for your Mail.
It was such an exciting adventure.I did not like ZUBAT, though...”
That’s what it says.I went to a dark cave the other day
with a friend.That cave leads to another route.
By the way, I must thank you for being so kind.I’d like to do something good in return.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00008
lines.text: TM44 is...\n...Zzz...\f...\r...Umm... Rest!\rThe phrase “recover fast” became\nshortened to “Rest,” you see?\fThis is a move to sleep and recover HP.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00009
lines.text: ...I’m\nsleepy...

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00010
lines.text: ...Wait!\nThat would make you not have\fany Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00011
lines.text: I found a good Pokémon in Dark Cave.\nI’m going to raise it to take on\fFalkner.\rHe’s the leader of Violet City’s Gym.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00012
lines.text: Dark Cave...\rIf a Pokémon could light it up,\nI’d explore it.

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00013
lines.text: Rt. 31\nWest to Violet City

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00014
lines.text: Dark Cave

lines.label: msg_0378_R31_00015
lines.text: Huh? What is it?\nIs that a Pokémon Egg?\fI’ve never seen one.\r...Zzz...

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00000
lines.text: You must be an adventuring Trainer.\nDid you challenge the Pokémon Gym yet?

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00002
lines.text: Lyra: I knew it was you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rHow did you get past me?\nHere is something neat for\fsurprising me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00003
lines.text: Ethan: I knew it was you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rHow did you get past me?\nHere is something neat for\fsurprising me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00004
lines.text: The Vs. Recorder can record\nyour Pokémon battles.\rI have to go now!\fI won’t let you pass me again!\r

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00005
lines.text: The Vs. Recorder can record\nyour Pokémon battles.\rI have to go now!\fI won’t let you pass me again!\r

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00006
lines.text: Let’s go, MARILL!\r

lines.label: msg_0379_R31R0101_00007
lines.text: Come on, MARILL!\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00000
lines.text: Wait up!\nWhat’s the hurry?\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00001
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses was looking\ffor you.\rSee for yourself. He’s waiting for\nyou at the Poké Mart.

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses was looking\ffor you.\rSee for yourself. He’s waiting for\nyou at the Poké Mart.\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00003
lines.text: Have you gone to the Pokémon Gym?\rYou can test your Pokémon and\nyourself there.\rIt’s a rite of passage for all Trainers!

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00004
lines.text: Have you gone to the Pokémon Gym?\rYou can test your Pokémon and\nyourself there.\rIt’s a rite of passage for all Trainers!\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00005
lines.text:
You have some good Pokémon there.It must be from the training you gave
them around Violet City.The training at the Gym must have
been especially helpful.As a souvenir of Violet City, take this.It increases the power of
Grass-type moves.

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00007
lines.text: Your experiences in Violet City\nshould be useful for your journey.

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00008
lines.text: Hey, your Bag is chock-full.

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00009
lines.text: Hey, your Bag is chock-full.\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00010
lines.text: WROOOOAR!\rPEOPLE RUN WHEN I ROAR!\nBUT YOU CAME LOOKING!\rTHAT PLEASES ME!\nNOW TAKE THIS!\r

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00012
lines.text: WROOOAR!\nIT’S ROAR!\rEVEN POKéMON RUN\nFROM A GOOD ROAR!

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00013
lines.text: WROOOAR! YOUR BAG IS FULL!

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00014
lines.text: How would you like to have this\ntasty, nutritious SlowpokeTail?\rFor you right now, just $1,000,000!\nYou’ll want this! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00015
lines.text: Tch! I thought kids these days\nwere loaded...

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00016
lines.text: You don’t want it?\nThen scram. Shoo!

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00017
lines.text: Rt. 32\nSouth to Azalea Town

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00018
lines.text: Ruins of Alph\nEast Entrance

lines.label: msg_0380_R32_00019
lines.text: Union Cave ahead

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00000
lines.text: This area is great for fishing.\nLooking at all those people fishing,\fdid you feel like you wanted to try\ffishing, too?\rWould you like one of my Rods? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00003
lines.text:
When you want to go fishing,
face the water and use the Rod first.Then concentrate and look closely
at the water!An “!” appears when a Pokémon
has taken a bite!Press the A Button quickly to pull back
on the line.You’ll see what happens next.If there’s water, be it the sea or
a stream, try out your Rod.

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00004
lines.text: Oh. That’s rather disappointing...

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00005
lines.text:
When you want to go fishing,
face the water and use the Rod first.Then concentrate and look closely
at the water!An “!” appears when a Pokémon
has taken a bite!Press the A Button quickly to pull back
on the line.You’ll see what happens next.

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00006
lines.text: What should I make my Pokémon hold?\rMaybe an item that increases\nits Attack power...

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00007
lines.text: Bonjour.\nHow are you?\fAre you picking Apricorns? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00008
lines.text: Way to go, little Apricorn collector!\rI feel so great, I want to give\nyou this!\r

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00009
lines.text: How come? What a waste!\rI will show you how great\nApricorns are!\rTake this first.\r

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00010
lines.text:
Lure Ball!
This Poké Ball makes it easy to catch the Pokémon that appear when you go fishing!Actually, this is made from Apricorns.
Consider those two as small gifts from me.If you want more, go to Azalea Town.
A man called Kurt can make special Poké Balls out of Apricorns.Apricorns rule!

lines.label: msg_0381_R32PC0101_00011
lines.text: Kurt is the hero of every Apricorn\ncollector out there.\rIf you are to go to Azalea Town,\nbe sure to visit him.\rApricorn, Apricornier, Apricorniest!

lines.label: msg_0382_R32R0101_00000
lines.text: The Ruins of Alph.\nA look-and-touch tourist site.\fTry the sliding stone panels!

lines.label: msg_0382_R32R0101_00001
lines.text: You’re studying the ruins?\nI see a scientist in the making.

lines.label: msg_0382_R32R0101_00002
lines.text: There are drawings on stone panels.\nI tried moving them.\fI wonder what they are.

lines.label: msg_0383_R33_00000
lines.text: Pant, pant...\nI finally got through that cave.\rIt was much bigger than I’d expected.\nI got too tired to explore the whole\fthing, so I came outside.

lines.label: msg_0383_R33_00001
lines.text: Rt. 33\nWest to Azalea Town

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00018
lines.text: I’m on patrol for suspicious individuals.

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00019
lines.text: Irene: Who are you?!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00021
lines.text: Irene: I’ll tell my sister about you!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00022
lines.text: Irene: I’ll tell my sister about you!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00023
lines.text: Irene: How did you find this place?\fThis is our hideout!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00024
lines.text: Jenn: What the...?\nWhat are you doing?\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00026
lines.text: Jenn: Better not laugh yet.\nMy sister is really strong!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00027
lines.text: Jenn: You and us... We might as well\nbecome friends!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00028
lines.text: Kate: I must pay you back for taking\ncare of my sisters!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00030
lines.text: Kate: You are so strong.\nWe lost with no excuses...\rHere, take this!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00032
lines.text: Kate: I’m sorry we jumped you.\rWe never expected anyone to find \nus here.\fYou sure startled us.

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00033
lines.text: Rt. 34\nSouth to Azalea Town

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00034
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rNorth to Goldenrod City\nThe Radio Tower at Goldenrod is giving\faway Radio Cards.\rAnswer their questions and receive a\nRadio Card!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00035
lines.text: Pokémon Day Care\nLet us raise your Pokémon for you!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00036
lines.text: Lyra: Grandpa!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00037
lines.text: Lyra: Good work, Grandpa!\nThe Pokémon you raised for me has\fbeen as healthy as can be!\rYou look fit, too!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00038
lines.text: Lyra: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00039
lines.text:
Let me introduce you.
This is {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. He’s a Trainer.He seems to be getting better at
raising Pokémon.Well, not as good as you, Grandpa,
of course!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00040
lines.text: Follow me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00041
lines.text: Ethan: Grandpa!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00042
lines.text: Ethan: Good work, Grandpa!\nThe Pokémon you raised for me has\fbeen as healthy as can be!\rYou look fit, too!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00043
lines.text: Ethan: Hey, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00044
lines.text:
Let me introduce you.
This is {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. She’s a Trainer.She seems to be getting better at
raising Pokémon.Well, not as good as you, Grandpa,
of course!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00045
lines.text: Follow me, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00046
lines.text: I have an idea!\nI’ll give you our numbers.\rThen you can check on the Pokémon\nwe raise for you.\r

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00047
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered the\nDay-Care Man in the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00048
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered the\nDay-Care Lady in the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0384_R34_00049
lines.text: Call us from time to time when you\ngive us your Pokémon to raise.\rI’ll be happy to have a use for this\nPokégear my grandchild gave me.\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00000
lines.text: Lyra: Grandma!\rLet me introduce my friend.\nThis is {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00001
lines.text: Ah ha.\nThis is your boy...friend.\fI see. Hmm.\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00002
lines.text: Lyra: What? Grandma...!\nWhat are you talking about?\rHe just happens to live nearby...\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00003
lines.text:
Grandma: Hahaha.
I know. I know.Since you brought him here, Lyra, you
must be sure about his talent.Right, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?
Come and see us anytime!

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00004
lines.text: Lyra: Well, I better go now...\nSee ya!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00005
lines.text: Lyra: Oh! I almost forgot!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00006
lines.text: Lyra: Here!\nThis is my Pokégear number!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00007
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Lyra\nin the Pokégear!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00008
lines.text:
Lyra: You know you can talk to your
Pokémon as they follow you?They do all sorts of cute stuff on the
road and in towns.I’m taking notes every time they do
funny things.Give me a call and I’ll share some of
them with you.

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00009
lines.text: Lyra: Grandma!\rDon’t you say anything.\rWe are both Trainers, and we are\nsupposed to exchange numbers.\fThat’s all.\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00010
lines.text: Ethan: Grandma!\rLet me introduce my friend.\nThis is {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00011
lines.text: Ah ha.\nThis is your girl...friend.\fI see. Hmm.\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00012
lines.text: Ethan: What? Grandma...!\nWhat are you talking about?\rShe just happens to live nearby...\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00013
lines.text:
Hahaha.
I know. I know.Since you took her here, Ethan, you
must be sure about her talent.Right, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?
Come and see us anytime!

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00014
lines.text: Ethan: Well, I better go now...\nSee ya!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00015
lines.text: Ethan: Oh! I almost forgot!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00016
lines.text: Ethan: Here!\nThis is my Pokégear number!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00017
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Ethan\nin the Pokégear!\r

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00018
lines.text:
Ethan: You know you can talk to your
Pokémon as they follow you?They do all sorts of cute stuff on the
road and in towns.I’m taking notes every time they do
funny things.Give me a call and I’ll share some of
them with you.

lines.label: msg_0385_R34R0101_00019
lines.text: Ethan: Grandma!\rDon’t you say anything.\rWe are both Trainers, and we are\nsupposed to exchange numbers.\fThat’s all.\r

lines.label: msg_0386_R34R0201_00000
lines.text: Oh, honey. You’re making a Pokédex?\rYou must be battling all kinds\nof Pokémon.\rTry using this TM for a change.

lines.label: msg_0386_R34R0201_00002
lines.text: It’s Taunt.\rUse it and the target Pokémon\ncan only use moves that do damage\fto your Pokémon for a while.

lines.label: msg_0386_R34R0201_00003
lines.text: BUTTERFREE: Freeh!

lines.label: msg_0386_R34R0201_00004
lines.text:
Did you see the shrine that pays homage
to the protector?This protector watches over the forest
from across time.I think that it must be a
Grass-type Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0387_R35_00021
lines.text: Your Pokémon look pretty tough.\nYou could go anywhere safely.

lines.label: msg_0387_R35_00028
lines.text: Rt. 35\nSouth to Goldenrod City

lines.label: msg_0387_R35_00029
lines.text: North to the National Park\nWest to the Pokéathlon Dome

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00000
lines.text: Excuse me, kid!\nI received this letter the other day\ffrom a friend of mine.\rHere’s the reply that I wrote.\rI am stuck here and was wondering\nif you could deliver it...\rHe’s on Route 31.\fCan you help a guy out? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00001
lines.text: Oh... Never mind, then...\nYou must be busy, too.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00002
lines.text: Huh?\nYour party is full!

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00003
lines.text: Wow, thanks!\r

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received the\nSPEAROW with Mail!

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00005
lines.text: My friend is on Route 31.\rHe looks obviously eager to read\nletters, so you’ll know who he is\fright away!

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00006
lines.text: My friend is on Route 31.\rOh, yeah.\nThere was a weird tree\fblocking the road.\fI wonder if it’s been cleared?

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00007
lines.text: Thank you for making the delivery!\r...What about a cave exploration?\nAh, you can go right through here.\rI want you to have this for\nyour kindness!\r

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00008
lines.text: My pal was snoozing, right?\nHeh, he’s always sleeping.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00009
lines.text: What?!\nYou lost the Mail?\fOh, well. That’s OK.\fDon’t worry about it.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00010
lines.text: Everything is fine!

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00011
lines.text: A strange tree is blocking the road.\nIt wriggles around if you talk to it.\rI heard it became wild when someone\nwatered it with a SquirtBottle.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00012
lines.text: I like the Pokémon Lullaby they play\non the radio.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00013
lines.text:
I can’t believe such a tiny change
turns the Pokégear into a radio!Oh, your Pokégear doesn’t have
that feature yet?It’s a shame!They happen to give quizzes at the
Radio Tower reception on the first floor.If you can answer them correctly,
they’ll give you the Radio Card!You better try it while they
have some left!

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00014
lines.text: I may not look it, but I’m pretty good\nat mechanics.\rDo you want to know how to\nlisten to the radio? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00015
lines.text:
You open your Pokégear and press the
radio button. Then you see the screen for tuning in a signal.The middle of the screen is the
radio-reception map.You can move the blinking mark on the
map around to tune in to different radio shows.For those who think this is a pain,
there are four channels, two on each side, for easy tuning.

lines.label: msg_0388_R35R0101_00016
lines.text: Was I being a backseat driver?

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00000
lines.text: I heard about the Bug-Catching Contest\nwhere Bug-type lovers gather from all\fover the region.\r...Me?\nI cannot take Bug types...

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00001
lines.text: The Bug-Catching Contest is held on\nTuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.\rNot only do you earn a prize just\nfor participating, you also get to\fkeep the Bug-type Pokémon you catch.

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00002
lines.text: Sorry to tell you this, but the\nPokéathlon Dome is still under\fconstruction, and the entrance there\fis off-limits.\rYou know what a rush construction is?\rIn short, they are working really hard.\nIt shouldn’t take too long.\rJust a little more patience, OK?

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00003
lines.text: The Pokéathlon Dome is this way.\rPlease go through the entrance gate,\nand do participate in the games!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00004
lines.text: Arrgh!\rWhen is the Pokéathlon going to\nbe ready?\rI can’t just sit here and wait!\nI’ll go on an around-Johto run!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00005
lines.text: I’ve been waiting for this moment!\rBehold my friendship with my Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00006
lines.text: I wonder if I can participate, too.\nIt’s only running with Pokémon, right?

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00007
lines.text: Play collectively with your Pokémon,\ntrust your Pokémon, and believe in your\fPokémon’s potential!\rYour friendship with Pokémon\nwill make your dream come true!\rPokéathlon for you!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00008
lines.text: Charge your energy with friendship!\nGive Aprijuice to your Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00009
lines.text: Tap tap ding ding!\rWe are in a big hurry!\nJust a little more work before you\fcan come through.\rI hope you are looking forward to it!

lines.label: msg_0389_R35R0201_00010
lines.text: Hey, hey!\nWatch yourself! The construction\fmakes it dangerous around here.\rJust wait a little longer for the\nexciting reveal!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00000
lines.text: There’s an odd tree!\nUse the SquirtBottle? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00001
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} used\nthe SquirtBottle!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00002
lines.text: The odd tree doesn’t like the\nSquirtBottle!\rThe odd tree attacked!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00003
lines.text: Yo!\rHaven’t you had trouble with a boulder\nblocking your way? Of course you have!\rFor people like you, there’s an HM\nthat will come to your rescue!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00004
lines.text: Are you the one who took care of the\nodd tree in the way?\rYou’re quite the Trainer!\nTake this!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00005
lines.text:
It contains make-’em-faint Rock Smash.You can even use it to smash boulders
once you’ve earned the Violet City Gym Badge!But beware!
Hidden moves like this are hard for your Pokémon to forget once they’ve learned them.You should think carefully which
Pokémon should learn it.

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00006
lines.text: Your Bag is full!

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00007
lines.text: An odd tree is blocking the way\nto Ecruteak City.\rIt’s preventing me from shopping.\fSomething should be done about it.

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00008
lines.text:
The odd tree is gone, as if it just
walked away...! What? It was a Pokémon?Well, finally I can go to Ecruteak
to do some shopping.If you follow the path from where the
odd tree was, you’ll reach Ecruteak City!

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00009
lines.text: Rt. 36\nNorth to Ecruteak City

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00010
lines.text: Ruins of Alph\nNorth Entrance

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00011
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rThe same kind of Pokémon may look the\nsame, but they can grow differently.\rTheir strengths may look the same\nin the beginning, but those strengths\fcan change as they grow.

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00012
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rThe move Dig can take you back to\nthe entrance when you use it.\rIf you want to explore a cave or\nsomething similar, a Pokémon with\fDig will be quite useful.

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00013
lines.text: I’m the Flower Shop’s Floria!\rListen, listen! When I sprinkled water\non that wiggly tree, it jumped right up!\rIt just has to be a Pokémon.\rI bet it would be shocked out of\ndisguising itself if you soaked it!

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00014
lines.text: I’m the Flower Shop’s Floria!\rListen, listen! When I sprinkled water\non that wiggly tree, it jumped right up!\fIt just has to be a Pokémon.\fIf you soaked it...\rOh, that’s the SquirtBottle!\rSoak the tree for me!\nI want to see what happens!

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00015
lines.text: That was fun!\rI want to give you this\nfor entertaining me!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00016
lines.text: With the Berry Pots, you can grow\nany Berry from any region\fwith no worries!\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00017
lines.text: That’s right!\nI’ll give you some Berries, too.\rBerry Pots won’t do any good\nwithout Berries.\r

lines.label: msg_0390_R36_00018
lines.text: You have to plant Berries in the soil.\nYou should water them from time\fto time. Then they’ll grow strong!\rI have to go back to Goldenrod.\fAre you heading for Ecruteak?\rThen you should go north here.\nSee you around!\r

lines.label: msg_0391_R36R0101_00000
lines.text: This is the Ruins of Alph.\nAn ancient tradition made of stones.\rDon’t you wonder who’d make\nsomething like this? And why?

lines.label: msg_0391_R36R0101_00001
lines.text: Did you see that strange tree in\nthe road?\rThat may explain why fewer people\nare visiting the Ruins of Alph.

lines.label: msg_0393_R37_00000
lines.text: Rt. 37\nNorth to Ecruteak City

lines.label: msg_0393_R37_00001
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rThe move Dig can take you back to\nthe entrance when you use it.\rIf you want to explore a cave or\nsomething similar, a Pokémon with\fDig will be quite useful.

lines.label: msg_0394_R38_00015
lines.text: Rt. 38\nSouth to Olivine City

lines.label: msg_0394_R38_00016
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rIf a Pokémon is trying to evolve,\nyou can stop it.\rPress the B Button during evolution.\rThat startles the Pokémon and stops\nits evolution.

lines.label: msg_0395_R38R0101_00000
lines.text: Where did you say you’re from?\rNew Bark Town?\rThat’s the town where...\nProfessor Elm lives, right?\fYou’ve come a long way to get here.

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00000
lines.text: Rt. 39\nSouth to Olivine City

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00001
lines.text: Moomoo Farm\nEnjoy Our Fresh and Tasty Milk

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00002
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rUse Headbutt on trees to shake\nPokémon out.\rDifferent kinds of Pokémon drop out\nof trees.\rUse Headbutt on any tree you see!

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00003
lines.text: MILTANK: Mooo!

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00004
lines.text:
Baoba: ...Ohh!
What you are holding is... what they call...a Pokédex! Haven’t seen one of those in ages.My name is Baoba!I used to run a Safari Zone in
Fuchsia City, but it was becoming out of date with new entertainment options coming out.I decided to go overseas to learn
the newest technology and open a state-of-the-art Safari Zone in Cianwood.It may be more than a coincidence
that we are chatting.Why don’t we register each other’s
numbers in the Pokégear?I can give you a call once the Safari
Zone is open before I call anyone else!

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00005
lines.text: Do you want to register? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00006
lines.text: That’s the way!\r

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00007
lines.text: Huh, I didn’t expect you to say no.\nYou can get hard-to-find Pokémon, too.\rYou’ll be able to make good progress\nwith your Pokédex, too...\r

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00008
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Baoba\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00009
lines.text: Baoba: I’ll let you know over the\nPokégear once it’s ready!\r

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00010
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Hey, you!\rDon’t you want a good memory of us\ntogether? How about taking a\fpicture with me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00011
lines.text: Lt. Surge: OK! OK!\rShow me a very good smile!\r

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00012
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Wow!\nThis turned out to be a really\fgood one!\rWe root for Route 39!

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00013
lines.text: Lt. Surge: That’s OK...\rLet me know if you change your mind.

lines.label: msg_0396_R39_00014
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC to delete some pictures\nbefore you come back.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00000
lines.text: My MILTANK ain’t givin’ me milk\nn’more.\rThis here farm’s got famous milk.\rMost everyone wants a drink.\nIt’ll give me lots o’ milk if’n I feed it\flots o’ Berries, I reckon.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00001
lines.text: How’d you like my Moomoo Milk?\rIt’s my pride and joy, there.\fGive it to Pokémon to restore HP!\rI’ll give it to ya fer just $500. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00002
lines.text: Here ya go!\nDrink up’n enjoy!\r

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00003
lines.text: Sorry, there.\nNo cash, no sale!

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00004
lines.text: I reckon yer Bag’s full.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00005
lines.text: You don’t want it?\nCome again, hear?

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00006
lines.text: I best go do my milkin’.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00007
lines.text: Our milk even goes out to Kanto.\rSo if our own MILTANK won’t give\nus any milk, we’re in trouble.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00008
lines.text: You fixed our MILTANK, hon.\nNow it gives Moomoo Milk again.\rHere’s somethin’ fer your trouble.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00010
lines.text: That there’s Natural Gift.\rIts move type and Power will depend\non the Berry yer Pokémon holds.\rWhen you use it once, the Berry’s gone.\nYou best think how you ought to\fuse it, hon.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00011
lines.text: I reckon yer Bag’s full.

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00012
lines.text: {ALN_CENTER}1 BOTTLE

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00013
lines.text: {ALN_CENTER}1 DOZEN

lines.label: msg_0397_R39R0101_00014
lines.text: {ALN_CENTER}NO THANKS

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00000
lines.text: Moomoo is sick...\fShe needs lots of Oran Berries.\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00001
lines.text: Thank you!\nMoomoo is totally healthy again!\rI’ll give you these Seals for\nyour trouble.\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00002
lines.text: Shocking!\nI really want to give you some\fSeals, but you don’t have a\fSeal Case...\rBut don’t you worry.\nMy sister can give you a Seal Case!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00003
lines.text: Ha!\nYour Seal Case is full!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00004
lines.text: Moomoo is totally healthy again!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00005
lines.text: Moomoo is sick...\fShe needs lots of Oran Berries.\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00006
lines.text: Thank you!\nMoomoo is totally healthy again!\rI’ll give you this Seal Case for\nyour trouble.\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00007
lines.text: You can customize your Poké Balls.\rSelect “BALL CAPSULES” from\nyour PC, and stick your Seals any way\fyou like on a Capsule, then put the\fCapsule on any of your Poké Balls.\rTry different things, and you’ll see.\nMy sister can give you Seals!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00008
lines.text: We sell Moomoo Milk at home.\fDon’t forget to drop by!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00009
lines.text: MILTANK: ...Moo...\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00010
lines.text: Its cry is weak...

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00011
lines.text: MILTANK: Mooo!\r

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00012
lines.text: It’s brimming with energy.

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00013
lines.text: Give an Oran Berry to MILTANK? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00014
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} gave an Oran Berry\nto MILTANK.

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00015
lines.text: MILTANK became a little healthier!

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00016
lines.text: MILTANK is getting healthier!

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00017
lines.text: MILTANK became totally healthy!

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00018
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} has no Oran Berries...

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00019
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} wouldn’t give\nan Oran Berry.\rMILTANK looks sad.

lines.label: msg_0398_R39R0201_00020
lines.text: The {STRVAR_1 10, 0, 0} were\nput away in the Seal Case!

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00000
lines.text: Rt. 42 Ecruteak City\nto Mahogany Town

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00001
lines.text: Mt. Mortar\nWaterfall Cave Inside

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00002
lines.text: Mt. Mortar\nWaterfall Cave Inside

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00003
lines.text: Rt. 42 Mahogany Town\nto Ecruteak City

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00004
lines.text: {SIZE 200}Thud!{SIZE 100}\r

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00005
lines.text: Oh, boy!\rSorry that I bumped into you.\rDid I hurt you?\rPlease don’t cry.\nHere, take this.\r

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00006
lines.text: It’s a move called Strength!\rWhen a Pokémon learns it, it can move\nboulders out of your way.\fEnjoy a happy mountain-climbing life!\r

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00007
lines.text: Eusine: SUICUNE...\nHow brave it is!\fHow refreshing it is!\fHow beautiful it is!\fAnd how quickly it moves!\r

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00008
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
You seem to be around where SUICUNE would appear.Well, that’s OK.
My desire to search for SUICUNE is far beyond yours...My grandpa was...quite into myths.
I’ve heard so many stories about SUICUNE from him.

lines.label: msg_0399_R42_00009
lines.text: SUICUNE...\rI won’t stop following you until\nI’ve found out what you’re after...\rYou hear me!\r

lines.label: msg_0400_R42R0101_00000
lines.text: Mt. Mortar is like a maze inside.\fBe careful. Don’t get lost in there.

lines.label: msg_0401_R43_00018
lines.text: Rt. 43\nNorth to Lake of Rage

lines.label: msg_0401_R43_00019
lines.text:
Trainer TipsAll Pokémon have pros and cons
depending on their types.If their types differ, even a higher-
level Pokémon may lose in battle.Learn which types are strong or
weak against your Pokémon’s type.

lines.label: msg_0401_R43_00020
lines.text: North to Lake of Rage\nSouth to Mahogany Town

lines.label: msg_0402_R43R0101_00000
lines.text: I heard that you can find a\nRed Scale occasionally.\rSpeaking of which, I know a person\nwho’d appreciate a Red Scale.\fWho?\rI can’t remember...

lines.label: msg_0402_R43R0101_00001
lines.text:
I heard that you can find a
Red Scale occasionally.Speaking of which, I know a person
who’d appreciate a Red Scale. Who?I think he’s called Mr. something
or other...What was his name...?

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00000
lines.text: Hold it there, kiddo!\rThe toll is $1,000 to go through.\r

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00001
lines.text: Thank you very much!\r

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00002
lines.text: Then pay what you have, please.\rThose who have no money, hmm...\ncan go through free of charge!\r

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00003
lines.text: He-he-he. We’re making a bundle.\rEveryone wants to see what’s going\non up at Lake of Rage.

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00004
lines.text: I got chased from my post by\nthese Team Rocket thugs.\rThen they just disappeared.\nSomeone apparently destroyed\ftheir hideout.\r...One more thing!\fI found this under the counter.\fIt makes me uncomfortable.\fCould I give it to you?\r

lines.label: msg_0403_R43R0201_00006
lines.text: It contains Sludge Bomb!\rIt not only damages the target\nbut also poisons it sometimes.\fSee!\rDoesn’t it make you feel\nuncomfortable?

lines.label: msg_0404_R44_00000
lines.text: Ice Path\rCareful not to slip, fall over,\nfreeze, and get stuck on the ice.

lines.label: msg_0404_R44_00001
lines.text: Rt. 44\nEast to Blackthorn City

lines.label: msg_0405_R45_00000
lines.text:
Have you heard of a place called
the Battle Frontier?It’s a huge place with many battle
facilities, and it’s located west of Olivine City!Let’s see...If you manage to win all the way up
through the Pokémon League, you might want to try it.

lines.label: msg_0405_R45_00001
lines.text: Rt. 45\nMountain Road ahead

lines.label: msg_0405_R45_00002
lines.text: Dark Cave

lines.label: msg_0406_R46_00000
lines.text: Rt. 46\nMountain Road ahead

lines.label: msg_0406_R46_00001
lines.text: Dark Cave

lines.label: msg_0406_R46_00002
lines.text: A dead end...?\rDid I take the wrong path?\rI didn’t know this was only\none way.

lines.label: msg_0406_R46_00003
lines.text: You should try different routes\nsometime.\rYou never know what Pokémon\nyou’re gonna get!

lines.label: msg_0407_R47_00000
lines.text:
Well, hello!It’s said that past this hole used to be
a huge tower reaching far into the sky.They say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded in the cliff.It was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep down underground!It is rumored that it even reached the
bottom of the ocean!In short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to each other...Most of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are the entrance and its interior, where you’ll see strange patterns.

lines.label: msg_0407_R47_00001
lines.text: I think this building may have been\nbuilt to enshrine Pokémon with\fa strong connection to the sea,\fthe land, and the sky.

lines.label: msg_0407_R47_00002
lines.text: A masked guy who looks great in front\nof a huge torrential waterfall...\fThat’s me, Crasher Wake!\rWho dares to talk to me so freely?\rOh!\nYou are that mask-fanatic Trainer\fI saw at the Celadon Dept. Store!\r

lines.label: msg_0407_R47_00003
