quite a reputation.That’s what we hear on the grapevine.
I’m delighted to hear that.            Elm in New Bark Town 8-)

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00039
lines.text:
Professor Oak: Hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
Good to see you. I heard a lot about you.Your Pokédex must be close
to complete?For all your hard work,
I would like to give you something.

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00040
lines.text:
Professor Oak: Hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
Good to see you. I heard a lot about you.Your Pokédex must be close
to complete?For all your hard work,
I would like to give you something.

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00041
lines.text: Professor Oak: Haha!\rWhat’s behind me...\nYou must have figured it out right away.\rYes, it is a Pokémon!\r

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00042
lines.text: Professor Oak: You don’t see them\nvery often in Kanto.\fChoose one and it’ll be yours!\r...Go ahead!

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00043
lines.text: So, you’re claiming the\nFire Pokémon CHARMANDER? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00044
lines.text: So, you’ve decided on the\nWater Pokémon SQUIRTLE? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00045
lines.text: So, you want to go with\nthe Grass Pokémon BULBASAUR? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00046
lines.text: This Pokémon is really quite energetic!\r

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00047
lines.text: No need to hurry.\nTake your time.

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00048
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received the\n{STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0} from Professor Oak!

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00049
lines.text: Would you like to give a nickname to\nthe {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0} you received? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00050
lines.text: Is {STRVAR_1 1, 1, 0} the nickname\nyou want to give? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00051
lines.text: Huh?\nYou have no room for it right now.\rCome back when you’ve made room.

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00052
lines.text:
Professor Oak: If a wild Pokémon
appears, your Pokémon can battle it.With it at your side, you should be able
to reach the next town...What am I saying?
You already know all this! Hahaha!

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00053
lines.text: Professor Oak: There is nothing more\nthat I can do for you.\rEnjoy the rest of your journey\nwith that new Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00054
lines.text: This is Professor Oak’s Pokémon.\n{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0} will probably not\fsteal it like before...

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00055
lines.text: Professor Oak: Good to see you!\nThis is what I’ve wanted to\fgive to you!\r

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00056
lines.text: Professor Oak: That Hidden Machine\ncontains the move Rock Climb!\rWhen you teach it to a Pokémon,\nyou can go up rock walls that have\fsteps carved in them.\r

lines.label: msg_0451_T01R0301_00057
lines.text: When you use Rock Climb,\nyou can go up rock walls that have\fsteps carved in them.\rYou will discover all sorts\nof new things!

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00000
lines.text:
Hey, kid! I just had a double shot
of espresso, and I am wired!I need to talk to someone, so you’ll
have to do!I might not look like much now, but
I was an expert at catching Pokémon.Do you believe me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00001
lines.text: Good, good. Yes, I was something out\nof the ordinary, let me tell you!

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00002
lines.text: What? You little whelp!\rIf I were just a bit younger, I’d\nshow you a thing or two. Humph!

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00003
lines.text: This Gym didn’t have a Leader...\rA young man from Pallet Town became the\nLeader, but he’s often away.

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00004
lines.text: How was it?\nWere you able to battle the Leader?

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00005
lines.text:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun....I had this dream about a DROWZEE
eating my dream.Weird, huh? Huh? What’s this?Where did this TM come from?
This is spooky! Here, you can have this TM.

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00006
lines.text: TM85 contains Dream Eater...\n...Zzzzz...

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00007
lines.text: I heard that there are many items on\nthe ground in Viridian Forest.

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00008
lines.text: Viridian City\nThe City of Evergreen

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00009
lines.text: Viridian City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: ...\fThe rest of the text is illegible...

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00010
lines.text: Welcome to Viridian City,\nthe Gateway to Indigo Plateau!

lines.label: msg_0452_T02_00011
lines.text: Trainer House\nThe Club for Top Trainer Battles

lines.label: msg_0453_T02FS0101_00000
lines.text: The Gym Leader here is totally cool.

lines.label: msg_0453_T02FS0101_00001
lines.text: Have you been to Cinnabar?\rIt’s an island way south\nof here.

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Blue: Yo! Finally got here, huh?I wasn’t in the mood at Cinnabar,
but now I’m ready to battle you....You’re telling me you conquered all
the Gyms in Johto?Hahaha! Heh! Johto’s Gyms are that pathetic?Hey, don’t worry about it.
I’ll know if you are good or not by battling you right now.

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Blue: No way!\rHow the heck did I lose to you?\r...\rTch, all right...\fHere, take this.\fIt’s the Earth Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Earth Badge from Blue!

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Blue: With this Badge, you’ll be able\nto use the HM move Rock Climb!\fHere!\rTake this as well!\r

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Blue: It contains Trick Room!\rIt allows slower Pokémon to move\nbefore faster Pokémon for a while.\rIt’s a very tricky move, isn’t it?\nHence the name!

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Blue: ...\rAll right, I was wrong. You’re the\nreal deal.\fYou are a good Trainer.\rBut I’m going to beat you someday.\nDon’t you forget it!

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00006
lines.text:
Yo, legend in the making!The floor here is unstable,
so you should put away your Pokémon ...now!The Gym Leader is a guy who battled
the Champion three years ago.He’s no pushover.
Give it everything you’ve got!

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Man, you are truly tough...\rThat was such an inspirational battle.\nIt brought tears to my eyes.

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00008
lines.text:
Yo, legend in the making!The floor here is unstable,
so you should put away your Pokémon ...now!The Gym Leader is a guy who battled
the Champion three years ago.He’s no pushover.
Give it everything you’ve got!

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Viridian City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0454_T02GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Viridian City Pokémon Gym\rGym Leader: Blue\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0455_T02PC0101_00000
lines.text: Where in the world is Viridian’s\nGym Leader?\fI wanted to challenge him...

lines.label: msg_0455_T02PC0101_00001
lines.text:
Viridian’s Gym Leader does not
rely on others!The Gym Leader claims that his policy
is to lose to no one without having any underlings.That makes him even more popular,
and many Trainers have come to work for him.

lines.label: msg_0455_T02PC0101_00002
lines.text: I heard that the Gym in Cinnabar\nis gone.\rI wonder what became of Blaine,\nthe Gym Leader.

lines.label: msg_0455_T02PC0101_00003
lines.text: My dream is to become a Gym Leader.

lines.label: msg_0456_T02R0201_00000
lines.text: Do you put a lot of thought into naming\nyour Pokémon?\rGiving them good nicknames adds to the\nfun of trading with others.

lines.label: msg_0456_T02R0201_00001
lines.text: They’re Speary--a SPEAROW--and\nRattey--a RATTATA.

lines.label: msg_0456_T02R0201_00002
lines.text: Speary: Ch-chun!

lines.label: msg_0456_T02R0201_00003
lines.text: Rattey: Kikiii!

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00000
lines.text: Welcome to Trainer House, the newest\nand most happening place in Viridian.\fWe’re open to Trainers only.\rYou can battle against the best\nof the best right downstairs.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00001
lines.text: Viridian is the town closest to\nIndigo Plateau.\rThey built this place because so\nmany Trainers pass through on their\fway up to Indigo Plateau.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00002
lines.text: They hold practice battles\ndownstairs here.\rI would love to see how well a\nTrainer from Johto battles.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00003
lines.text:
You go all over the place and battle
all kinds of Trainers.This is not just to train your Pokémon.
This is also a chance to experience many things yourself.I bet the Champion from
Pallet Town went to all the cities and towns in Kanto.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00004
lines.text: Whew...\rI’m taking a rest from\nPokémon battles.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00005
lines.text:
Practice battles are held in the
Training Hall downstairs.Skilled Trainers are invited to
participate.Communicate with your friends through
the Pokéwalker to bring them here!Be aware that you cannot bring them
here once you are downstairs!

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00006
lines.text:
Trainer House Rules1. You can challenge various Trainers
    once a day.2. All Pokémon over Level 50 become
    Level 50 for the battle.3. You cannot use items from your Bag.4. Afterward, your Pokémon will recover
    and the held item will be restored.5. You cannot earn experience from
    the battle.6. You earn Battle Points instead!Skilled Trainers are invited to
participate.

lines.label: msg_0457_T02R0301_00007
lines.text: ...What’s this?\nA strategy memo?\rThis writing looks like ONIX tracks...\fIt’s completely illegible...

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00000
lines.text: Hello, welcome to our Training Hall.\rYou may battle our best Trainers and\ntheir favorite Pokémon once\fper day.\rWould you like to participate? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00002
lines.text: You are ready!\nPlease go right through.\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00003
lines.text: I see...\nPlease come back again.\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00004
lines.text: Do you want to exit? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00005
lines.text: Thank you for playing!\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00006
lines.text: I see.\nGood luck!\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00007
lines.text: Oh, hello!\nRight this way, please!\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00008
lines.text:
This is the Trainer House--
the place for Trainers.The Pokéwalker will bring your
friends here!You can challenge various Trainers
once a day.You’ll earn Battle Points when you win. Bring out your best!

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00009
lines.text:
Oh! I’ll borrow your Vs. Recorder
for a moment.Let’s see... Slide open this part here,
and ticka-tacka-kachunk there!All done!Now you can check your Battle Points
using your Vs. Recorder!

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00010
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Vs. Recorder was\nupgraded.

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00011
lines.text: You may exchange your Battle Points\nfor fabulous prizes at Johto\fBattle Frontier!\r

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00012
lines.text: Now that you are ready,\nwould you like to train yourself? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00013
lines.text: Would you like to battle? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0458_T02R0302_00014
lines.text: See you tomorrow!

lines.label: msg_0459_T02R0401_00000
lines.text: To the south is Pallet Town.\nThat’s where Professor Oak, a\fwell-respected Pokémon\freseacher, lives.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00000
lines.text: Have you visited Pewter Gym?\rThe Gym Leader uses\nRock-type Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00001
lines.text: At night, CLEFAIRY come out to play\nat Mt. Moon.\rBut not every night.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00002
lines.text:
Ah, you came all the way out here
from Johto?That brings back memories.When I was young, I went to Johto
to train.You remind me so much of what I was
like as a young man.Here. I want you to have this item
I found in Johto.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00005
lines.text: Going to new, unknown places and\nseeing new people...\fThose are the joys of travel.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00006
lines.text: Steven: It seems that LATIOS became\nattracted to it in no time!\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00007
lines.text: Steven: It seems that LATIAS became\nattracted to it in no time!\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00008
lines.text: I can feel that LATIOS is full of\nfighting spirit!\rI would love to challenge it,\nbut I will let you go for it!

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00009
lines.text: I can feel that LATIAS is full of\nfighting spirit!\rI would love to challenge it,\nbut I will let you go for it!

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00010
lines.text: LATIOS: Shuaaaann!\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00011
lines.text: LATIAS: Huaaaaann!\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00012
lines.text: LATIOS flew away to the distant sky...\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00013
lines.text: LATIAS flew away to the distant sky...\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00014
lines.text: Steven: Impressive!\nIt was a great battle!\rI don’t think you had to give\neverything you’ve got,\fand that scares me...\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00015
lines.text: I’ve been away from the Hoenn\nPokémon League for too long.\rI’ll have to excuse myself.\r..................\rOh, I never got your name.\f...But I won’t ask for it this time.\rOur fun will have to wait for the\nright time.\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00016
lines.text: Steven: Impressive!\nIt was a great battle!\rLATIOS will be back once it recovers\nto make amends for the defeat.\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00017
lines.text: Steven: Impressive!\nIt was a great battle!\rLATIAS will be back once it recovers\nto make amends for the defeat.\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00018
lines.text: Steven: I see.\nYou’d rather hide your true strength\ffrom me. You have room to breathe,\fand that scares me.\r

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00019
lines.text: Steven: What? You are not scared,\nare you? Don’t be reserved. Go for it.

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00020
lines.text: Pewter City\nBetween Rugged Mountains

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00021
lines.text: Pewter City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Brock\fThe Rock-Solid Pokémon Trainer

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00022
lines.text: Pewter Museum of Science

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00023
lines.text: Welcome to Pewter City!

lines.label: msg_0460_T03_00024
lines.text: The door’s locked...

lines.label: msg_0461_T03FS0101_00000
lines.text: Look! I have a GYARADOS!\rI raised it from a MAGIKARP slowly.\nIt finally evolved!

lines.label: msg_0461_T03FS0101_00001
lines.text: There once was a weird old man who\nsold MAGIKARP.\rThat boy got one and kept it for\na long time!

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Brock: Wow, it’s not often that we
get a challenger from Johto.I’m Brock, the Pewter Gym Leader. I’m an expert on Rock-type Pokémon.My Pokémon are impervious to most
physical attacks.You’ll have a hard time inflicting
any damage.Come on!

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Brock: Your Pokémon’s powerful\nattacks overcame my\frock-hard resistance...\rYou’re stronger than\nI expected...\fGo ahead--take this Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Boulder Badge from Brock!

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Brock: I really enjoyed the battle\nwith you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\fI’ll give you the move Rock Slide, too.\rIt can sometimes cause your foe\nto flinch.\r

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Brock: I really enjoyed the battle\nwith you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\fI’ll give you the move Rock Slide, too.\rIt can sometimes cause your foe\nto flinch.\r

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Brock: The world is huge. There are\nstill many strong Trainers like you.\rJust wait and see.\rI’m going to become a lot\nstronger, too.

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Yo! Legend in the making! You look...\freally rocking.\rAre you battling the Gym Leaders\nof Kanto?\rThey’re strong and dedicated people,\njust like Johto’s Gym Leaders.

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Yo! Legend in the making! That Gym\ndidn’t give you much trouble.\rThe way you took charge was\nreally inspiring.\fI mean that seriously.

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Pewter City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0462_T03GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Pewter City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Brock\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00000
lines.text: ...Yeah, and the Gym in Cinnabar’s\ngone. I was really amazed.\r...Yes? I’m on the phone.\nGo away!

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00001
lines.text: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu.

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00002
lines.text: Most Pokémon get drowsy if they\nhear a JIGGLYPUFF singing.\rThere are several moves that can be\nused only while a Pokémon is asleep.

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00003
lines.text: Aw...\nIf only I had a HAUNTER...\rIf you have a HAUNTER,\nyou will trade it for my XATU,\fwon’t you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00004
lines.text: How wonderful! You made my day!\rThanks to you, I have finally got the\nPokémon I’ve been looking for...\fsince forever!

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00005
lines.text: It has to be a HAUNTER!\rHAUNTER!!

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00006
lines.text: You’d never turn down a trade\nif you had a HAUNTER.\rThat means you just don’t have one.\nThat must be it...

lines.label: msg_0463_T03PC0101_00007
lines.text: How do you like the cool XATU\nI traded you?\rIt’s so cool, because it used to be\nwith cool me!

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00000
lines.text: Welcome!\rJust to let you know, all the large\nspecimens have been taken to the\fother museums for display.\rSo for now, admission is free\nof charge!\rPlease go ahead.

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00001
lines.text: Did you know that you can\nextract Pokémon from Fossils?\rIf you ever need to, let me take care\nof it for you!\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00002
lines.text: Please come by again if you ever want to\nextract Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00003
lines.text: I’ll extract it for you.\rCome back after a while!

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00004
lines.text: Hi, there!\rI have extracted a Pokémon from\nyour Fossil!\rIt is called {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0}.\nTake good care of it!\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00005
lines.text: Oops!\nYour party seems full.\rWhy don’t you go to the PC\nto make room for it?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00006
lines.text: Hey!\nYou don’t have any Fossils.\rI heard that sometimes you find Fossils\nwhen you smash rocks at the\fRuins of Alph and other places.

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00007
lines.text: Do you want to extract a Pokémon\nfrom the {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00008
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0}!

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00009
lines.text: Would you like to give a nickname\nto the {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0} you received? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00010
lines.text:
They say that meteorites struck
somewhere near Pewter City.We would love to display them here
in our museum, but...These meteorites are said to
emit strange energy and cannot be carried away...

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00011
lines.text:
There are two places that I love!
One is the Ruins of Alph in Johto...The other is the Pewter Museum!
It’s so quiet and makes me feel calm.Do you feel its admirable history
silently creeping up on you?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00012
lines.text: I should be grateful for my long life.\rNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00013
lines.text: ..................\rAll those shining stars at night are\nthe stones I’ll never get to know...

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00014
lines.text: Steven: People who dedicate themselves\nto what they believe stand out in\fa crowd.\rBut, my passion is no less than yours.\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00015
lines.text: Wow!\nThe thing you have...\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00016
lines.text: This stone is...so mysterious!\rSomething seems to be shining inside...\nThe stone is modest...yet hiding\fsomething wonderful!\rYou should have it studied\nby experts.\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00017
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} handed the Enigma Stone\nto the researcher!\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00018
lines.text: I will check it.\nCan you hold on a second?\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00019
lines.text: Thank you for your patience!\nIt took me a little while,\fbut I have confirmed it!\rThis is an Orb that contains\nwhat is called {COLOR 2}Soul Dew{COLOR 0}.\r

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00020
lines.text: Soul Dew is no ordinary thing\nand is rarely seen.\fI would love to study it closely.

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00021
lines.text:
Steven: Soul Dew is said to be the
solidified spirits of LATIAS and LATIOS.It has the power to bring out the
true potential of LATIAS and LATIOS.The spirits of these Pokémon and
Soul Dew are said to call out to each other...The only thing that puzzles me is
the place Soul Dew was found. Why Kanto?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00022
lines.text: Stringy and winding...\nIs this a plant Fossil?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00023
lines.text: It’s a curving, sharp Fossil.\nThis may be...\fthe Fossil of a carnivore?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00024
lines.text: It’s flat and looks hard.\nThis may be...\fa part that protected its body?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00025
lines.text: Solid amber tree sap has\nsomething inside!\rIf you can take it out, you can\nextract a Pokémon from\fancient times...?

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00026
lines.text: Small bones are put together to form\nsome kind of a Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00027
lines.text: The rough stone has words etched\ninto it...\r“This is an unidentified object\nfound at Mt. Moon. It is possibly a\fmoon rock.”

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00028
lines.text: There are thick and well-read books!\r“The Principles of Fossil Extraction”\f“Archaeology Manual”\f“Lost Pokémon”\f“Pokémon Ancestors”\f“Friendships of Trainers and Pokémon”\f“Caring at the Loamy Layer of Kanto”

lines.label: msg_0464_T03R0101_00029
lines.text: Our museum mainly displays\nFossils and specimens from Kanto.\rPlease enjoy the extinct Pokémon\nthrough their remembrance, and\fstep through time to the ancient world.

lines.label: msg_0465_T03R0201_00000
lines.text: NIDORAN♂, shake hands!

lines.label: msg_0465_T03R0201_00001
lines.text: NIDORAN㊚: Gau gau!

lines.label: msg_0466_T03R0601_00000
lines.text: I used to enjoy snoozing\nwith the radio on...\rIt’s broken and is being fixed now.\r...\n...\f...\f...\rIt’s too quiet to fall asleep!

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00000
lines.text: Kanto’s Power Plant?\rIt’s near the end of Route 9, the road\nthat heads east from here.\rI think there was an accident of\nsome sort there.

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00001
lines.text: You’re collecting every single kind\nof Pokémon?\rThat must be quite a challenge, but\nit sounds fun, too.

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00002
lines.text: The cape in the north is a good\nplace for dates.\rGirls like it!\rJust between you and me...\nMisty, the Gym Leader, is sometimes\fthere at the cape.\rGuess I don’t stand a chance!

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00003
lines.text: SLOWBRO: Yarah?

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00004
lines.text: SLOWBRO is full of the fighting spirit!

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00005
lines.text: My SLOWBRO and I make an\nawesome combination!\rSLOWBRO, show me your Psychic!\r...!\nSLOWBRO’s Psychic hits hard!

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00006
lines.text: This shady character asked me just now\nhow to get to the Power Plant.\rHe said it must be kept\n“...confidential.”\rWhat does that mean?

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00007
lines.text: A shady character sneaked into\nthe Gym! What business does\fhe have with Misty?

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00008
lines.text: I saw this shady guy in black go\noff toward the Cape.

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00009
lines.text: I’m a huge fan of Cerulean Gym’s Misty.

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00010
lines.text: I heard of a cave here that had\nhorribly powerful Pokémon in it.\fThat’s why I came here.\r

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00011
lines.text: Ayuh?\rMy Dowsing Machine is responding...

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00012
lines.text: This is...\nThe notorious Cerulean Cave!\rHorribly powerful Pokémon live here.\nOnly those who have defeated all eight\fKanto Gym Leaders are allowed to\fchallenge it.

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00013
lines.text: Cerulean City\nThe Floral Lagoon City

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00014
lines.text: Cerulean City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Misty\fThe Tomboyish Mermaid

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00015
lines.text: Trendsetter of the Bicycle Boom\rCerulean Bike Main Shop

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00016
lines.text: There’s a notice here...\rStamp out thievery and make the city\na friendlier, more cheerful place!\fCerulean Police

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00017
lines.text: Rt. 24 Ahead\nEast to Cerulean Cape

lines.label: msg_0467_T04_00018
lines.text: It’s locked...

lines.label: msg_0468_T04FS0101_00000
lines.text: You’ll run into many Trainers on\nthe way to Cerulean Cape.\rThey want to see how they stack\nup against other Trainers.

lines.label: msg_0468_T04FS0101_00001
lines.text: Misty is about the only person in town\nwho can beat the Trainers at\fCerulean Cape.

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00000
lines.text: {SIZE 200}Bump!{SIZE 100}\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Oops! I so sorry!\nYou not hurt, OK?\fI very busy.\fNo time for talking with you.\fNot good for me if seen by somebody.\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00002
lines.text: Oh no! You seen me already!\fI make big mistake!\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Hey, you! Forget you see me, OK?\nYou seen, heard, known nothing, OK?\fBye!\fBye-bye a go-go!\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Sorry, I’ll be out for a while.\nMisty, Gym Leader

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Since Misty’s out, we’ll be away, too.\nGym Trainers

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Cerulean City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Cerulean City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Misty\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Misty: I was expecting you,\nyou pest!\rYou may have a lot of Johto Gym Badges,\nbut you’d better not take me\ftoo lightly.\rMy Water-type Pokémon are tough!\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Misty: You really are good...\rI’ll admit that you are skilled...\rHere you go.\nIt’s the Cascade Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00010
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Cascade Badge from Misty!

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00011
lines.text: Misty: Here is another memento\nfrom this battle. Take it!\r

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00012
lines.text: Misty: It contains the move\nWater Pulse.\rIt can sometimes confuse your foe.\rYou’ve managed to defeat Trainers\nall the way from Johto.\fI’m sure you have a good use for it.

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00013
lines.text: Misty: Does Johto have a lot of\npowerful Trainers?\rI will someday go on my journey\nto battle with powerful Trainers!

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00014
lines.text: Yo! Legend in the making!\rSince Misty was away, I went out\nfor some fun, too.\fHe-he-he.

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00015
lines.text: Hoo, you showed me how tough you are.\rAs always, that was one great battle!

lines.label: msg_0469_T04GYM0101_00016
lines.text: ...!\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} picked up the black item\nthat was by the pool.\rIt’s a Part from a machine!\r

lines.label: msg_0470_T04PC0101_00000
lines.text: For battles, I’d much rather use\nPokémon I’ve been raising, even if\rthey’re weaker than some newly\ncaught Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0470_T04PC0101_00001
lines.text: The Magnet Train travels at over\n340 mph. It goes between Kanto and\fJohto in almost no time at all.\rIt really makes Johto accessible.

lines.label: msg_0471_T04R0101_00000
lines.text: Are you collecting\nKanto Gym Badges?

lines.label: msg_0472_T04R0201_00000
lines.text: I heard that some shady character is\nskulking about.\rI won’t stand for it if he turns out\nto be a thief.

lines.label: msg_0472_T04R0201_00001
lines.text: We were held up by robbers before.

lines.label: msg_0472_T04R0201_00002
lines.text: DIGLETT: Dug dug.

lines.label: msg_0473_T04R0301_00000
lines.text: My husband lives happily with Pokémon\nhe got through trades.\rI live happily having such a\ngreat husband.

lines.label: msg_0473_T04R0301_00001
lines.text: Ah... I’m so happy...

lines.label: msg_0473_T04R0301_00002
lines.text: KANGASKHAN: Garu garuu.

lines.label: msg_0473_T04R0301_00003
lines.text: ZUBAT: Zuba zubaa.

lines.label: msg_0474_T04R0401_00000
lines.text:
A long time ago, this cool boy rode my
Bike around, and that started this entire Bike boom.Then I decided to open a branch at
Goldenrod City.And they started selling like the wind!But no one comes to this shop anymore
because of that.All I have left here is a bicycle pump...Should I start selling inflatable tubes?

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00000
lines.text: That’s quite some building, eh?\nIt’s Kanto’s Radio Tower.

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00001
lines.text: Kanto has many good radio shows.

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00002
lines.text: People come from all over to pay their\nrespects to the spirits of Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00003
lines.text: You need a Poké Flute to wake\nsleeping Pokémon.\fEvery Trainer has to know that!

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00004
lines.text: Lavender Town\nThe Noble Town

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00005
lines.text: Kanto Radio Station\nYour Best-Loved Shows On-Air\fAround the Clock!

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00006
lines.text: Lavender Volunteer\nPokémon House

lines.label: msg_0475_T05_00007
lines.text: House of Memories\nMay Pokémon Spirits Rest Easy

lines.label: msg_0476_T05FS0101_00000
lines.text: Repel is a necessity if you are\ngoing to explore a cave.\rEven though I like exploring, I still\nhaven’t made it to all the caves.

lines.label: msg_0476_T05FS0101_00001
lines.text: I heard about a craftsman who\nmakes custom Poké Balls in the\fJohto town of Azalea.\rI wish I had some.

lines.label: msg_0477_T05PC0101_00000
lines.text: To the north of Lavender is\nthe Rock Tunnel.\rGo through it to get to the\nPower Plant.

lines.label: msg_0477_T05PC0101_00001
lines.text: There’s a radio show that plays\nPoké Flute music.\rOh? Ah, your radio needs an EXPN Card\nto tune in to it.

lines.label: msg_0477_T05PC0101_00002
lines.text: If the Power Plant isn’t running, the\nMagnet Train won’t run either...\rIt also means the Radio Station\ncan’t broadcast...

lines.label: msg_0477_T05PC0101_00003
lines.text: The Director of the Radio Station\nsure was happy.\rHe said they’re back on the air,\nbecause the Power Plant is running\fsmoothly again.

lines.label: msg_0478_T05R0201_00000
lines.text: Mr. Fuji does live here, but he’s\naway now.\rHe should be at the House of Memories.

lines.label: msg_0478_T05R0201_00001
lines.text: Can you believe it?\rSome people get bored with taking\ncare of Pokémon.\rGrandpa takes in such poor homeless\nPokémon and takes care of them.

lines.label: msg_0478_T05R0201_00002
lines.text: PSYDUCK: Gu-guwa?

lines.label: msg_0478_T05R0201_00003
lines.text: NIDORINO: Gyun!

lines.label: msg_0478_T05R0201_00004
lines.text: PIDGEY: Pijji!

lines.label: msg_0479_T05R0301_00000
lines.text: Lavender is a tiny, quiet town\nat the foot of the mountains.\rIt’s gotten a bit busier since the\nRadio Tower was built.

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00000
lines.text: Hello, there!\nI am the official Name Rater!\rWant me to rate the nicknames\nof your Pokémon? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00001
lines.text: Which Pokémon nickname should\nI critique, kid?

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\rBut, would you like me to give it\na much better name?\fHow about it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00003
lines.text: All right! Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?\r

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00004
lines.text: There! From now on, this Pokémon\nshall be known as {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!\rIt is a much better name than before!\nDon’t you agree?

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00005
lines.text: OK.\nSuit yourself.\rDo come visit again if you’ve changed\nyour mind.

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00006
lines.text:
There! From now on, this Pokémon
shall be known as {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!Not so different from before?
Your eyes are tricking you!This one is better.
How fortunate for you!

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00007
lines.text: Hmm.\n{STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}, is it?\rThat is a truly impeccable name!\rTake good care of {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!

lines.label: msg_0480_T05R0401_00008
lines.text: Huh...\nThat is merely an Egg!

lines.label: msg_0481_T05R0601_00000
lines.text:
Mr. Fuji: Welcome.Hmm... You appear to be raising your
Pokémon in a kind and loving manner.Those who love Pokémon come here to
pay their respects to Pokémon.Please pay homage to the spirits
of Pokémon.I’m sure that will make them happy.

lines.label: msg_0481_T05R0601_00001
lines.text: There are other resting places of\nPokémon here, I think.\rThere are many chambers that only\nMr. Fuji may enter.

lines.label: msg_0481_T05R0601_00002
lines.text: I came with my mom to visit\nPokémon resting places...

lines.label: msg_0481_T05R0601_00003
lines.text: The Pokémon that lived with me a\nlong time...\rI didn’t treat them as Pokémon!\fI loved them like my grandchildren...

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00000
lines.text: Welcome!\rFeel free to look around anywhere\non this floor.

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00001
lines.text: Sorry, but you can only tour the\nground floor.\rEver since Johto’s Radio Tower was\ntaken over by a criminal gang,\fwe have had to step up our security.

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00002
lines.text: Many people are hard at work here\nin the Radio Tower.\rThey must be doing their best to put\non good shows.

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00003
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no!\rWe’ve been off the air ever since the\nPower Plant shut down.\rAll my efforts to start this station\nwould be wasted if I can’t broadcast.\fI’ll be ruined!

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00004
lines.text: Ah! So you’re the {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} who\nsolved the Power Plant’s problem?\rThanks to you, I never lost my job.\nI tell you, you’re a real lifesaver!\fPlease take this as my thanks.\r

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00005
lines.text: Ah! So you’re the {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} who\nsolved the Power Plant’s problem?\rThanks to you, I never lost my job.\nI tell you, you’re a real lifesaver!\fPlease take this as my thanks.\r

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00006
lines.text: The Director loaded the EXPN Card\non {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Pokégear!\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}’s Pokégear has been\nupgraded!

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00007
lines.text: With that thing, you can tune in to\neven more radio programs here in\fKanto.\fGahahahaha!

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00008
lines.text:
Hey there!
I am the super Music Director!Huh? Your Pokégear can’t tune in to my
music shows.How unfortunate!If you upgrade it with the EXPN Card,
you can tune in. You’d better get one!

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00009
lines.text:
Hey there!
I am the super Music Director!I’m responsible for the gorgeous
melodies that go out over the air.Don’t be square. Grab your music
off the air!

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00010
lines.text: 1F Reception\n2F Sales\f3F Personnel\f4F Production\f5F Director’s Office\n

lines.label: msg_0482_T05R0701_00011
lines.text:
Perk Up Pokémon with Mellow Sounds
of the Poké Flute.The Poké Flute broadcast is only
available around the Kanto region.Try to tune in around the upper area
of the radio!

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00000
lines.text: Vermilion Port is Kanto’s\nseaside gateway.\rLuxury liners from around the world\ndock here.

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00001
lines.text: My Pokémon is preparing the land\nfor construction.\rBut I have no money to start\nthe project.

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00002
lines.text: MACHOP: Guooh gogogoh!

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00003
lines.text: There are eight Gyms in Kanto.\rThat big building is Vermilion’s\nPokémon Gym.

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00004
lines.text: Skilled Trainers gather in Kanto.\nGym Leaders are especially strong.\rThey won’t be easy to defeat.

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00005
lines.text: You’ve started to collect Kanto\nGym Badges?\rDon’t you agree that the Trainers\nhere are tough?

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00006
lines.text: I guess you’ll be finished with your\nconquest of Kanto Gyms soon.\rLet me know if you get all\neight Badges.

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00007
lines.text: Congratulations!\nYou got all the Kanto Gym Badges.\rI’ve got a reward for your efforts.\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00008
lines.text: PP Max is a powerful item that\nraises a move’s top PP to its maximum.\fIt can change the way you battle!

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00009
lines.text: PP Max is a powerful item that\nraises a move’s top PP to its maximum.\fIt can change the way you battle!

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00010
lines.text: Vermilion City\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00011
lines.text: Vermilion City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Lt. Surge\fThe Lightning American

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00012
lines.text: Pokémon Fan Club\nAll Pokémon Fans Welcome!

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00013
lines.text: Vermilion Port Entrance

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00014
lines.text: Eusine: That was so close!\nI thought I could corner it by\fambushing it here...\rBut running on the water...\nis beyond me.\rStill, I am starting to see a pattern.\fSUICUNE prefers water!\fThat means...\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00015
lines.text: Sorry, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nI’ve got to go!\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00016
lines.text:
Hi!
My name is Steven. The Champion from the Hoenn region.Have we met...before?That’s not possible.
All the Trainers I have battled seem to have the same look, anyway.Especially the ones who gave me
tough battles...

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00017
lines.text: Steven: By the way, have you heard of\na Pokémon called LATIAS?\rI am investigating why LATIAS,\na Pokémon from Hoenn, decided to\fleave Hoenn to come here.\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00018
lines.text: Steven: By the way, have you heard of\na Pokémon called LATIOS?\rI am investigating why LATIOS,\na Pokémon from Hoenn, decided to\fleave Hoenn to come here.\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00019
lines.text: LATIAS is a Pokémon that has a lot\nto do with Soul Dew, a gemlike Orb.\rConsidering the fact that LATIAS is now\nin Kanto, it is possible to assume that\fthis has to do with the Soul Dew.\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00020
lines.text: LATIOS is a Pokémon that has a lot\nto do with Soul Dew, a gemlike Orb.\rConsidering the fact that LATIOS is now\nin Kanto, it is possible to assume that\fthis has to do with Soul Dew.\r

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00021
lines.text:
LATIAS is a Pokémon that travels
a great distance.It’ll be difficult to find without any
machine to track it with.But any Trainer will be drawn to it,
won’t they?

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00022
lines.text:
LATIOS is a Pokémon that travels
a great distance.It’ll be difficult to find without any
machine to track it with.But any Trainer will be drawn to it,
won’t they?

lines.label: msg_0483_T06_00023
lines.text: Steven: I must go.\nMay our journeys cross again.\r

lines.label: msg_0484_T06FS0101_00000
lines.text: Team Rocket is no longer in Kanto.\nThat alone makes me happy.

lines.label: msg_0484_T06FS0101_00001
lines.text: I’m thinking about going shopping\nin Saffron.\rFollow the northern route, and you’ll\nbe there in no time.

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Lt. Surge: Hey, you little tyke!It may not be very smart to
challenge me, but it takes guts!When it comes to Electric-type Pokémon,
I’m number one!I’ve never lost on the battlefield.I’ll zap you just like I do all my
enemies in battle!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Arrrgh!\nYou are strong!\rOK, kid.\nYou get the Thunder Badge!\r

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Thunder Badge from Lt. Surge!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Lt. Surge: That Thunder Badge suits\nthose who’ve defeated me!\fTake good care of it, OK?\rThere is something else.\nHere is a great TM for you!\r

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Lt. Surge: That TM contains\nShock Wave... Zzzap!\rUse it to go like lightning!\rWhen you go north, you will see\na big city called Saffron!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Hey, kid!\nStill slugging and chugging away?\rWhen you go north, you will see a\nbig city called Saffron!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00006
lines.text:
Yo! Legend in the making!
You lucked out this time.The traps at this Gym have been out
of order for a while.But the traps are back up and
running now! Why lucky, you may ask...Because you can train yourself better
that way!Make up your mind and go for Lt. Surge!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Whew! That was an electrifying bout!\nIt sure made my nerves tingle.

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Nope! Nothing here but trash.

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00009
lines.text: ...\nOh, you found a secret switch at the\fbottom of the trash can!\fBetter press it.

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Nope! Nothing here but trash.\nOh no, the electric fence is\flocked again!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00011
lines.text: The first electric fence is unlocked!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00012
lines.text: The second electric fence is unlocked!\rNow the electric fences are gone, and\nthe path to the Leader is clear!

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00013
lines.text: Vermilion City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0485_T06GYM0101_00014
lines.text: Vermilion City Pokémon Gym\rGym Leader: Lt. Surge\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0486_T06PC0101_00000
lines.text: A sleeping Pokémon is lying in the\nmiddle of the road.\rIt’s a fantastic opportunity to get it,\nbut how do you wake it up?

lines.label: msg_0486_T06PC0101_00001
lines.text: There used to be a sleeping Pokémon\nlying in the middle of the road.\fBut it seems to have disappeared.

lines.label: msg_0486_T06PC0101_00002
lines.text: The Fast Ship is a great place to\nmeet and battle Trainers.

lines.label: msg_0486_T06PC0101_00003
lines.text: Oh? You have some Badges I’ve never\nseen before.\rOh, I get it. You got them in Johto.

lines.label: msg_0487_T06R0101_00000
lines.text:
I am the Fishing Dude, the elder of
the Fishing Bros.Have you met the Fishing Guru at
Lake of Rage?He dreams about seeing the world’s
greatest MAGIKARP.If you don’t mind, could you show him
any MAGIKARP you catch?Who knows, you may catch the
MAGIKARP of his dreams.

lines.label: msg_0487_T06R0101_00001
lines.text: You found something in between\nthe pages...\rIt’s a photo of people fishing...\nThey look identical!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00000
lines.text:
I’m the Chairman of the
Pokémon Fan Club.I’ve raised over 150 Pokémon.I’m very fussy when it comes
to Pokémon.Did you visit just to hear about
my Pokémon? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00001
lines.text:
Good! Then listen up!So...my precious RAPIDASH...It’s...cute...lovely...smart...
adorable...irresistible...plus... amazing... Don’t you think so? Oh, so...wild...beautiful... kind... I love it!Hug it... It’s warm and cuddly...
Oh, it’s...spectacular...captivating... simply divine... I treasure it... Oops! Look at the time! I’ve kept you too long!Thanks for hearing me out. I want to
give you this present!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00003
lines.text: It’s a Rare Candy that makes\nPokémon stronger.\rI prefer making my Pokémon stronger\nby battling, so you can have it.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00004
lines.text: Hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rDid you come see me about my\nPokémon again?\rNo? Oh... I had more tales to tell...

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00005
lines.text: Hello, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rDid you come see me about my\nPokémon again?\rNo? Oh... I had more tales to tell...

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00006
lines.text: How disappointing...\rCome back if you want to listen\nto me again!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00007
lines.text: Your Bag is jammed full.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00008
lines.text: Our Chairman is very vocal when it\ncomes to Pokémon...

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00009
lines.text: I love the way CLEFAIRY opens up\nits arms!\rIt’s so adorable!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00010
lines.text: I love CLEFAIRY, but I could never\ncatch one.\rSo I’m making do with a Poké Doll\nthat I found.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00011
lines.text:
I love CLEFAIRY, but I could never
catch one. So I’m making do with a Poké Doll that I found.What?
The girl who lost this Poké Doll is sad...!OK. Could you take this Poké Doll
back to that poor little girl?I’ll befriend a real CLEFAIRY on
my own one day!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00012
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe lost Poké Doll!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00013
lines.text: You watch. I’m going to get a\nreal CLEFAIRY as my friend.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00014
lines.text: Look at my darling BAYLEEF!\rThe leaf on its head is so cute\nand fashionable!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00015
lines.text: It’s a CLEFAIRY!\nHuh?\rOh, right. It’s a CLEFAIRY Poké Doll.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00016
lines.text: BAYLEEF: Li liif!

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00017
lines.text: Let’s all listen politely to\nother Trainers.

lines.label: msg_0488_T06R0301_00018
lines.text: If someone brags, brag right back!

lines.label: msg_0489_T06R0401_00000
lines.text: Do you know about the Magnet Train?\rIt’s a railway that connects\nKanto and Johto.

lines.label: msg_0489_T06R0401_00001
lines.text: Saffron! Saffron!\nI want to go to Saffron City to see\fthe Magnet Train.\rMagnet Train!

lines.label: msg_0490_T06R0601_00000
lines.text: Over many years, DIGLETT dug a\nlarge tunnel.\fThat tunnel goes to a distant town.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00000
lines.text: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\rI wonder if it will become a Frog\nPokémon someday.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00001
lines.text: POLIWRATH: Poli poli!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00002
lines.text: Oh, my!\nWere you staring at me?\rSeeing me come out of the Game Corner\nwith a whole pile of Coins...\fAnd grinning to myself?\fYou were, weren’t you?

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00003
lines.text: GRIMER started to appear recently.\nYou see the pond in front of the house?\rIt has GRIMER, too.\nI wonder where they came from.\rSigh...

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00004
lines.text: Ha ha! This Gym is great!\nIt’s full of strong Trainers!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00005
lines.text: I’ll tell you a secret!\rThe Celadon Condominiums have some\nplaces you can only reach by taking the\felevator on the second floor!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00006
lines.text: The restaurant there is having an\neating contest.\rI heard that we have a great\ncontestant from the Sinnoh region\fthis year.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00007
lines.text: The Celadon Department Store offers\nthe widest range of items!\fYou can buy anything you want!\r...Do I sound like their\nsales representative?

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00008
lines.text: I love this kind of place where\nthere are many buildings!\rI heard Johto also has a city called\nGoldenrod that has many\ftall buildings.\fI would love to visit there sometime.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00009
lines.text: Erika: Hi, Jasmine. I heard Whitney from\nGoldenrod Gym said you were too\fplain and should look more fancy.\fIs that true?\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00010
lines.text: Jasmine: Yes...\rI’m thinking maybe I should\nparticipate in this Contest in Sinnoh\fto try and be more vibrant...\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00011
lines.text: Erika: How did it go?\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00012
lines.text: Jasmine: I couldn’t bring myself to\ngo to the Contest.\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00013
lines.text: Erika: Oh, I see...\rThen why don’t you try putting on\nsomething especially gorgeous?\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00014
lines.text: Jasmine: Ah, yes!\nMaybe I can bring myself to\fenter the Contest!\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00015
lines.text: Erika: How about a fancy, light blue\noutfit with a cape over it?\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00016
lines.text: Jasmine: What?\nThat’s too embarrassing!\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00017
lines.text: Erika: I see.\nYou think Clair from Blackthorn is a\flittle embarrassing...\fI’m just taking notes.\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00018
lines.text: Jasmine: Oh, no!\nErika, that’s not what I meant!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00019
lines.text: Erika: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\rWould you like to\nexchange numbers? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00020
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Erika\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00021
lines.text: Erika: I am often free in the morning\non Sunday.\rCall me around then.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00022
lines.text: Erika: Oh, that’s too bad...

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00023
lines.text: Erika: Would you like to\nexchange numbers? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00024
lines.text: Erika: Hi!\nGood to see you here.\rHow would you like to take a picture\nwith me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00025
lines.text: Erika: Try and look cool now.\r

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00026
lines.text: Erika: Good job.\nIt looks good!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00027
lines.text: Erika: Oh, that’s too bad...

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00028
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC and delete\nsome pictures.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00029
lines.text: Jasmine: Amphy is well thanks to you.

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00030
lines.text: Celadon City\nCity of the Rainbow’s Colors

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00031
lines.text: Celadon City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Erika\fThe Nature-Loving Princess!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00032
lines.text: Find what you need at the\nCeladon Dept. Store!

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00033
lines.text: Celadon Condominiums

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00034
lines.text: Celadon Game Corner\nA Fun Place for Everyone

lines.label: msg_0491_T07_00035
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rGuard Spec. protects Pokémon\nfrom status-reduction moves\fduring battle.\rGet your items at the\nCeladon Dept. Store!

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Erika: Hello...
Lovely weather, isn’t it?It’s so pleasant...
I’m afraid I might doze off...My name is Erika.
I am the Leader of Celadon Gym....Oh? You are from Johto, you say? How nice...Oh. I’m sorry, I didn’t realize that
you wished to challenge me.I know.I have been training myself on
not only flower arrangement but also Pokémon battle.I shall not lose.

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Erika: Oh!\nI concede defeat...\rYou are remarkably strong...\nI shall give you the Rainbow Badge...\r

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Rainbow Badge.

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00003
lines.text:
Erika: That was a delightful match.
I felt inspired.Please, I wish you to have this TM19
as a special token.It is Giga Drain.
It is a wonderful move that drains half the damage it inflicts to heal your Pokémon.It is indeed a horrifying move.

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Erika: Losing leaves a\nbitter aftertaste...\rBut knowing that there are strong\nTrainers spurs me to do better...

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Celadon City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0492_T07GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Celadon City Pokémon Gym\rGym Leader: Erika\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0493_T07PC0101_00000
lines.text: That Pokégear you have--\nit’s way too cool!\rIs that the...latest model?

lines.label: msg_0493_T07PC0101_00001
lines.text: Erika is a master of Grass-type\nPokémon.\rShe’ll make you pay if you don’t\nwatch yourself.

lines.label: msg_0493_T07PC0101_00002
lines.text: The Game Corner in this city used\nto be run by Team Rocket...\rBut when Team Rocket was removed,\nthis rich, game-loving man renovated\fthe Game Corner for the fun of it.

lines.label: msg_0494_T07R0101_00000
lines.text: Hello! Welcome to the Celadon\nDepartment Store!\rThe directory is on the wall next to\nthe elevator.

lines.label: msg_0494_T07R0101_00001
lines.text: This department store is part of the\nsame chain as the one in Goldenrod City.\rThey were both renovated at the\nsame time.

lines.label: msg_0494_T07R0101_00002
lines.text: This is my first time here.\nIt’s so big...\fI’m afraid I’ll get lost.

lines.label: msg_0494_T07R0101_00003
lines.text: 1F: Service Counter\n2F: Trainer’s Market\f3F: TM Shop\f4F: Wiseman Gifts\f5F: Battle Collection\f6F: Rooftop Atrium

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00000
lines.text: I just recently became a Trainer.\fMy son encouraged me to do it.\rI’m impressed by the selection of\nconvenient items.

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00001
lines.text: My dad’s having a hard time learning\nthe names of items and how they are\fsupposed to be used...

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00002
lines.text: Top Grade Items for Trainers!\n2F: Trainer’s Market

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00003
lines.text: Wake: Hmm... Hmm... Humm...\r

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00004
lines.text: Wake: Ha! This is quite a mask...\r

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00005
lines.text:
Wake: Huh? You talking to me?Your eyes...are on my
Crasher Wake mask?No, no, no!
I can never let it go!...
Huh? That’s not it? You want the other mask?Hmm.
OK.

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00006
lines.text: Wake: What?\nThat’s not enough?\rYou’re quite a negotiator for your\nage... All right, I’ll give you this, too!\r

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00007
lines.text: Wake: ...\rArrr, all right, all right! I will give you\nthis much-valued one as well!\r

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00008
lines.text: Wake: It’s OK.\nI’ve already paid for you.\rPresents for you from the one\nwho wears masks the best.\fDon’t be shy.\fHa ha ha!\r

lines.label: msg_0495_T07R0102_00009
lines.text: Wake: Hmm... Hmm... Humm...\rHa! This is quite a mask...

lines.label: msg_0496_T07R0103_00000
lines.text: I can’t decide which Pokémon I\nshould use this TM on...

lines.label: msg_0496_T07R0103_00001
lines.text: Uh-oh! I traded my Pokémon without\nremoving the Up-Grade from it.

lines.label: msg_0496_T07R0103_00002
lines.text: Yeah! I’m finally getting a PORYGON!\rI’m no good at the Coin game,\nso I could never get enough Coins...\r...Huh?\rI traded PORYGON, and it turned into a\ndifferent Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0496_T07R0103_00003
lines.text: The TM Shop sells\nsome rare moves.

lines.label: msg_0496_T07R0103_00004
lines.text: Make Your Pokémon Stronger!\n3F: TM Shop

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00000
lines.text: Falkner: Out of all the Trainers\nout there, the best Trainer would\fhave to be my dad.\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00001
lines.text: Janine: Ha!\nYou don’t know a thing!\rThe best Trainer in the world is Koga,\none of the Elite Four!\fNamely--my dad!\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00002
lines.text: Falkner: You are mistaken.\nMy dad treats Poké...\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00003
lines.text: Janine: Please stop this!\nWhy don’t you just admit that my dad\fis the true Trainer!\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00004
lines.text: Falkner: You were listening, right?\nYou agree my dad is\fgreater, right? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00005
lines.text: Falkner: You do?\nJust as I thought!\rYou know something?\nI’m sure we’ll enjoy talking about\fmy dad!\fHere is my number!\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Falkner\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00007
lines.text: Falkner: Give me a call on Saturday\nmorning if you want to hear about\fmy dad!

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00008
lines.text: Falkner: You don’t?\nI thought you were smarter than that.\rOh, well.\fYou’ll change your mind eventually.

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00009
lines.text: Falkner: So, you did change your mind.\nYou now think my dad\fis greater? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00010
lines.text: Falkner: Hey, why don’t we take\na picture together? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00011
lines.text: Falkner: All right!\nAre you ready?\r

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00012
lines.text: Falkner: Yes!\nWe look good.

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00013
lines.text: Falkner: That’s all right.\nI’ll just take one with my dad...

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00014
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC and delete\nsome pictures.

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00015
lines.text: Janine: Bah!

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00016
lines.text: I’m here to buy Bloom Mail to send\nto my girlfriend.

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00017
lines.text: You know what?\rTunnel Mail is finally available\nat this department store!\rPreviously, it was only sold\nin Violet City.

lines.label: msg_0497_T07R0104_00018
lines.text: Gifts to Express Yourself!\n4F: Wiseman Gifts

lines.label: msg_0498_T07R0105_00000
lines.text: I want to buy some items that raise\nPokémon stats, but I don’t have\fenough money...

lines.label: msg_0498_T07R0105_00001
lines.text: Do you know PP UP?\rIt raises the Max PP of moves.\rI thought I would find it here,\nbut they say you can’t buy it...\fRats!

lines.label: msg_0498_T07R0105_00002
lines.text: Using items on them makes\nPokémon happy.\fThey hate certain items, though...

lines.label: msg_0498_T07R0105_00003
lines.text: Bring Out Pokémon Potential\n5F: Battle Collection

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00000
lines.text:
A vending machine with a 
prize roulette...It makes you happy when you get
something for free even if it’s worth only $200.Happiness does not come from how much
things are worth.It is up to the heart of the one to
receive it...

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00001
lines.text: Aww! There are no games here!\nI wanted to play...

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00002
lines.text: Have a Break at the Vending Machines\n6F: Rooftop Atrium

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00003
lines.text: It’s a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00004
lines.text: Clang!\rA can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0} dropped down.\r

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00005
lines.text: Clang!\rBonus! Another can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}\ndropped down.\r

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00006
lines.text: Not enough money...

lines.label: msg_0499_T07R0106_00007
lines.text: Decided not to buy a drink.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00000
lines.text: Hello.\rTo which floor may I take you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00001
lines.text: I look forward to serving you again.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00002
lines.text: Certainly.\nElevator going up!\r

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00003
lines.text: Certainly.\nElevator going down!\r

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00004
lines.text: Uh... We are already on that floor?

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00005
lines.text: First floor has the Service Counter\nand the main entrance.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00006
lines.text: Second floor has the Trainer’s Market\nwhere you can buy everything you need.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00007
lines.text: Third floor has the TM Shop\nto power up your Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00008
lines.text: Fourth floor has the Wiseman Gifts,\nwhich has the perfect gifts.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00009
lines.text: Fifth floor has the Battle Collection\nto raise stats.

lines.label: msg_0500_T07R0107_00010
lines.text: Sixth floor has the Rooftop Atrium\nfor a nice break.

lines.label: msg_0501_T07R0201_00000
lines.text:
Do you need anything?
I am the manager of the condominiums.It’s pretty safe around here, so I
don’t have much to do.I like to take my Pokémon out to
occupy myself....By the way, we have two
elevators here. Don’t get confused.

lines.label: msg_0501_T07R0201_00001
lines.text: MEOWTH: Meow!

lines.label: msg_0501_T07R0201_00002
lines.text: CLEFAIRY: Clef cleff!

lines.label: msg_0501_T07R0201_00003
lines.text: NIDORAN♀: Kya kyaoo!

lines.label: msg_0501_T07R0201_00004
lines.text: Please take this elevator\nto go to the third floor.

lines.label: msg_0502_T07R0202_00000
lines.text: Please take this elevator\nto go to the roof.

lines.label: msg_0502_T07R0202_00001
lines.text: This elevator goes straight between\nthe first and the third floors.

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00000
lines.text: I’m the Game Director!\rFilling up your Pokédex is tough,\nbut don’t give up!\rYou can do it! Seriously!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00001
lines.text: Wow, you did it!\nYou have filled up the\fJohto Pokédex!\rImpressive! I’m amazed!\nI will reward you for that!\fSeriously!\r

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00002
lines.text:
Wow! Excellent!
You completed your Pokédex! Congratulations!You must be the genius of the century!
Seriously!Game Freak will give you an award
and prove that it’s the truth!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00003
lines.text: I bet it was a long way to complete\nthe Pokédex.\rRemember, the most precious thing of\nall was the time you’ve worked hard\fgoing everywhere to complete\fthe Pokédex.\rI just said something deep! Seriously!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00004
lines.text: I am the Graphic Designer!\nI am a skilled dot artist!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00005
lines.text: I am the Programmer!\rI control the world of games\nwith my fingertip!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00006
lines.text: I am the Planner!\nI come up with great ideas!\rThis place you’re standing\nhere is no exception! Hahaha!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00007
lines.text: I am the Sound Designer!\nI compose music.\rI’ll give you something cool if you\nmanage to collect all eight\fKanto Badges and show them to me.

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00008
lines.text:
I am the Sound Designer!
I compose music.Wow, you have collected
all the Kanto Badges already! That’s great!I’ll give you something cool
for that.

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00010
lines.text:
GB is a rectangular thing with a
black-and-white screen that you used to play the original Pokémon... Oh, wait! That was a Game Boy!Turn it on and GB Sounds will let you
hear some nostalgic sounds.It’s a gadget full of wonder!
Try it at various places!There are some places you won’t
hear classic music...But that’s life!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00011
lines.text:
I find GB Sounds to be incredible!
Even places that were built recently have nice, classic music.Behold the full extent of my passion!...Did I say “behold”? What am
I saying?Anyway, try it at various places!There are some places you won’t
hear classic music...But that’s life!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00012
lines.text: Lyra: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00013
lines.text: Ethan: Hey, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\r

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00014
lines.text:
Lyra: Guess what?That Sound Designer over there
showed me something cool.It’s a hi-tech, retro machine to
listen to music from the Game Boy!He said he’ll give it to anyone
who has collected all of the Kanto Badges.Why don’t you go for it, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?
See ya!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00015
lines.text:
Ethan: Guess what?That Sound Designer over there
showed me something cool.It’s a hi-tech, retro machine to
listen to music from the Game Boy!He said he’ll give it to anyone
who has collected all of the Kanto Badges.Why don’t you go for it, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?
See ya!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00016
lines.text: Game Freak\nDevelopment Room

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00017
lines.text: This elevator goes straight between\nthe second floor and the roof.

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00018
lines.text: It’s the game program.\rMessing with it could ruin it.\nYou cannot touch it!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00019
lines.text: Pokémon stickers are everywhere\non the desk!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00020
lines.text: There are many photo collections\nand books about myths!

lines.label: msg_0503_T07R0203_00021
lines.text:
What do you think?I am the President here.We are remaking an old game,
but this is quite a challenge.Old fans would not want us to mess
with their good memories... but there is no point in just redoing the same thing, right?We are working toward something
that brings back memories, yet is also completely new!I’ve been in this business for 20 years
now, but creating a game is always a rewarding challenge!

lines.label: msg_0504_T07R0204_00000
lines.text: High places--I do love them so!\rI’d say the only thing that loves\nheights as much as me is smoke!

lines.label: msg_0505_T07R0205_00000
lines.text: Let me recount a terrifying tale...\r

lines.label: msg_0505_T07R0205_00001
lines.text: Then again, it’s not as scary while\nit’s still light outside.\rCome back after sunset, OK?

lines.label: msg_0505_T07R0205_00002
lines.text:
Once upon a time, there was a little
boy who was given a new Bicycle... He wanted to try it right away...He was having so much fun that he
didn’t notice that it was already dark...While riding home in the pitch-black
night, the Bike suddenly slowed!The pedals became heavy!The Bike began slipping
backward as if it was dragged by someone!It was as if the Bike were cursed and
trying to drag him into oblivion!......Shrieeeek!The boy had been riding uphill on
Cycling Road!...

take this item--Spell Tag!

lines.text: Yo, legend in the making!\nDo you play this Coin game, too?\rI’ve been trying for the prize Pokémon,\nbut that’s a tough game to beat!

lines.text: I was hoping to buy some Safari Zone\nsouvenirs, but it’s not open!\rI thought it was closed today,\nbut actually it’s gone!\rI never saw it coming.

lines.text: The Safari Zone has been moved\nto Johto...\rI hear that now the son of the Warden\nis going to run Pal Park!

lines.text: Have you been to the Pal Park?\rThe Safari Zone Warden’s son is\nrunning it with his wife.\rIt must run in their family to\nmanage parks.

lines.text: Fufufufu...\nI’m sorry to disappoint you...\rI’m only joking! I’m the real deal!\rJanine of Fuchsia Gym, that’s me!\r

lines.text: Yo, legend in the making!\nWhoops! Take a good look around you.\rThe Trainers all look like the\nGym Leader, Janine.\rWhich of them is the real Janine?

lines.text: That was a great battle,\nTrainer from Johto!

lines.text: Fooled you!\nHahaha!\r

lines.text: Wahahaha!\rYou betcha! I’m Janine!\r

lines.label: msg_0514_T08GYM0101_00010

lines.label: msg_0514_T08GYM0101_00015

lines.label: msg_0514_T08GYM0101_00016

lines.text: Yes! You agreed to participate!\nLet’s not waste any time!\rLet me explain how Pal Park works.\nWhat should I explain? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00003
lines.text:
Pal Park is a place where you are
timed on the catching of six Pokémon.You are provided with six special
Poké Balls for the challenge.Participating Trainers are required to
supply the six Pokémon that are to be caught.If you do not supply the stock of six
Pokémon, you may not participate in the Catching Show....Would you like to know
anything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00004
lines.text:
At the start of the Catching Show,
you will be given six Park Balls.Use the Park Balls to catch the
six Pokémon you provide....Would you like to know
anything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00005
lines.text:
Insert a Game Boy Advance Pokémon
Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed, or LeafGreen in the Game Pak slot.Six of the currently caught Pokémon
can migrate from the Game Pak to the DS Game Card when your DS is turned on and you select “MIGRATE FROM...”Please note that you cannot insert a
GBA Game Pak into a Nintendo DSi to migrate....Would you like to know
anything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00006
lines.text: Would you like to take part in\na Catching Show now? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00007
lines.text: Aww, that’s too bad.\rWell, just give me a shout again\nif you’d like to participate.

lines.text: Yes! You agreed to participate!\nLet’s not waste any time!\rLet me explain how Pal Park works.\nWhat should I explain? {YESNO 0}

lines.text: I’m sorry you had to retire.\nI’ll take what Park Balls you\fhave left.\rNext time, please do stay to catch\nall six Pokémon.

lines.text:

have no room for six more Pokémon.You won’t be able to accept them,
even if you do catch them.Make enough room in a PC Box and
come back for your Catching Show.

Congratulations!
That’s all six Pokémon caught!The audience sure enjoyed watching
your Catching Show.All right, let’s see your all-important
score from this show!...
...Catching Points: {STRVAR_1 53, 0, 0}!Time Points: {STRVAR_1 53, 1, 0}!Type Points: {STRVAR_1 53, 2, 0}!The total is......
...{STRVAR_1 53, 3, 0} points!

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00017
lines.text: Wow! That’s an outstanding record!\nKudos to you!\r

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00018
lines.text: Good! That’s a decent record.\nProps to you!\r

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00019

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00020

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00021
lines.text: Oh, then it might be fun for you to\ngo for an even better score by\ftrying to catch these six again.\rIf you want to do another Catching\nShow, just come see us!

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00022
lines.text: If you want to do another Catching\nShow, come see us again, please!\r

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00032

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00033
lines.text: I’ve heard Trainers complain that\nrare Pokémon take longer to appear.\rIs it easier to start with common\nPokémon?

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00034
lines.text:
Oh, me?
No, I never catch Pokémon myself. But I enjoy Catching Shows a lot.I love to see Johto and Hoenn Pokémon,
especially.The regions I’ve never been to
are so mysterious.

lines.label: msg_0516_T08R0201_00035
lines.text:
I feel so happy that I’d like to share
my happiness with you today.I must crown you with this...
Crown.Oh, before you get the wrong idea,

powerful.And, at last, I’ve been accepted into
the Elite Four. I can only keep getting better! Losing is not an option!

lines.text: Our city was featured on a\nradio show.\rIt’s nice to hear praise for your\ncity, but it’s a bit embarrassing, too.

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00001
lines.text: I went to the Gym, raring for battles\nagainst Trainers...\rIt turns out, I stumbled into the\nunused Gym next door.\fBoy, I was pretty embarrassed.

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00002
lines.text: This is the house of the Copycat girl.\rShe is so good at being a copycat\nof the way people talk that it’ll\fconfuse you when you talk to her.

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00003
lines.text: The Copycat girl looked unhappy.\rShe said she lost her cherished\nPoké Doll--CLEFAIRY.

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00004
lines.text: Going into an alley for the first time\nmakes me sorta anxious.

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00005
lines.text:
Chomp... Chew...The manager of the Power Plant
used to be a repairman in a small factory.Chew... Chew...His hard work has taken him up the
ladder to eventually become the manager of the Power Plant. Chew... Gulp...Quite impressive, don’t you think?
Haaah, I’m full!

lines.label: msg_0529_T11_00006
lines.text: This is Silph Co., famous for\nPokémon merchandise.\rIn the past, Team Rocket wanted the\ncompany because of that.

lines.label: msg_0533_T11R0101_00027

lines.text: This is a problem!\rThe machine at the Power Plant\nis broken, and we’re not receiving\felectricity!\rI don’t know how long it will be until\nwe can get the Magnet Train going.

lines.text: Thanks to someone who got the\nPower Plant up and running,\fthe Magnet Train is available again!\rPassengers need to go through the\ngate for the automatic ticket check...\r

lines.text: Enjoy the attractive and magnetic\njourney!\r

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00008
lines.text: The Magnet Train is a super-modern\nrail liner that uses electricity and\fmagnets to attain incredible speeds.\rHowever, there isn’t any electricity.\nIt’s just an iron box.

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00009
lines.text: Whew...\rHow many times have I gone back\nand forth between Kanto and Johto?

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00010
lines.text: Before the Magnet Train station was\nbuilt, there was a house here.\rA little girl who was called Copycat\nused to live in it.

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00011
lines.text: Hi. Do you have a Magnet Train Pass?\rI have one.\rAll the people in Saffron who ride the\nMagnet Train have Passes.

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00012
lines.text:
Lt. Surge: Oh! I never expected to see
you at a place like this! What a coincidence!I can feel great electric power around
the Magnet Train station!You had a PIKACHU, didn’t you?
How about trading it for my French PIKACHU? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00013
lines.text: Lt. Surge: My PIKACHU and\nyour PIKACHU up for a trade,\fwhat do you think?

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00014
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Wow! Electrifying!\nLet’s trade ’em now!\r

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00015
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Shocking!\nI want to share my feelings for\fPIKACHU with you!\rI’m ready anytime, so just bring\na PIKACHU, OK?

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00016
lines.text: Lt. Surge: Yeah!\nI’m so ecstatic! I’ll see you around.\fGood-bye!\r

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00017
lines.text: Lt. Surge: What? That is not\nthe right Pokémon!\rI won’t trade my PIKACHU for\nanything other than PIKACHU.

lines.label: msg_0535_T11R0601_00018
lines.text: We request that you make sure your\nPokémon are well behaved or put away\fin their Poké Balls so they won’t lick\fother passengers’ faces.\fThank you.

lines.label: msg_0536_T11R0602_00000
lines.text: We have arrived at Saffron! Saffron!\nThe accent is on the “a”!\r

lines.text: Welcome. This is Silph Co.’s\nhead office building.

lines.text:
Hey, you! The elevator there is out of
order now.Something is wrong with the electricity,
and it won’t work right.I feel sorry that you wasted a trip,
so here is a gift for you!

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00002
lines.text: It’s Silph Co.’s latest product.\nIt’s not for sale anywhere yet.

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00003
lines.text: This elevator is out of order.\rIt may electrocute you. Stay away.

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00007
lines.text:
Steven: We meet again!
Have you been to Hoenn before?It’s such a beautiful place, with the
clearest ocean you can imagine.You should visit sometime. Hey!Why don’t we trade Pokémon?I’ve been looking for FORRETRESS.
I can trade my BELDUM for it. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00008
lines.text: Steven: Will you trade FORRETRESS\nfor my BELDUM? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00009
lines.text: Steven: OK, let’s trade!\r

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00010
lines.text: Steven: That’s too bad.

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00011
lines.text: Steven: Are you telling me that\nyou think that’s a FORRETRESS?

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00012
lines.text: Steven: You don’t see FORRETRESS in\nthe Hoenn region.\rIt’s my first time to actually see one.\nThank you so much!\rOh, look at the time. I really must go.\r

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00013
lines.text:
Steven: This Pokémon seems to like
you a lot. Do you happen to like Steel-type Pokémon?I had a feeling.
That particular texture!The cool and glowing bodies!
Such uniquenesses are only for Steel-type Pokémon!When it comes to the solitariness and
nobleness you sense through the  rugged body, which is almost rebuffing when you hug, nothing comes close to BELDUM, I must say...In short, my METAGROSS is
truly strong and cool!...
Oh, it seems that I got carried away.It was a pleasure talking to you.
Bye!

lines.label: msg_0537_T11R0701_00014
lines.text: Hello...\nYou’re breaking up...\fI think it depends on how my dad feels.\rI see...\nI’ll be on my way. See you soon.\r

lines.text: Steven: I see...\nFor the choice you’ve made,\fI’d like to give you this Pokémon.\rExcept your party is full.\rWhy don’t you go to the PC to make\nsome room? I’ll be waiting here.

There is a mysterious notebook here.
Its age is impossible to tell.“It was by pure chance that I obtained
information about the Pokémon ROTOM.“Remarkably, ROTOM has the ability to
enter and merge with special motors.“It’s now known that ROTOM can stay
inside a motor almost indefinitely.“However, it will emerge if it enters a
Union Room or a Wi-Fi Club.“ROTOM will also emerge from the motor
if it is left at the Day Care.“ROTOM may also forget certain moves
when it leaves a motor.“This Pokémon requires
exhaustive observation and analysis.“To ensure I get all the credit,
my ROTOM research must be kept secret.“They will come to revere me as the
scientific genius Char...”The rest of the notebook is blank.

lines.text:
Professor Elm: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
I’ve been waiting for you!Do you know anything about
my research?As you know, Pokémon are carried
in Poké Balls these days.But before the Poké Ball was invented,
people used to walk with Pokémon. Just like your friend Lyra does!Poké Balls are great because you can
carry many Pokémon.But walking with Pokémon must have
some advantages.It could have something to do with how
Pokémon grow or evolve...So I’m going to give you a Pokémon!Can you walk beside this Pokémon,
outside of its Poké Ball, to see if this brings any special feelings or bonds between Pokémon and people?The device over there has some Pokémon
you could choose from...

lines.text:
When you first catch a Pokémon,
it may be weak.But it will eventually grow to
be strong.It’s important to treat Pokémon
with love.

lines.label: msg_0557_T22FS0101_00001
lines.text: Pokémon can hold items like a Potion\nor an Antidote.\rBut they don’t appear to know how\nto use man-made items.
