lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Falkner: I’m Falkner, the Violet City
Pokémon Gym Leader!People say you can clip Flying-type
Pokémon’s wings with a jolt of electricity...I won’t allow such insults to bird
Pokémon!I’ll show you the real power of the
magnificent bird Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00001
lines.text:
Falkner: ...For pity’s sake!
My dad’s cherished bird Pokémon...But a defeat is a defeat.
All right.Take this official Pokémon
League Badge. This one is the Zephyr Badge.

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Zephyr Badge from Falkner!

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Falkner: With that Badge, Pokémon,\nincluding traded Pokémon up to Lv. 20,\fwill obey you without question.\rIt also enables you to use the hidden\nmove Rock Smash anytime outside\fof battle.\r

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00004
lines.text:
Falkner: By using a TM, a Pokémon will
instantly learn a new move.Think before you act--a TM can be
used only once.TM51 contains Roost.
It restores half the max HP.There are Pokémon Gyms in cities and
towns ahead. Make good use of them!As for your next move... I would suggest Azalea Town.

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00005
lines.text:
Falkner: There are Pokémon Gyms in
cities and towns ahead.You should test your skills at
these Gyms.As for your next move... I would suggest Azalea Town.I’m going to train harder to become
the greatest Bird Keeper of all!

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00006
lines.text:
Yo! Champ in the making!
You must be here to challenge Falkner, the Gym Leader, right?You are quite welcome.
...Almost!This city has a tower called the
Sprout Tower where Trainers come to train themselves.Challenging Falkner may be too
difficult if you haven’t gone through their training. Ha ha ha!

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00007
lines.text:
Yo, Champ in the making!
I’m no Trainer, but I can give some advice! Believe me! If you believe, then a Championship dream can come true.You believe?
Then listen.The Grass type is weak against the
Flying type. Keep this in mind.

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Nice battle! Keep it up, and you’ll\nbe the Champ in no time at all!

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Violet City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0558_T22GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Violet City Pokémon Gym\rGym Leader: Falkner\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00009
lines.text: A guy named Bill made the Pokémon\nPC storage system.\rYou can access the Pokémon storage\nsystem using the PC at the reception\fthere. Why don’t you try it once?

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00010
lines.text:
It was about three years ago.
This group of thugs called Team Rocket was involved in wrongdoing. They were abusing Pokémon.But!
Bad things never last!A boy did a wonderful job and
Team Rocket was disbanded!

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00011
lines.text: Pokémon are really smart.\nTraded Pokémon might not listen to you\fright away. For example, high-level\fPokémon sometimes refuse to obey\fwhen you don’t have enough Gym Badges.

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00012
lines.text: Primo: Hello!\nI should be a familiar face to every\fPokémon fan. I’m from the TV show,\f“The Show Me Show!”\rI am Primo, the big brother!\rToday, would you, one of my fans,\ntell me what you think of me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00013
lines.text: Primo: Oh my...!\nIs that how you feel about me?!\rI never thought of it that way before.\nBy the way, how do you like the\fway I am so exciting and fun?\r

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00014
lines.text: Primo: Truly?\rThat gives me all-new energy so\nI can work even harder!\rGreat feedback! It’ll help me a lot.\nThank you for your continued support!

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00015
lines.text:
You cannot possibly mean that you are
not interested in the big brother...?Arrgh, that cannot be true!
You are just busy right now, aren’t you? That must be it!Why don’t you answer my questions
when you’ve got time for me?See you!

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00016
lines.text:
Primo: ...!You are no ordinary fan, knowing such
a thing!You’re a Trainer, right?
I’ll pull some strings for you.I think I can swing a deal to get you
a new wallpaper for your PC Boxes.Make sure you keep your channel
tuned to “The Show Me Show!”And don’t forget about me, the
big brother!

lines.text: Hmm...\rCan you tell me what kind of Trainer\nyou like best?\r

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00022
lines.text: Which kind of Trainer would you like\nto be? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00023
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 14, 0, 0} is the kind of Trainer\nyou want to be? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00024
lines.text: I see! So {STRVAR_1 14, 0, 0} is the kind\nof Trainer you like.\rIf that’s the case, others may\ncome to see you in the same way.\r

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00025
lines.text: Talk to me again if you want to\nlet me know what kind of Trainer\fyou like best.

lines.label: msg_0559_T22PC0101_00026
lines.text:
Hello! You’ve been mistaken for
{STRVAR_1 14, 0, 0}, haven’t you?But I think you can also pass for
a different kind of Trainer.So, how about telling me what kind of
Trainer you like?

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00000
lines.text: Earl, I am!\nWonderful are Pokémon, yes!\rTeach you I will to be a better Trainer!\rWhat you want to know?\nWant to be a winner is you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00001
lines.text: Good! Teach you, I will!\nIn battle, Pokémon top on list,\fthe walking one, jump out first!\rChange order in list, make battle\neasy, maybe!\rMore from me you want to hear? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00002
lines.text: So, want to know how to raise\nPokémon well? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00003
lines.text:
Fine! Teach you, I will!
If Pokémon come out in battle even briefly, some Exp. Points it gets.Keep out weak Pokémon,
switch in battle quick!This way, weak Pokémon very
strong become! More from me you want to hear? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00004
lines.text: So, want to know how to\nbattle well? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00005
lines.text:
Fine! Teach you, I will!
Pokémon have goods and bads because many types.High-level Pokémon not win always
if bad types.Pokémon with good types
for the foe, you choose. Smart battle, it is!

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00006
lines.text: Oh! Smart student you are!\nNothing more do I teach!\rGood to Pokémon you must be!

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00007
lines.text: I’m taking notes of the teacher’s\nlecture.\rI’d better copy the stuff on the\nblackboard, too.

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00008
lines.text: I traded my best Pokémon to the\nguy beside me.

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00009
lines.text: Huh? The Pokémon I just got is\nholding something!

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00010
lines.text: ...Some Berries can restore a\nPokémon’s health.\rMany other items can be held\nby Pokémon...\rIt sure is tough taking notes...

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00011
lines.text:
Pokémon have what are called
abilities!It seems that each kind of Pokémon has
distinct abilities.They say these abilities come in handy
in battle!

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00012
lines.text: The blackboard explains Pokémon\nstatus changes in battle.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00013
lines.text: Read which topic? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00014
lines.text: If poisoned, a Pokémon steadily\nloses HP.\rThe poison lingers after the battle,\nand HP is lost as you walk.\fTo cure it, use an Antidote.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00015
lines.text: Paralysis reduces speed and may\nprevent movement.\rIt remains after battle, so use\na Parlyz Heal.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00016
lines.text: If asleep, your Pokémon can use only\ncertain moves, such as Sleep Talk and\fSnore.\rA sleeping Pokémon doesn’t wake up\nafter battle.\fWake it up with an Awakening.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00017
lines.text: A burn consumes HP, little by little,\nand also reduces the Attack stat.\rA burn lingers after battle.\nUse a Burn Heal as the cure.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00018
lines.text: If your Pokémon is frozen,\nit can’t do a thing.\rIt remains frozen after battle.\nThaw it out with an Ice Heal.\r

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00019
lines.text: It’s this kid’s notebook...\r“Catch Pokémon using Poké Balls.\nUp to six can be in your party.”\rKeep reading? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00020
lines.text: “Before throwing a Poké Ball, weaken\nthe target first.”\r“A poisoned or burned Pokémon is\neasier to catch.”\rKeep reading? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00021
lines.text: “Some moves may cause confusion.\nConfusion may make a Pokémon attack\fitself.”\r“Leaving battle clears up any\nconfusion.”\rKeep reading? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0560_T22R0301_00022
lines.text: “People who catch and use Pokémon\nin battle are called Pokémon Trainers.”\r“They are expected to visit Pokémon\nGyms and defeat other Trainers.”\rThe next page is... Blank!\r

lines.text: A Pokémon you get in a trade\ngrows quickly.\rBut if you don’t have the right Gym\nBadge, they may disobey you.

lines.label: msg_0562_T22R0601_00001
lines.text: I collect Pokémon.\nDo you have BELLSPROUT?\rWant to trade it for my ONIX? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0562_T22R0601_00002
lines.text: Yay! I got myself BELLSPROUT!\nThanks!

lines.label: msg_0562_T22R0601_00003
lines.text: Huh? That’s not BELLSPROUT.\fWhat a letdown...

lines.label: msg_0562_T22R0601_00004
lines.text: You don’t want to trade? Aww...

lines.label: msg_0562_T22R0601_00005
lines.text: Hi, how’s my old ONIX doing?

lines.label: msg_0563_T22R0701_00000
lines.text: Lately, I don’t see people coming\nfrom Goldenrod City.

lines.label: msg_0563_T22R0701_00001
lines.text: Things are busy lately, because\nwe have many people coming\ffrom Goldenrod and Ecruteak!

lines.label: msg_0563_T22R0701_00002
lines.text: Plants are also living things!\nThey would want to move\faround from time to time!

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00000
lines.text: Ilex Forest Ahead\nEnter through the gate.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00001
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: ...Tell me something.Is it true that Team Rocket has
returned?What? You beat them? Hah!
Quit lying.Are you serious?
Then let’s see how good you are.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00002
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: I hate the weak.Pokémon, Trainers.
It doesn’t matter who or what.I hate to see them hanging around.
That goes for Team Rocket, too.They think they are big and tough
as long as they are in a group.But get them alone, and they’re weak.
I hate them all.You stay out of my way.
You won’t be an exception if you get in my way.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00003
lines.text: Nothing is going on.\nIt’s unsafe to go in there, so I’m\fstanding guard to make sure\fpeople don’t wander in.\rAm I not a good Samaritan?

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00004
lines.text: Do you know about SlowpokeTail?\nI heard it’s tasty!\rAren’t you glad I told you that?

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00005
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom town...\rI heard their tails are being sold\nsomewhere.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00006
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE have returned.\rKnowing them, they could’ve just been\ntaking it easy somewhere.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00007
lines.text: Did you come to get Kurt to make\nsome Poké Balls?\fA lot of people do just that.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00008
lines.text:
Cut through Azalea and you’ll be in
Ilex Forest.But these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.The Charcoal Man’s Pokémon can cut
down trees.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00009
lines.text: SLOWPOKE: ...\r...\r

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00010
lines.text: ...Yawn?

lines.text: Azalea Town\nLiving Happily with Pokémon

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00012

lines.text: Azalea Town Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Bugsy\fThe Walking Bug Pokémon Encyclopedia

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00014
lines.text:
SLOWPOKE Well
Also known as the Rainmaker Well.Locals believe that a SLOWPOKE’s
yawn summons the rain.Records show that a SLOWPOKE’s yawn
ended a drought 400 years ago.

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00015
lines.text: Charcoal Kiln\rWe let our FARFETCH’D fetch branches\nfor charcoal!

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00016
lines.text:
Who are you?
You don’t know us?We are...
Team Rocket!...What?
We broke up a while ago?Give me a break!
We have not broken up!Actually we did once.
But we have come back to pursue Giovanni’s ambition.Enough talking.
Shut up and just beat it!

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00017
lines.text: {SIZE 200}Thud!{SIZE 100}\r

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00018
lines.text: We have this tough guy called Kurt\nin this town.\fHe should be able to take care of it...

lines.label: msg_0564_T23_00019
lines.text: I knew we could count on Kurt!

lines.label: msg_0565_T23FS0101_00000
lines.text: The number of Gym Badges you have\nshows how strong a Trainer you are.\rThe more Badges you have, the\nbetter the items you’ll see in shops!

lines.label: msg_0565_T23FS0101_00001
lines.text: A Great Ball is better for catching\nPokémon than a Poké Ball.\rBut Kurt’s might be better sometimes.

lines.label: msg_0566_T23GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Yo, challenger!
Bugsy made this Gym. It’s a huge nest of Bug-type Pokémon.Bugsy’s young, but he’s a master of
Bug-type Pokémon!It’s going to be tough without
my advice.Let’s see... Bug-type Pokémon don’t
like fire.Flying-type moves are
super effective, too.

lines.label: msg_0566_T23GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Well done! That was a great clash\nof talented young Trainers.\rWith people like you, the future of\nPokémon is bright!

lines.label: msg_0566_T23GYM0101_00002
lines.text: Azalea Town Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0566_T23GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Azalea Town Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Bugsy\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00000
lines.text:
Bugsy: I’m Bugsy!
I never lose when it comes to Bug-type Pokémon.My research is going to make me
the authority on Bug-type Pokémon!Let me demonstrate what I’ve learned
from my studies.

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00001
lines.text: Bugsy: Whoa, amazing!\nYou’re an expert on Pokémon!\rMy research isn’t complete yet.\nOK, you win. Take this Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Hive Badge from Bugsy!

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00003
lines.text:
Bugsy: Do you know the benefits of the
Hive Badge?If you have it, Pokémon up to Lv. 30
will obey you, even traded ones.Pokémon that know Cut will be able
to use it outside of battle, too.Here, I also want you to have this.

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00005
lines.text: Bugsy: TM89 contains U-turn.\rIt lets your Pokémon attack, then\nswitch with the next Pokémon\fin your party.\rIsn’t that great?

lines.label: msg_0567_T23GYM0102_00006
lines.text: Bugsy: Bug-type Pokémon are deep.\nThere are many mysteries to explore.\rStudy your top choices thoroughly.

lines.label: msg_0568_T23PC0101_00000
lines.text:
Do any of your Pokémon know...
what they call the hidden moves?When a Pokémon faints, it just means
it doesn’t have the power to battle.But it can still use hidden moves
outside of battle!

lines.label: msg_0568_T23PC0101_00001
lines.text: Bill’s PC can store up to 30\nPokémon per Box.

lines.label: msg_0568_T23PC0101_00002
lines.text:
Do you know what an Apricorn is?You crack it open to discard the core
and put it in this special machine... Then you can catch Pokémon!Before Poké Balls became available,
everybody used Apricorns to catch Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0569_T23R0101_00000
lines.text: Ilex Forest is big. Be careful!\nDon’t get lost.

lines.label: msg_0569_T23R0101_00001
lines.text: The forest is watched over by\nits protector.\rStay out of mischief!

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00000
lines.text: All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom the town.\rThe forest’s protector may be\nangry with us...\rIt may be a bad omen. We should stay in.

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00001
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE have returned...\rBut my FARFETCH’D haven’t come back.\nMy apprentice has gone to look for them\fin the Ilex Forest.\rIt’s been ages now.\nWhere in the world is that lazy guy?

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00002
lines.text: You chased off Team Rocket and went to\nIlex Forest alone?\rThat takes guts!\nI like that. Come train with us.

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00003
lines.text: Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?\nAre they out playing somewhere?

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00004
lines.text: I’m sorry--I forgot to thank you.\nThis is Charcoal that I made.\rFire-type moves will become\nmore powerful when a Pokémon\fholds that.

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00005
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Charcoal!

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00006
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even\nfound FARFETCH’D.\fYou’re the coolest, man!

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00007
lines.text: Uh-oh, your Bag is chock-full.

lines.label: msg_0570_T23R0201_00008
lines.text: FARFETCH’D: Kwaa!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00000
lines.text:
Hm? Who are you?{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, eh? You want me to make
some Balls?Sorry, but that’ll have to wait.Do you know Team Rocket?
Ah, don’t worry. I’ll tell you anyhow.Team Rocket’s an evil gang that
uses Pokémon for their dirty work.They’re supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.Anyway, they’re at the well, cutting
off SlowpokeTails for sale!So I’m going to go give them a
lesson in pain!Hang on, SLOWPOKE!
Old Kurt is on his way!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00001
lines.text:
Kurt: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
You handled yourself like a real hero.As I mentioned before, Team Rocket was
disbanded by a boy called Red three years ago.Now that they have come back...
I have a bad feeling about it...In any case, it would please me greatly
to make Poké Balls for a Trainer like you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. This is all I have now, but take it.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00003
lines.text: Kurt: I make Poké Balls from Apricorns.\rCollect them from trees and bring\n’em to me.\rI’ll make Poké Balls out of them.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00004
lines.text: Kurt: You have Apricorns for me?\fFine! I’ll turn them into Poké Balls.\r

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00005
lines.text: Kurt: It’ll take a day to make you a\nPoké Ball. Come back for it later.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00006
lines.text: Kurt: Oh...\nThat’s a letdown.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00007
lines.text: Kurt: I’m working!\nDon’t bother me!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00008
lines.text: Kurt: Ah, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\fI just finished your Poké Ball. Here!\r

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00009
lines.text: Kurt: Your Bag is full!\nCome back when it’s lighter.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00010
lines.text: Kurt: That turned out great.\rTry catching Pokémon with it.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00011
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE are gone...\nWere they taken away by bad people?

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00012
lines.text: Grandpa’s gone...\nI’m so lonely...

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00013
lines.text: The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came\nback! Its tail has grown back, too!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00014
lines.text: Dad works at Silph where he studies\nPoké Balls.\rI have to stay home with Grandpa\nand SLOWPOKE.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00015
lines.text: That’s right!\nI’ll give you my grandpa’s number. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00016
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Kurt\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00017
lines.text: My grandpa can tell you more\nabout Apricorns.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00018
lines.text: No? Why?\nYou don’t want to talk to my grandpa?

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00019
lines.text: You want to talk to my grandpa,\ndon’t you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00020
lines.text: SLOWPOKE: ...\nYawn?

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00021
lines.text: You see three people, with landscape\nin the background.\rIt’s Kurt, Professor Oak, and...\nin the middle,\fa lady with determined eyes.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00022
lines.text: It’s a statue of the forest’s\nprotector.

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00023
lines.text: The radio is on.\rIt’s Professor Oak’s Pokémon Talk!

lines.label: msg_0571_T23R0501_00024
lines.text: The radio is declaring the revival\nof Team Rocket!

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00000
lines.text: You crossed the sea to get here?\rThat must have been hard.\rIt would be much easier if your\nPokémon knew how to Fly...\r

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00001
lines.text: But you can’t use Fly without this\ncity’s Gym Badge.\rIf you beat the Gym Leader here,\ncome see me.\fI’ll have a nice gift for you.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00002
lines.text: That’s Cianwood’s Gym Badge!\rThen you should take this HM.\r

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00004
lines.text: Teach Fly to your Pokémon.\rYou will be able to Fly instantly\nto anywhere you have visited.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00005
lines.text: My husband lost to you, so he needs\nto train harder.\rThat’s good, since he was getting a\nlittle chubby.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00006
lines.text: Your Bag is full.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00007
lines.text: His only hobby is to battle\ntough Trainers.\rDo you want to have my\nhusband’s phone number? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00008
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Chuck\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00009
lines.text: He takes a break from the pounding\nwaterfall on Wednesday nights.\rHe should be able to chat with\nyou then.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00010
lines.text: Oh, I see.\nMy husband won’t be a good match?

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00011
lines.text: Do you want to exchange your\nnumber for my husband’s? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00012
lines.text: If you use Fly, you can get back\nto Olivine instantly.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00013
lines.text: Boulders to the north of town can\nbe crushed.\rThey may be hiding something.\nYour Pokémon could use Rock Smash to\fbreak them.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00014
lines.text: Chuck, the Gym Leader, spars with\nhis Fighting-type Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00015
lines.text:
Eusine: Yo, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.Wasn’t that SUICUNE just now?I only caught a quick glimpse, but I
thought I saw SUICUNE running on the waves.SUICUNE is beautiful and grand.
And it races through towns and roads at simply awesome speeds.It’s wonderful...I want to see SUICUNE up close...I’ve decided.
I’ll battle you as a Trainer to earn SUICUNE’s respect!Come on, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
Let’s battle now!

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00016
lines.text:
You’re amazing, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!I’m starting to understand why SUICUNE
was keeping an eye on you.I’m going to keep searching
for SUICUNE.I have a feeling we’ll see each other
again. See you around!

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00017
lines.text: There are several islands between\nhere and Olivine.\rA mythical sea creature supposedly\nlives there.

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00018
lines.text: Cianwood City\nA Port of Crashing Waves

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00019
lines.text: Cianwood City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Chuck\fHis Roaring Fists Do the Talking

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00020
lines.text: Cianwood City Pharmacy\r500 Years of Tradition\nWe Await Your Medicinal Queries

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00021
lines.text: This is the house of Cameron,\nthe Photographer.\fTake a Snapshot as a Keepsake!

lines.label: msg_0572_T24_00022
lines.text:
Entrance to the road for the
Safari Zone.Experience thrilling encounters
with wild Pokémon for heart-to-heart contact!The Safari Zone is just around the
corner from this entrance!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Chuck: Ooomph!
The pounding waterfall right onto my head... Arrgh!Why did you stop the waterfall from
pouring on me!You just spoiled my training!
I have to warn you that I am a strong Trainer training every day under this waterfall!What?
It has nothing to do with Pokémon?...
That’s true!...
...Come on. We shall do battle!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Chuck: Urggh!\n...\rOooarrgh!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00002
lines.text: There! Scared now, are you?\rWhat?\nIt has nothing to do with Pokémon?\fThat’s true!\fCome on. We shall do battle!\r

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Chuck: Hmm... I lost?\rHow about that!\nAll right. You’re worthy of\fthe Storm Badge!\r

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Storm Badge from Chuck!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Chuck: The Storm Badge lets your\nPokémon Fly to any city or town you’ve\falready been to!\rHere, take this, too!\r

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Chuck: That is Focus Punch.\rIt doesn’t land if the foe you’re\nattacking hits you first, but it’s very\fpowerful if it manages to hit!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Argh... Your Bag is jammed full!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Chuck: Wahahah!\nI enjoyed battling you!\rBut a loss is a loss!\rFrom now on, I’m going to train\n24 hours a day!

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00009
lines.text: He’s so into his training, he\ndoesn’t seem to notice you.

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00010
lines.text: There is a large winch.\nWill you turn it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00011
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} turned the winch\nwith pure might!\r

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00012
lines.text: It won’t turn anymore.

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00013
lines.text: Cianwood City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0574_T24GYM0101_00014
lines.text: Cianwood City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Chuck\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00000
lines.text: Have you met the maniac in this city?\rHe’s always bragging about his\nrare Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00001
lines.text: You can’t help showing off the Pokémon\nyou have, don’t you agree?\rI’d love to show mine to a friend of mine\nwho lives in Violet...

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00002
lines.text:
The Pokémon at this Gym are all rough
and tough.They could blow me away in a second. Let me give you a piece of advice.The Gym Leader uses Fighting-type
Pokémon.You can try to fool them with
Psychic-type Pokémon.Or simply defeat them before they
can demonstrate their power.By the way, Chuck, the Gym Leader,
is into his waterfall training.He won’t be able to hear you unless
you somehow stop the pounding water.

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00003
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! You won, didn’t you?\nYour face tells me you did.

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00004
lines.text:
Huh? Do you happen to...
have only one Pokémon?That must be hard on you.
...That’s right!
I’ll give you a TENTACOOL!I just caught a little too many.
I was going to release it, so take it. Go ahead!

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00005
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe TENTACOOL!

lines.label: msg_0575_T24PC0101_00006
lines.text: Want to give a nickname to\nthe TENTACOOL? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00000
lines.text:
I... I’m in shock!A guy about your age with piercing
eyes and long hair came in.He scared me into giving him my
prized Pokémon!I still have one left, but what if
he comes back?You look strong.
Could you look after my Pokémon for a while? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00001
lines.text: Oh, thank you!\nTake good care of it, please!\r

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\na Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00003
lines.text: Your Pokémon party is full.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00004
lines.text: Oh, no... What’ll I do if he comes back?

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00005
lines.text: Hi! How’s my Pokémon?\rI think I’m safe now, so may I have\nit back? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00006
lines.text: Hi! How’s my Pokémon?

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00007
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00008
lines.text: Hey, that’s not my Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00009
lines.text: My Pokémon has come to like you.\rAll right, you should keep it.\nBut promise to be good to it!

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00010
lines.text: Oh, no, no...\nThat’s the same as being robbed.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00011
lines.text: For Pokémon, happiness is being\nwith a person who treats them well.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00012
lines.text: Huh?\nIt’s holding an item.\fYou should keep that.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00013
lines.text: Huh?\nIts Poké Ball has a Ball Capsule on it!\fPlease remove it.

lines.label: msg_0576_T24R0201_00014
lines.text: Huh?\nYou...only have one Pokémon!\fYou can’t give it back to me then.

lines.label: msg_0577_T24R0501_00000
lines.text: Huh? You need medicine?\nYour Pokémon appear to be fine.\fIs something worrying you?\r...\rThe Lighthouse Pokémon is in trouble?\rI got it!\fThis ought to do the trick.

lines.label: msg_0577_T24R0501_00002
lines.text: My SecretPotion is a tad too strong.\fI only offer it in an emergency.

lines.label: msg_0577_T24R0501_00003
lines.text: What’s up?\nNeed some medicine? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0578_T24R0601_00000
lines.text:
Hi. You must be a sightseer!
Why not take a picture here?You saw the camera outside?
I put it there!You may come across my relatives
here and there.Anyway, go ahead and take a picture!
Check the camera, and it’ll take a picture for you.It’ll be a good memory of your
journey with your Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0579_T24R0701_00000
lines.text: You came from Olivine?\rDo you remember the four islands\nalong the way?\rI heard that a mythical sea creature is\nhiding in them.

lines.label: msg_0579_T24R0701_00001
lines.text: I heard that you can only see it if\nyou have a Silver Wing.\rIt must have the same scent as\nthe creature.

lines.label: msg_0579_T24R0701_00002
lines.text: I’ve heard that the whirlpools around\nthe islands are caused by the\fsea creature.\rYou might need a special move to\nget past them.

lines.label: msg_0580_T24R0801_00000
lines.text:
I don’t remember the last time
someone came to visit me.When I was young, I was a
Pokémon Trainer, too. I tried to reach the tower and dive into the ocean.I put a lot of effort into many things.
Well, I take things easy now, listening to the waves and winds on this beach.

lines.label: msg_0580_T24R0801_00001
lines.text:
Have you heard of the Bell Tower
in Ecruteak?There are what they call Clear Bells
on top of the tower.They don’t make a single noise
in strong winds.There is only one way to make them ring.It is to obtain another Clear Bell just
like the ones at the top of the tower. I went after it when I was young. But I never got one...

lines.label: msg_0580_T24R0801_00002
lines.text:
Have you heard of Whirl Islands?There are what they call Tidal Bells
at its waterfall basin.They don’t make a single noise
in crashing waves.There is only one way to make them ring.It is to obtain another Tidal Bell just
like the ones at the waterfall basin. I went after it when I was young. But I never got one...

lines.label: msg_0580_T24R0801_00003
lines.text:
Oh! You’ve managed to get a Clear Bell?The old-time dream of mine...
I see... You’ve done it......
...I can hear it!The chime of the bells on the wind
coming from the direction of the Bell Tower...

lines.label: msg_0580_T24R0801_00004
lines.text:
Oh! You’ve managed to get a Tidal Bell?The old-time dream of mine...
I see... You’ve done it......
...I can hear it!The chime of the bells on the sea
breeze coming from the direction of the Whirl Islands...

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00000
lines.text: They built the new Radio Tower to\nreplace the old, creaky one.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00001
lines.text: Have you visited the Pokéathlon Dome?\nIt is a huge sports facility where\fPokémon compete with each other.\rIt was quite a sight!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00002
lines.text: I know there’s a new Bike Shop,\nbut I can’t find it anywhere.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00003
lines.text: The fact that you have a Bike...\nmeans you got it from a Bike Shop,\fright?\rAll right!\nI can say that there is a Bike Shop\fsomewhere in this city!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00004
lines.text: Is that man in black dressed up\nlike a Team Rocket member?\fHow silly!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00005
lines.text: Was that man in black really part\nof Team Rocket?\fI can’t believe it!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00006
lines.text:
The Radio Tower in Goldenrod City is
a landmark.They’re running a promotional campaign
right now.They’ll modify your Pokégear so it can
also serve as a radio.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00007
lines.text:
The Radio Tower in Goldenrod City is
a landmark.They’re running a promotional campaign
right now.They’ll modify your Pokégear so it can
also serve as a radio.Oh, your Pokégear works as a radio!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00008
lines.text: E-he-he-he...\nI got in trouble for playing in the\fbasement of the department store.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00009
lines.text: The man at that tent rates your\nPokémon names.\rHe can even rename your Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00010
lines.text: I think I’ll give my Pokémon cool\nnicknames as a reward if they do\fwell in the Pokéathlon.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00011
lines.text: Whew! This is one big town.\nI don’t know where anything is.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00012
lines.text: I know that you can find the\nPokéathlon Dome when you take\fRoute 35 north and go past the\fleft gate...\rBut I seem to get lost every time\nI come to this town...

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00013
lines.text: So this is the Radio Tower...\r

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00014
lines.text: What do you want, you pest?\nScram!\r

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00015
lines.text: What are you doing?\nGet to your position right away!\r

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00016
lines.text: Pokémon? They’re nothing more than\ntools for making money!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00017
lines.text: We are on guard here.\nDon’t you worry!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00018
lines.text: Take over the Radio Tower...\rWhat? It’s none of your business!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00019
lines.text: You look awfully young...\nAre you new?

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00020
lines.text: Hey, brat! You don’t belong here!\fGet lost!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00021
lines.text: Hey, hey!\nI’ve got this covered!\rWhy don’t you go to the Radio Tower?

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00022
lines.text: Friendship with Pokémon?\rThat makes me laugh!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00023
lines.text: Our dream will soon come true...\nIt was such a long struggle...

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00024
lines.text: Who are you? A newcomer?\rWe’ve run out of Team Rocket\nuniforms.\rOne of my guys is going to get more...\rWhat’s taking him so long?\rThe studio in the tunnel is just around\nthe corner.

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00025
lines.text: For a young one like you to decide\nto become a member of Team Rocket...\fThat’s great, kiddo!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00026
lines.text: Get out of my way!\rWe, as Gym Trainers, will never allow\nTeam Rocket to do nasty things here\fin our city!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00027
lines.text: Tee hee!\rYou Gym Trainers can be a problem.\nStay in the Gym and stay out of\fthe way!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00028
lines.text: The Gym Leader, Whitney, went flying by\nsaying, “I have got to\fget a Radio Card!”

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00029
lines.text: Wh-what are you trying to do?\nCan’t you see this cool, pitch-black\funiform I’m wearing?\rYou’re not afraid of Team Rocket? Huh?

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00030
lines.text: You don’t appear scary enough to be a\nTeam Rocket member in that uniform...\fMake a scarier face and say, “Yeee!”\rAll the while, clenching your teeth!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00031
lines.text: Where do you think you’re going?\nWe are right in the middle of\fthe mission!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00032
lines.text: Where do you think you are going?\nThe Radio Tower is not here!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00033
lines.text: The GTS lets you trade Pokémon\nall over the world!\r...Except that we have something\nmore important to do right now!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00034
lines.text: If you love to trade so much, wait until\nthe Radio Tower mission is over.\rThen you’ll have plenty of time!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00035
lines.text: Slow down!\rI’m the only one who was sent here.\fDon’t give me any more trouble, OK?\r

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00036
lines.text: Johto-Kanto Magnet Train Line\nGoldenrod City Station

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00037
lines.text: Goldenrod City Radio Tower\rA Network Providing Johto\nwith Interesting Information

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00038
lines.text: Goldenrod City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Whitney\fThe Incredibly Pretty Girl!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00039
lines.text: Goldenrod City\nA Happening Big City

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00040
lines.text: Bike Shop Goldenrod Branch\nThe World is a Cycling Path!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00041
lines.text: Goldenrod City Game Corner\nA Safe and Sound Playground!

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00042
lines.text: Name Rater\nGet Your Pokémon Nicknames Rated

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00043
lines.text: Watch Out!\nGet Off Your Bike in the Tunnel

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00044
lines.text: Be Careful!\nGet Off Your Bike in the Tunnel

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00045
lines.text: The Global Terminal\rAn Amazing and Completely\nGlobal Terminal!\n

lines.label: msg_0581_T25_00046
lines.text: Goldenrod Flower Shop\rA Small Shop Providing\nLots of Beauty

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00000
lines.text: Whitney: Hi! I’m Whitney!\r...You!\nI saw you at the Radio Tower just now.\rEveryone was into Pokémon, so I got\ninto it, too!\rPokémon are super cute!\rYou want to battle?\fI’m warning you--I’m good!\r

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Whitney: Sob...\r...Waaaaaaah!\nYou’re mean!\rYou shouldn’t be so serious!\nYou...you child, you!

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00002
lines.text: Whitney: Waaaaah!\rWaaaaah!\r...Snivel, hic.\n...You meanie!

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Whitney: Sniff...\rWhat? What do you want? A Badge?\rOh, right. I forgot.\nHere’s the Plain Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Plain Badge from Whitney.

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Whitney: The Plain Badge lets your\nPokémon use Strength outside\fof battle.\rOh, you can have this, too!\r

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00007
lines.text:
Whitney: It’s Attract!
It makes full use of a Pokémon’s charm.Isn’t it just perfect for a cutie
like me? That’s right!I heard that this thing called the
Pokéathlon Dome is now open right next to the National Park.You should go try it, since you’re
so good at battling with your Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Whitney: Ah, that was a good cry!\rCome for a visit again! Bye-bye!

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Oh, no. You made Whitney cry.\rIt’s OK. She’ll stop soon.\nShe always cries when she loses.\r

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Yo! Champ in the making!\rThis Gym is home to Normal-type\nPokémon Trainers.\rI recommend you use Fighting-type\nPokémon.

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00011
lines.text: You won? Great! I was busy admiring\nthe powerful Trainers here.

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00012
lines.text: Goldenrod City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0582_T25GYM0101_00013
lines.text: Goldenrod City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Whitney\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00000
lines.text: The Colosseum upstairs is for\nlink battles.\rBattle records, such as how many times\nyou had link battles and the results,\fare recorded on the back of your\fTrainer Card.

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00001
lines.text: Oh, you are a Team Rocket member...

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00002
lines.text:
I wonder how many kinds of Pokémon
there are in the world.A long time ago, Professor Oak said
there were 150 different kinds...Since then, many new Pokémon have
been discovered in different regions.There are almost 500 different kinds
known now...

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00003
lines.text: Team Rocket...!

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00004
lines.text:
A higher level Pokémon doesn’t
always win.After all, it may have a type
disadvantage.I don’t think there is a single
Pokémon that is the toughest.

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00005
lines.text: I think I’ve met you before...\rYou must have a reason for\nlooking like that...?

lines.label: msg_0583_T25PC0101_00006
lines.text: Hey, I don’t mind restoring a Pokémon’s\nhealth, even when they belong to\fTeam Rocket...\rBut stay away from other places, OK?

lines.label: msg_0584_T25R0201_00000
lines.text: Sigh... I opened a branch here,\nbut I can’t sell my Bicycles.\fWhy is that?\rCould you ride a Bicycle and\nadvertise for me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0584_T25R0201_00001
lines.text: Really? Great!\rGive me your name and phone number,\nand I’ll loan you a Bicycle. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0584_T25R0201_00003
lines.text:
The main shop is at Cerulean
back in Kanto.Say hello to the shop manager
if you happen to go there!Our Bicycles are first-rate!
You can ride them in Kanto, too!

lines.label: msg_0584_T25R0201_00004
lines.text: Sigh... Oh, for the kindness\nof people...

lines.label: msg_0584_T25R0201_00005
lines.text: It’s a shiny new Bicycle!

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00000
lines.text: If you treat your Pokémon nicely,\nthey will love you in return.\rOh? Let me see your Pokémon...\r

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00001
lines.text: It looks really happy!\nIt must love you a lot.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00002
lines.text: I get the feeling that it really\ntrusts you.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00003
lines.text: It’s friendly toward you.\nIt looks sort of happy.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00004
lines.text: It’s quite cute.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00005
lines.text: You should treat it better.\nIt’s not used to you.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00006
lines.text: It doesn’t seem to like you at all.\nIt looks mean.

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00007
lines.text: I keep losing in battles, and my\nPokémon end up fainting...\rMaybe that’s why my Pokémon don’t\nlike me much...

lines.label: msg_0585_T25R0301_00008
lines.text: When I use an item on my Pokémon,\nit acts really glad!

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00000
lines.text:
Bill: Hi, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! Would you do
something for me and take this EEVEE?It came over when I was adjusting
Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.Someone has to take care of it,
but I don’t like being outside.Can I count on you to play with it,
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00001
lines.text: Bill: I knew you’d come through!\nYou’re the real deal! Way to go!\fOK, I’m counting on you.\fTake good care of it!\r

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe EEVEE!

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00003
lines.text: Bill: Professor Elm said EEVEE can\nevolve into seven different kinds\fof Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00004
lines.text: Whoa, wait. You can’t carry any\nmore Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00005
lines.text: Oh... Now what to do?

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00006
lines.text: Bill: I used to do experiments on\ntransferring things.\rBoth the GTS and Nintendo Wi-Fi\nConnection were inspired by\fmy machine that transfers things!

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00007
lines.text: Give a nickname to\nthe EEVEE you received? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00009
lines.text: Oh, you collect Pokémon?\nMy son Bill is an expert.\rHe just got called to the Pokémon\nCenter in Ecruteak City.

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00010
lines.text: Whatever happens, it makes me happy\nto see my own son.

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00011
lines.text: My big brother Bill made the\nPokémon Storage System.

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00012
lines.text: Are you a Trainer?\rI’ve got a useful phone number\nfor you. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00013
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Bill\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00014
lines.text: My brother made the\nPokémon Storage System.\rI was going to give you Bill’s number...

lines.label: msg_0586_T25R0401_00015
lines.text: When you call my brother, he can tell\nyou about the PC Boxes where you\fstore your Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00000
lines.text: The train hasn’t come in...\rI know! I’ll carry the passengers on\nmy back!\rThat won’t work.

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00001
lines.text: The Magnet Train is back in service!\rPassengers need to go through the\ngate for the automatic ticket check...\r

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00002
lines.text: ...Beep!\rI am so sorry, but you need a\nMagnet Train Pass to get on\fthe Magnet Train...\r

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00003
lines.text: Passengers need to go through the\ngate for the automatic ticket check...\r

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00004
lines.text: Ping...fwip!\nHere is your Pass back.\rThis train is about to leave\nfor Saffron City.

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00005
lines.text: Enjoy the attractive and magnetic\njourney!

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00006
lines.text: We are arriving at Goldenrod!\nGoldenrod! The accent is on the “o”!

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00007
lines.text: Enjoy the attractive and magnetic\njourney!\r

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00008
lines.text: I’m the President.\rMy dream was to build a train that\nis faster than any Pokémon.\rIt really brings Johto much closer\nto Kanto.

lines.label: msg_0587_T25R0501_00009
lines.text: We request that you make sure you\nrefrain from keeping large Pokémon out\fat the station.

lines.label: msg_0588_T25R0502_00000
lines.text: We have arrived at Goldenrod!\nGoldenrod! The accent is on the “o”!\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00000
lines.text:
Apparently, there is an odd tree
on Route 36.They say it dances when you
water it...Oh, of course not!This is a Flower Shop, so we do have
watering cans and things like that...But I cannot let you have one!
It’s too dangerous! Hmmm...Well, maybe if you manage to defeat
the Goldenrod Gym Leader, it might be OK...

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00001
lines.text:
Apparently, there is an odd tree
on Route 36.They say it dances when you water it...Oh, that’s a Plain Badge from
Goldenrod Gym!Did you defeat Whitney?!
Well, then there’s nothing to worry about, is there?I’ll let you use this SquirtBottle for
a while then... Oh, never mind. Keep it!

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00002
lines.text: The odd tree is on Route 36.\nPlease be careful!

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00003
lines.text: Lalala lalalala.\nHave plenty of water, my lovely!\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00004
lines.text: Are you using the Berry Pots?\rYou can pick any of the Berries you\nhave planted.\rDon’t forget to water them!

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00005
lines.text: How...\n...\f...\f...\fcute!\rWhere did you get that...\noh-so-cute Pokémon?\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00006
lines.text: SHAYMIN, is it?\nIt’s so cute!\rI know!\rLet me give it a flower!\nI have just the one for it!\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00007
lines.text: The Gracidea will look perfect on\nSHAYMIN!\fPut it on SHAYMIN in the daylight.

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00008
lines.text: Mulch!\nAnyone want Mulch?\rBerries love Mulch.\nIt makes Berries grow faster!\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00009
lines.text: That {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0} is a mix of\nhigh-quality soil and Pokémon’s...\fer...you know...\rIt’s full of nutrients!\nBerries will surely benefit from it.

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00010
lines.text: Thank you.\nPlease come again!

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00011
lines.text: You bought the {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}.\r

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00012
lines.text: Ouch!\nYour Bag is full!

lines.label: msg_0589_T25R0601_00013
lines.text: Well... Excuse me, but\nyou’re short of money.

lines.label: msg_0590_T25R0801_00000
lines.text: Once while I was battling, my Pokémon\ncouldn’t use any moves.\rThe Power Points, or PP, of its\nmoves were all gone.

lines.label: msg_0590_T25R0801_00001
lines.text: Sometimes, a healthy Pokémon\nmay be unable to use its moves.\rIf that happens, heal it at a\nPokémon Center or use an item.

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00000
lines.text: Hello, hello!\nI am the official Name Rater!\rWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour Pokémon? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00001
lines.text: Which Pokémon’s nickname should\nI critique?

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}, is it? Hmm...\nThat is a decent nickname!\rBut, I can give it a nicer name?\nHow about it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00003
lines.text: OK, then. What shall the new\nnickname be?\r

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00004
lines.text:
Done!
How about that?From now on, this Pokémon
shall be known as {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!It is a better name than before,
isn’t it? Good for you!

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00005
lines.text: Ah, good. I see.\nDo come visit again if you change\fyour mind.

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00006
lines.text: Done! From now on, this Pokémon\nshall be known as {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!\rIt looks no different from before?\nThat’s just you!\fThis is vastly superior!\fHow fortunate for you!

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00007
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable nickname!\rTake good care of {STRVAR_1 1, 0, 0}!

lines.label: msg_0591_T25R0901_00008
lines.text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an Egg!

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00000
lines.text: Welcome to the Goldenrod\nDepartment Store.

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00001
lines.text: The department store has a\ndecent selection.\rBut some items are only available\nas Game Corner prizes.

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00002
lines.text: What kind of business would a\nTeam Rocket member have here?\rWe aren’t selling sanity here.

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00003
lines.text: I’m raring to shop again today!

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00004
lines.text: Be it Team Rocket, “Team Pocket,” or\nwhatever...leave me alone!\rI’m busy shopping and have no time\nto waste!

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00005
lines.text: Mom’s good at bargain hunting.\rShe always buys stuff at lower prices.

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00006
lines.text: Mom told me to stay away from\npeople in black suits.

lines.label: msg_0592_T25R1001_00007
lines.text: 1F Service Counter\n2F Trainer’s Market\f3F Battle Collection\f4F Medicine Box\f5F TM Corner\f6F Rooftop Atrium

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00000
lines.text: The ladies at this department store\neven greet kids like me with respect.\rThat’s what I call professional!

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00001
lines.text: The ladies at this department store\nnever change their attitude.\rBe it in front of a regular customer\nor a Team Rocket member.\rThat’s what I call professional!

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00002
lines.text: The existence of this department store\ntells me that Goldenrod is a big city.\rThe selection here is unmatched\nanywhere else.

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00003
lines.text: You better listen to me.\rQuit being a Team Rocket member\nalready!

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00004
lines.text: I got my ABRA at the Game Corner.\fNow it’s my best partner.

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00005
lines.text: Oh, Team Rocket!\nPlease don’t take my ABRA away!

lines.label: msg_0593_T25R1002_00006
lines.text: Your Travel Companion\n2F Trainer’s Market

lines.label: msg_0594_T25R1003_00000
lines.text: I-I-I’m really impatient!\rI use X Speed in battle to speed up\nmy Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0594_T25R1003_00001
lines.text: Oh my...\nTeam Rocket has reached here already!

lines.label: msg_0594_T25R1003_00002
lines.text: Hey! When you battle, do you use\nX Special?\rIt’s awesome. It really jacks up\nSpecial Attack!

lines.label: msg_0594_T25R1003_00003
lines.text: I never thought about it, but\nTeam Rocket does go shopping...

lines.label: msg_0594_T25R1003_00004
lines.text: For Victory Seekers\n3F Battle Collection

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00000
lines.text: Hey. I love strong Pokémon.\rI feed them Protein to crank up\ntheir Attack.

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00001
lines.text: I consider myself a bad guy,\nbut I never liked hanging around\fother bad ones like Team Rocket.

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00002
lines.text: Iron adds to your\nPokémon’s Defense.

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00003
lines.text: Team Rocket...\nWhat are you doing here?

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00004
lines.text: Some Pokémon evolve only\nthrough trading.\rI know of four: MACHOKE, KADABRA,\nHAUNTER, and, um, GRAVELER.\fI heard there are others, too.

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00005
lines.text: Even Team Rocket wouldn’t steal their\nown members’ Pokémon, would they?

lines.label: msg_0595_T25R1004_00006
lines.text: Let Us Pump Up Your Pokémon!\n4F Medicine Box

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00000
lines.text: Hello. Oh, your Pokémon...\r

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00001
lines.text: It’s very attached to you.\rThis move should be perfect for a\npair like you.\r

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00003
lines.text: It’s adorable!\rYou should teach it good TM moves.

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00004
lines.text: It looks a little bit evil.\nHow about this TM for it?\r

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00006
lines.text: There are sure to be TMs that are\njust perfect for your Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00007
lines.text: Mystery Gift.\rWith just a little beep, you get a gift.

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00008
lines.text: The Mystery Gift option is not\ncompatible with Game Boy Color.

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00009
lines.text: I collect Pokémon.\nDo you have a DROWZEE?\rWant to trade it for my MACHOP? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00010
lines.text: Yay! I got myself a DROWZEE!\fThanks!

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00011
lines.text: Huh? That’s not DROWZEE.\nWhat a letdown...

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00012
lines.text: You don’t want to trade? Aww...

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00013
lines.text: Hi, how’s my old MACHOP doing?

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00014
lines.text: Huh? You...are part of Team Rocket?\nSince when?

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00015
lines.text: On Sundays, a lady comes to check\nout Pokémon.\rShe even gives away TMs!

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00016
lines.text: Team Rocket...\nWhy are they here?

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00017
lines.text: You can’t rename a Pokémon you get in\na trade.\rThe name is a reflection of the original\nTrainer’s feelings for it.

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00018
lines.text: You shouldn’t wear a black suit like\nthat. People will think you are a part\fof Team Rocket.\rWhat? You are one of them?

lines.label: msg_0596_T25R1005_00019
lines.text: Modify Your Pokémon\n5F TM Corner

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00000
lines.text: Do you listen to the radio?\rWhich shows do you prefer?\rI like Buena’s Password!\rWhen I catch it, I take notes so\nI don’t forget the password.\rThat’s why my Pokégear is full\nof scribbles!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00001
lines.text: Even Team Rocket would understand\nhow refreshing it is to listen to the\fRadio on the rooftop, right?

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00002
lines.text: If you’re tired, try the Vending\nMachine’s drinks.\fYour Pokémon will love them, too.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00003
lines.text: Team Rocket...\rYou should have a drink from the\nvending machine and take a break.\rIt’s about time you started thinking\nof how you want to live your life.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00004
lines.text: Take a Break from Shopping!\n6F Rooftop Atrium

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00005
lines.text: It’s a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00006
lines.text: Clang!\rA can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0} dropped down.\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00007
lines.text: Clang!\rBonus! Another can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}\ndropped down.\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00008
lines.text: Not enough money...

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00009
lines.text: Decided not to buy a drink.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00010
lines.text: The must-try of the Goldenrod\nDepartment Store!\fWelcome to the Daily Drawing Corner!\rYou can try it for $300, and we have\nwonderful prizes!\rWould you like to try it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00011
lines.text: All right. Please draw one!\r...\n...\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00012
lines.text: Wow!\nYou’ve got yourself the no. {STRVAR_1 50, 0, 0} prize!\rPlease take it.\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00014
lines.text: Oh my...

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00015
lines.text: Oh my...\nYour Bag is full.\rThen we’ll refund you the money.\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00016
lines.text: Oh my...\nYou’re short of money.\rPlease come again.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00017
lines.text: Please come again.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00018
lines.text: Sunday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM02!\nNo. 2, Luxury Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00019
lines.text: Monday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM65!\nNo. 2, Nest Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00020
lines.text: Tuesday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM91!\nNo. 2, Repeat Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00021
lines.text: Wednesday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM57!\nNo. 2, Net Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00022
lines.text: Thursday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM60!\nNo. 2, Quick Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00023
lines.text: Friday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM42!\nNo. 2, Dusk Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00024
lines.text: Saturday’s prizes will be:\rNo. 1, TM62!\nNo. 2, Timer Ball!\fOr No. 3, a Berry!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00025
lines.text: Whitney: What a coincidence!\nThis must be meant to be.\rDo you want to exchange\nphone numbers? Please? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00026
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Whitney\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00027
lines.text: Whitney: I’m available around noon\non Saturdays.\rGive me a call when you’ve got time.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00028
lines.text: Whitney: Don’t be so mean.

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00029
lines.text: Whitney: Do you want to know\nmy phone number now? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00030
lines.text: Whitney: Why don’t we take a\npicture together? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00031
lines.text: Whitney: OK!\nStand right next to me, right here!\r

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00032
lines.text: Whitney: Don’t we look good together?

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00033
lines.text: Whitney: That’s a shame!

lines.label: msg_0597_T25R1006_00034
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC to delete\nsome pictures.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00000
lines.text: Thank you for shopping with us today.\rTo which floor may I take you? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00001
lines.text: I look forward to serving you again.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00002
lines.text: Certainly.\nElevator going up.\r

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00003
lines.text: Certainly.\nElevator going down.\r

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00004
lines.text: We are already on that floor?!

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00005
lines.text: First floor has the Service Counter\nand the main entrance.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00006
lines.text: Second floor has the Trainer’s Market,\nwhere various useful items are sold.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00007
lines.text: Third floor has the Battle Collection\nto aim for strong, tough Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00008
lines.text: Fourth floor has the Medicine Box to\nimprove your Pokémon’s potential.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00009
lines.text: Fifth floor has the TM Corner\nto give your Pokémon a new edge.

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00010
lines.text: Sixth floor has the Rooftop Atrium.\nDon’t miss the Daily Drawing Corner!

lines.label: msg_0598_T25R1007_00011
lines.text: The basement has the warehouse.\nIt is not open to customers.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00000
lines.text:
Welcome! This is the Global Trade
Station, or GTS for short.We enable the trading of Pokémon with
people worldwide over Nintendo WFC.Would you like to do a global
Pokémon trade? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00001
lines.text: Hello!\nWelcome to the GTS!\rWould you like to do a global Pokémon\ntrade over Nintendo Wi-Fi\fConnection? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00002
lines.text:
You may trade Pokémon one of two
ways at the GTS.You may offer a Pokémon for trade,
or search among offered Pokémon.Should I describe things in greater
detail? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00003
lines.text:
You will be asked to put up the
Pokémon you are offering to trade.At that time, you will be asked what
Pokémon you would like in return.If another player offers your desired
Pokémon in return for your offered Pokémon, the trade will go through.Should I explain anything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00004
lines.text:
You may search among the Pokémon
that are offered by other Trainers.They will all identify what Pokémon
their Trainers want back in return.If you find one that you want, you
must provide us with the kind of Pokémon wanted in return.Should I explain anything else? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00005
lines.text: Would you like to make a global\nPokémon trade? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00006
lines.text: Please do visit again.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00007
lines.text: I hope you enjoy your visit\nto the GTS!\r

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00008
lines.text: ...Uh-oh!\rI’m sorry, but your team and all\nyour PC Boxes are full.\rIf you wish to use the GTS, you must\nhave room on your team or in a PC Box.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00009
lines.text:
...Uh-oh!
You only have one Pokémon with you.If you wish to use the GTS, you must
have at least two Pokémon with you.Please come back with more Pokémon
on your team.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00010
lines.text: Such a small world it is, eh?\rEh? Wait, this is a miniature?\nThe real Earth is millions of times bigger\fthan this?\rWhoaaaaaaa!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00011
lines.text: They say if you communicate with\nsomeone, their location is\frecorded on this giant globe.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00012
lines.text: All I need to do is leave a Pokémon\nhere to trade.\rWho knows, it might be traded while\nI’m asleep tonight.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00013
lines.text: Using the equipment here, you can easily\ntrade Pokémon with other Pokémon fans\fon the other side of the world!\rThat’s incredible!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00014
lines.text: You can register where you live on\nthis giant globe.\rOnce you do, you can show your location\nto anyone you communicate with.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00015
lines.text: Nintendo WFC is so easy to use,\neven I can trade Pokémon now!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00016
lines.text: This week, I’ll do it!\rI really want to make the Top 4 of the\nrankings.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00017
lines.text:
The Global Terminal has three floors.You use warp panels for getting from
one floor to another.A blue panel takes you to the GTS on
the ground floor.Take a green panel to the studios for
Box Data and Dress-Up Data on 2F.Take a pink warp panel to the third
floor for the Battle Video Gallery.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00018
lines.text: Your favorite is {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0},\nisn’t it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00019
lines.text: Your favorite is that Egg,\nisn’t it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00020
lines.text: Yes, I was right!\nI thought so!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00021
lines.text: ...Oh? Your favorite really is\n{STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0}, isn’t it?

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00022
lines.text: ...Oh? Your favorite really is that Egg,\nisn’t it?

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00023
lines.text: I want to know everyone’s favorite\nkinds of Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00024
lines.text: Yo, yo, yo!\rWanna let the world know about you?\nThen you gotta tell me, yo! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00025
lines.text: Yo, I know all I need to know about\nyou now.\rIf you want to change your message,\nI’m the guy to see, yo!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00026
lines.text: Yo! You don’t have anything you want\nto say?\rIf you want to change your message,\nI’m the guy to see, yo!

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00027
lines.text:
There are several portal machines here
at the Global Terminal.You must set your Vs. Recorder in
the machines for communication.Please do give the machines a try, as
they guide you through the operation.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00028
lines.text:
Welcome to the Global Terminal!Here, you may join the huge community
of Trainers worldwide.You may view the records of Trainers
like yourself from around the world.You may also trade Pokémon with the
world’s Trainers.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00029
lines.text: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi\nConnection for Trainer Rankings? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00030
lines.text:
Trainer Rankings is a team-based
ranking system for Trainers around the world.The Trainers will be divided into several
groups and ranked in many categories.If you join, your Trainer achievements
are automatically sent to your team.In other words, what you do as a
Trainer can help your team’s standings.Beware!If you enter a ranking category more
than once, only the points earned from your previous report will be tallied.

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00031
lines.text: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection\nand examine the Battle Video\fRankings? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0600_T25R1201_00032
lines.text: Battle Video Rankings is a gallery of\npopular Battle Videos.\rStudy many classic battles and sharpen\nyour own Trainer skills.\r

lines.text: The green panel leads to the studios\nfor Box Data and Dress-Up Data on 2F.\rThe pink panel leads to the Battle\nVideo Gallery on 3F.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00000
lines.text: Why? It’s not fair!\nWhy are there only shots of Pokémon?\rWhy aren’t there any shots of ladies?\nI call discrimination!

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00001
lines.text: Climbing the mountain to enjoy\nits great view is one thing...\rBut sneaking a peek at other people’s\nPC Boxes fills me with a guilty glee.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00002
lines.text:
Did you know?
About my PC Box, I mean.It’s full of Pokémon everyone longs
for, like......No, it would be immodest for me to
say. It would sound like bragging.If you really must know, you can always
find out yourself.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00003
lines.text: I visit every day to check on other\npeople’s Dress-Up Data.\rFor me, it’s like the first step to\nfashion!

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00004
lines.text: Oh, dear me! Gracious!\nThis is almost scandalous!

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00005
lines.text: For combinations of Pokémon and\nAccessories, you can get ideas from\fothers by observing what they do.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00006
lines.text: The same kind of Accessory can create\nentirely different impressions.\rIt really depends on where and how\nit’s used.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00007
lines.text: I won a Backdrop drawing for\nAccessories in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00008
lines.text: What I like to do...\rI like sneaking glances at the people\nchecking out Dress-Up Data.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00009
lines.text: Warps to the GTS and the Trainer\nRankings on 1F.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00010
lines.text: Warps to the Battle Video Gallery on 3F.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00011
lines.text: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi\nConnection for Dress-Up Data? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00012
lines.text:
Here, you may post the Dress-Up Data
of your Pokémon.The Dress-Up Data can be set up and
saved in the Goldenrod Tunnel.The Dress-Up Data posted by other
Trainers may also be viewed here.The data may be sorted by Pokémon
for convenient viewing.

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00013
lines.text: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi\nConnection for Box Data? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0601_T25R1202_00014
lines.text:
Here, you may post the Box Data
containing your Pokémon.Choose a wallpaper, then place your
Pokémon on it to compose your scene.When you are done, post it for other
Trainers to see.The Box Data posted by other Trainers
may also be viewed here.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00000
lines.text: What you see here is how much people\naround the world love Pokémon.\rWatching Battle Videos lets you share\nthe fun these people had.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00001
lines.text: This is a great idea.\nAnyone and everyone can participate.\rEven if you lose, that battle could still\nbecome an outstanding Battle Video.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00002
lines.text: What stunning, gripping Battle Videos!\nShould I go home and retrain\fmy Pokémon?

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00003
lines.text: My Battle Videos starring only cute\nlittle MARILL are the ones I like best.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00004
lines.text: What an amazing collection!\nI can see why this is so popular.\rJust seeing some of these Battle Videos\nmakes me feel tougher!

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00005
lines.text: To treat one’s self to Battle Videos\nevery day...\rI would consider that a hobby worthy\nof a true gentleman.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00006
lines.text:
My mysterious Battle Video.
My mysterious Battle Video.What’s on it?
What’s on it?It’s a mystery!
It’s a mystery! And I mean it!

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00007
lines.text:
Let me attempt the alphabet rap using
Goldenrod, dig?G... Go south from here for the
Ilex Forest.O... Over land is not where you’ll find
the Goldenrod Tunnel.L... Looking like criminals in their black
pajamas is Team Rocket.D... Um... D... is...
Yeah, I know, lame-o. You give it a try!

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00008
lines.text: The Hiker enjoying the Box Data down\non 2F is my little brother.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00009
lines.text: Warps to the GTS and the Trainer\nRankings on 1F.

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00010
lines.text: Warps to the studios for Box Data and\nDress-Up Data on 2F.

lines.text: Connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi\nConnection for Battle Videos? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0602_T25R1203_00012
lines.text:
Here, you may post a Battle Video of
your Pokémon.You may also view Battle Videos posted
by other Trainers.The Battle Videos may be sorted by
Pokémon, battle facility, and so on.The Battle Video you post will be
assigned a 12-digit number.Your friends may view your Battle Video
by entering this 12-digit code here.
