lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00028
lines.text:
My name is Mr. Game!My heart pounds with excitement when
people enjoy my Coin game!In fact, that’s what I live for!
You look like quite a challenger!Why don’t you play my Coin game?You can get fabulous prizes if
you manage to collect a lot of Coins. {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00031
lines.text: All right!\nHere is your Coin Case!\r

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00032
lines.text: Show me how you play, and my heart\nwill pound with excitement!\r

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00033
lines.text: Playing my Coin game will make your\nheart and my heart both pound with\fexcitement, you know?

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00034
lines.text: My name is Mr. Game!\rMy heart pounds with excitement when\npeople enjoy my Coin game!\rIn fact, that’s what I live for!\nGo ahead and play it!\rMake my heart pound with excitement!

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00035
lines.text: Go ahead and play my Coin game!\fMake my heart pound with excitement!

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00036
lines.text: What a feeling!\rNothing beats Coin-game spectatorship!\nOh! I almost forgot!\rYou can exchange your Coins for prizes\nwith the two gentlemen at the table\fover there.

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00037
lines.text: Did you come back to play\nmy Coin game?

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00038
lines.text: It seems you need a Coin Case\nto play...\r

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00039
lines.text: Mr. Game: Aha!\rYou must be here to play my Coin game!\nCome here and I’ll give you a Coin Case!

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00040
lines.text: Mr. Game: Show me how you play and\nmake my heart pound with excitement!\r

lines.label: msg_0603_T25SP0101_00041
lines.text: Mr. Game: Huh?\rWhy don’t you sit across from me\nand show me how you play?

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00000
lines.text:
...You again?There’s no need to be alert.
I don’t bother with wimps like you.Speaking of weaklings, the city’s
Gym Leader isn’t here, and is supposedly taking care of a sick Pokémon at the Lighthouse.Humph! Boo-hoo!
Just let sick Pokémon go!A Pokémon that can’t battle
is worthless!Why don’t you go train at
the Lighthouse?Who knows? It may make you a bit
of a better Trainer!

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00001
lines.text: Dark roads are dangerous at night.\rBut, in the pitch-black night,\nthe sea is even more treacherous!\rWithout the beacon of the Lighthouse\nto guide her, no ship can sail.

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00002
lines.text: That thing you have--\nit’s a Pokégear, right?\fWow, that’s cool.

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00003
lines.text: Wow, you have a Pokémon!\nThat is just so awesome.

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00004
lines.text: You, young Trainer!\nThe sea is sweet!\rSing with me!\fThe sea is blue!\nThe sea is salty!

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00005
lines.text: Olivine City\nThe Port with Sea Breezes

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00006
lines.text: Olivine Port\nFast-Ship Pier

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00007
lines.text: Olivine City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Jasmine\fThe Steel-Clad Defense Girl

lines.label: msg_0604_T26_00008
lines.text: Olivine’s Lighthouse\rIt is also known as\nthe Glitter Lighthouse.

lines.label: msg_0605_T26FS0101_00000
lines.text: Do your Pokémon already know the\nmove for carrying people on water?

lines.label: msg_0605_T26FS0101_00001
lines.text: My BUTTERFREE came from my\nboyfriend overseas.\rIt carried some Mail from him.\fWant to know what it says?\rLet’s see...\rNope! It’s a secret!

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Jasmine: Thank you for your help
at the Lighthouse...But this is different. Please allow me to
introduce myself.I am Jasmine, a Gym Leader.
I use the...clang! Steel type!...Do you know about the Steel type?They are very hard, cold, sharp,
and really strong! Um... I’m not lying.

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Jasmine: ...You are a better Trainer\nthan me, in both skill and kindness.\rIn accordance with League rules,\nI confer upon you this Badge.\r

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Mineral Badge from Jasmine!

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Jasmine: With that Badge,\nall Pokémon, including traded\fPokémon up to Lv. 70, will obey\fyou without question.\fUm... Please take this, too...\r

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Jasmine: It is called Iron Tail...\rYour Pokémon will hit the target\nwith its hard tail, occasionally\flowering the target’s Defense...

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Jasmine: Um...\rI don’t know how to say this, but\ngood luck...

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Jasmine: Long time, no see.\rUm... I’m fine, thank you.\rI don’t know how to say this,\nbut...nothing...

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Jasmine: Um... Er...\rWill you trade your Pokémon\nfor mine? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Jasmine: Really? Thank you very much!\rI’ll be happy with any Pokémon!\r

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Jasmine: Oh, uh-huh, I see.\nThat’s disappointing, but I understand.

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00011
lines.text: Jasmine: Thank you so much.\nI’ll take good care of it.

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00012
lines.text: Jasmine: Don’t you sometimes feel like\nscrubbing Steel-type Pokémon?\fDon’t you?

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00013
lines.text: Will you trade {STRVAR_1 1, 1, 0}? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00014
lines.text: Jasmine: I like Eggs, too, but\nI’d like a Pokémon, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\fOne that might have a little training...

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00015
lines.text: Jasmine: I’d appreciate it so much...\nExcept that I cannot accept such\fa precious Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00016
lines.text: Jasmine, the Gym Leader?\nShe’s at the Lighthouse.\rShe’s been tending to a sick Pokémon.\rA strong Trainer is compassionate\nat the same time...

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00017
lines.text: Jasmine uses Steel-type Pokémon.\rShe’s trying to hide her tenderness\nbehind her steely coldness.

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00018
lines.text: That was awesome.\fThe Steel type, huh?\fThat was one heated battle you had!

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00019
lines.text: I knew you’d come here.\rThank you for helping the Gym Leader,\nbut battle is a separate matter.\rGo for it!

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00020
lines.text: Impressive!\rYou should continue your journey to\ndifferent places.\rSince you can use Surf, why don’t you\ntry it on the Lake of Rage?

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00021
lines.text: Giggle...\rI know how capable you are\nfrom the Lighthouse.\rIt’s time you showed that side of\nyourself to Jasmine! Good luck!

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00022
lines.text: You are amazing...\rYou should aim even higher, since\nyou have such potential.\rHave you been to Mahogany Town?

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00023
lines.text: Olivine City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0606_T26GYM0101_00024
lines.text: Olivine City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Jasmine\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00000
lines.text: Pokémon get more friendly if you\nspend time with them.

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00001
lines.text: They can shine like a bright light--\nlike a beacon at night to guide us...\rThey can take us across the water on\ntheir backs when we are without\fa boat...\rPokémon are helping us everywhere.\fI can’t imagine a life without them!

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00002
lines.text: There’s a person in Cianwood City\nacross the sea.\rI heard him bragging about his\nrare Pokémon.

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00003
lines.text: ...There!\nAll done!\fIt’s sure to surprise anyone!\r

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00004
lines.text: Oh, are you a Trainer?\rYou came at just the right time!\nI just finished putting my Ball Capsule\fon my Poké Ball.\rDo you want to battle and be\namazed by my decoration? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00005
lines.text: All right!\nHere I come!\r

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00006
lines.text:
You can turn your Poké Balls into your
own special creations by adding Seals.How cool is it to have a Poké Ball that
only you have in the entire world? Give it a whirl!Oh, remember to put the Ball Capsule
on a Poké Ball once it’s ready!

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00007
lines.text: Oh, really?\rTalk to me if you want to see my\nBall Capsule sometime!

lines.label: msg_0607_T26PC0101_00008
lines.text: Now you want to see my Ball Capsule?\rBattle me so I can show it to you! {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0608_T26R0301_00000
lines.text: Hi, I’m looking for this Pokémon.\rIf you have a KRABBY, would you\ntrade it for my VOLTORB? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0608_T26R0301_00001
lines.text: Great! Thank you!\rI finally got a KRABBY!

lines.label: msg_0608_T26R0301_00002
lines.text: You don’t have a KRABBY?\nThat’s too bad, then.

lines.label: msg_0608_T26R0301_00003
lines.text: You don’t have one either?\rGee, that’s really disappointing...

lines.label: msg_0608_T26R0301_00004
lines.text: Hi! The KRABBY you traded me is\ndoing great!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00000
lines.text: Along the way to Cianwood, there are\nfour deserted islands.\rBad kids are taken to the islands\nas punishment!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00001
lines.text: Whenever I get in trouble, Daddy\nalways scares me.

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00002
lines.text: My sister gave me a lot of Seals!\fHere, have some!\r

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00003
lines.text: Wow!\nYou have so many Seals!\rYou can cover your Poké Balls in Seals!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00004
lines.text: I can give you better ones tomorrow!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00005
lines.text: Huh?\nYou don’t have a Seal Case?\fI was gonna give you some Seals...

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00006
lines.text: There!\nI’ll give you this!\r

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00007
lines.text: Have another!\r

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00008
lines.text: Have more!\r

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00009
lines.text: Stick them on your Ball Capsules!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00010
lines.text: Your Seal Case is full!

lines.label: msg_0609_T26R0501_00011
lines.text: The {STRVAR_1 10, 0, 0} was\nput away in the Seal Case.\r

lines.label: msg_0610_T26R0601_00000
lines.text: Olivine is on the sea!\rAnd if it’s on the sea, there is bound\nto be something to catch!\rI’ve fished here for 30 years.\rWould you like to face the sea\nand fish? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0610_T26R0601_00001
lines.text: Ah, hahah!\nWe have ourselves a new angler!

lines.label: msg_0610_T26R0601_00003
lines.text: Water-type Pokémon aren’t found\nin the sea alone.\fThey go wherever there is water.

lines.label: msg_0610_T26R0601_00004
lines.text: Whaaat? You don’t like to fish!?\fIncomprehensible!

lines.label: msg_0610_T26R0601_00005
lines.text: How are things?\nLand the big one?

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00000
lines.text:
You!
How is your Pokémon training coming along?Have you ever noticed that in the
mountains, sometimes there are round boulders right in your way...?You can move them with the
hidden move Strength!Hikers at Mt. Mortar sometimes have
extra, or so I’ve heard...

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00001
lines.text: Gobble...gobble...\r...Choke!\nAck... I’m choking!\rWhew! That was close.\nI should chew before I swallow my food.

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00002
lines.text: Whenever I roll into Olivine, I always\nvisit the Olivine Café.\rEverything on the menu makes me feel\nstronger. I can’t stop eating!

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00003
lines.text: Olivine Café’s menu is chock-full\nof hearty fare for beefy Sailors!

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00004
lines.text:
Jasmine: Hi!
...!These empty dishes in front of me
are not all mine...Er...Actually, the person who sat here
ahead of me ate a lot...Anyway, do you want to exchange
phone numbers? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00005
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Jasmine\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00006
lines.text: Jasmine: Now we can contact each\nother anytime.\rI should be able to battle you around\nnoon on Wednesdays.\fI’ll be waiting for your call!

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00007
lines.text: Jasmine: Oh... I understand...

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00008
lines.text: Jasmine: Did you change your mind?\nWill you exchange numbers? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00009
lines.text: Jasmine: We seem to...bump into each\nother often.\rWhy don’t we take a picture\nto make this a memory? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00010
lines.text: Jasmine: Are you ready?\r

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00011
lines.text: Jasmine: You did a fine job.\nWe look good.

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00012
lines.text: Jasmine: I see...

lines.label: msg_0611_T26R0701_00013
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC to delete\nsome pictures.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00000
lines.text: Ecruteak used to have two towers,\none in the east and one in the west.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00001
lines.text: Have you heard that they are talking\nabout rebuilding the Burned Tower?\rThere will be two towers again!\nI’m looking forward to it!

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00002
lines.text: Hmm...\nI thought I just heard a woman\fscreaming or something...\rIs that just me?

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00003
lines.text: Kimono Girls are always rehearsing their\ndances at the Dance Theater there.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00004
lines.text: I’m going to rehearse at the\nDance Theater. Care to join me?

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00005
lines.text: The tower that used to be here...\nI heard that it used to be much taller\fbefore it was burned by a fire.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00006
lines.text: Three big Pokémon ran off in different\ndirections. What were they?

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00007
lines.text: They say that they will start the\nconstruction work to rebuild this\ftower soon!

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00008
lines.text:
Oh!
That’s a nice Pokémon you’re walking with! They make you feel uplifted, don’t they?They give us the hope of the light,
so to speak.Speaking of the light, I heard something
about the Lighthouse in Olivine.The Pokémon that serves as the
beacon has fallen ill. Sounds like it’s in trouble.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00009
lines.text: The Pokémon at that Lighthouse in\nOlivine has fully recovered.\rI heard that boats can safely sail out\nto sea at night again.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00010
lines.text: If you go west from this city, you’ll\nreach a port called Olivine City.\rWhen your Pokémon learns Surf,\nyou can go out to the ocean from\fRoute 40 without a ship!

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00011
lines.text: Ecruteak City\nA Historical City

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00012
lines.text: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Morty\fThe Mystic Seer of the Future

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00013
lines.text: Ecruteak Dance Theater

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00014
lines.text: Burned Tower\nIt was destroyed by a mysterious fire.\rPlease stay away, as it is unsafe.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00015
lines.text: Barrier Station to Bell Tower\nNo Trespassing by the Unworthy

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00016
lines.text: {SIZE 200}Thud!!

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00017
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: How...? How is this\npossible? How can I lose to\fmere Kimono Girls...?\r

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00018
lines.text:
{STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}: You were watching me,
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}...Yeah, that’s right!I never thought defeating five Kimono
Girls would be so hard...I got beaten to a pulp......You must have come here for the same
reason, right?Don’t get cocky just because you
defeated Team Rocket!These Kimono Girls are insanely strong.Go ahead! See if you can defeat them.But I’m not going back.
I don’t want to see you win.

lines.label: msg_0612_T27_00019
lines.text:
In the distant past...When this tower burned in a fire,
three nameless Pokémon perished in it.Then, a rainbow-hued Pokémon
descended from the sky and somehow brought them back...The people were afraid of power such as
the rainbow-hued Pokémon had shown.They tried to control it by force.The nameless Pokémon made no attempt
to fight back. Instead, their great sorrow compelled them to leave.This legend has been passed down
by the Ecruteak Gym Leader. Me?I was a Trainer way back when.
Ho ho ho!

lines.label: msg_0613_T27FS0101_00000
lines.text: My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON.\rBut my friend’s EEVEE turned into\nan UMBREON.\rI wonder why? We both were raising\nour EEVEE in the same way...

lines.label: msg_0613_T27FS0101_00001
lines.text: If you use Revive, a Pokémon that has\nfainted will wake right up.

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Morty: It’s good of you to have come.Here in Ecruteak, Pokémon have long
been revered.It’s said that a rainbow-hued
Pokémon will come down to appear before a truly powerful Trainer.I believed that tale, so I have
secretly trained here all my life.As a result, I can now see what
others cannot.I see a shadow of the person who
will make the Pokémon appear.I believe that person is me!You’re going to help me reach
that level!

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Morty: I don’t think our potentials are\nso different. But you seem to have\fsomething more than that...\rSo be it. This Badge is yours.\r

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Fog Badge from Morty!

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Morty: By having the Fog Badge,\nPokémon up to Lv. 50, including traded\fPokémon, will obey you.\rAlso, Pokémon will be able to use Surf.\rHere is another thing...\nI want you to have this, too.\r

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Morty: It’s Shadow Ball. It causes\ndamage and may reduce Special Defense.\fUse it if it appeals to you.

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00006
lines.text:
Morty: I get it...The person the Kimono Girls were
talking about must be you...Never mind.You should be strong enough to go
across the sea.When you go west and then south,
you’ll reach Olivine City. Why don’t you head for it?

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Yo! Champ in the making!\nThe Trainers here use Ghost-type\fPokémon at will.\rA ghost is like a shade or a phantom...\nIt won’t do any good to use physical\fstrength alone.

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Whew, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\nYou did great!\rI was cowering in the corner out of\npure terror!

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00009
lines.text: You have business with the Gym Leader?\rMorty, the Gym Leader, has gone to\nthe Burned Tower.\rSorry, but you’ll have to leave.\nHo ho ho.\r

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0614_T27GYM0101_00011
lines.text: Ecruteak City Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Morty\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0615_T27PC0101_00000
lines.text: Bill: Hi, I’m Bill. And who are you?\rHmm, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, huh?\r

lines.label: msg_0615_T27PC0101_00001
lines.text:
You know what?
I’m the one who developed the system to transfer Pokémon.But it couldn’t have been done by
me alone.For example, do you know the Hoenn
region? This girl Lanette from Hoenn made the Pokémon Storage System easier to use.My friends all over the world are
working together to improve the Pokémon trade and storage systems.I have to hurry on back to Goldenrod
and see my folks. Buh-bye!

lines.label: msg_0615_T27PC0101_00002
lines.text: Kimono Girls are so pretty.\rThe way the Kimono Girls dance and\nthe way they use their Pokémon are\fboth marvels.

lines.label: msg_0615_T27PC0101_00003
lines.text: Morty, the Gym Leader, is soooo cool.\rHis Pokémon are really tough, too.

lines.label: msg_0615_T27PC0101_00004
lines.text: Lake of Rage...\nThe appearance of a red GYARADOS...\fI smell a conspiracy. I know it!

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00000
lines.text:
Past here is the Bell Tower.
This tower was built as a place of rest for HO-OH, the legendary Flying-type Pokémon.Since HO-OH left, many people have gone
up to the tower to try to bring it back.But none have succeeded in making
HO-OH appear...Morty, the Gym Leader, is one who
has tried.You don’t seem to have the Ecruteak
Gym Badge. If you can’t even defeat Morty, going up there will be a waste of time.Sorry, but you’ll have to leave.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00001
lines.text:
Morty, the Gym Leader, ascended this
tower to try to bring back HO-OH, because it no longer appears.Even he couldn’t bring it back.You don’t seem to have the Ecruteak
Gym Badge.If you can’t even defeat Morty, going
up there will be a waste of time.Sorry, but you’ll have to leave.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00002
lines.text:
Past here is the Bell Tower.
This tower was built as a place of rest for HO-OH, the legendary Flying-type Pokémon.Since HO-OH left, many people have gone
up to the tower to try to bring it back.But none have succeeded in making
HO-OH appear...Morty, the Gym Leader, is one who
has tried.I see... That’s the Ecruteak Gym Badge.The Badge alone will not do any good,
but I can let you through.Please, do go on.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00003
lines.text: I see...\nThat’s the Ecruteak Gym Badge.\rThe Badge alone will not do any good,\nbut I can let you through.\rPlease, do go on.\r

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00004
lines.text: Please, do go on.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00005
lines.text: Having been able to witness HO-OH\ncoming back to this tower is more than\fworth the training I have gone through.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00006
lines.text:
Only those who possess the Rainbow Wing
are given permission to go up to the top of the Bell Tower...But the rainbow-hued Pokémon will
not come down for just anybody who goes up there.There must be something else you need.
I’ve heard the Kimono Girls know something about it.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00007
lines.text: The Johto region has two legends.\rOne is the legend about Whirl Islands.\nThe other is the Bell Tower legend...\rWe have been passing down the\nBell Tower legend for generations\fin Ecruteak City.

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00008
lines.text: The Bell Tower shook!\rIt must be HO-OH...\nHO-OH must have returned to the top!

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00009
lines.text: Such a young one to take on HO-OH...

lines.label: msg_0616_T27R0201_00010
lines.text: The rainbow-hued Pokémon flying\ngracefully over the tower...\rThe silvery, sparkling Pokémon resting\ngently upon the whirling seabed...\rAll of this is far beyond my imagination.

lines.label: msg_0617_T27R0401_00000
lines.text: This happened when I was young.\rThe sky suddenly turned black.\nA giant Flying-type Pokémon was\fblocking out the sun.\rI wonder what that Pokémon was?\rIt was like a bird and like a dragon.

lines.label: msg_0617_T27R0401_00001
lines.text: Is there really a Pokémon that big?\fIf it exists, it must be powerful.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00000
lines.text: {SIZE 200}Hey! Hey!{SIZE 100}\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00001
lines.text: Stop dancing such a serious dance!\nShow me something like a hula dance!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00002
lines.text: ...You mustn’t push such a request\non me.\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00003
lines.text: Huh?\nAre you telling me you don’t respect\fwhat the customer wants?\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00004
lines.text: Well, then I’ll show you how to dance.\rI’ll show you a great one.\nWahahaha!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00005
lines.text: Huh? Who are you?\rYou dare to get in my way?\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00006
lines.text: Oh, no!\nYou make me look like a villain!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00007
lines.text: Oops!\nI have an important mission.\rIf they find out I was wasting time\nhere, they’ll make me start over\fas the lowest Team Rocket Grunt!\rI better leave now!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00009
lines.text:
You must be {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, correct?
That was indeed excellent. Kind and strong... Good at raising Pokémon as well...That person does know what to look for
in people...Ohoho! That was just me talking to
myself. Never mind.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00010
lines.text:
For Kimono Girls like me, dancing
is everything.I have never gone a day without
a dance practice.Pokémon are the same.They grow with you little by little
each day.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00011
lines.text:
Welcome.
My name is Zuki. I met you previously in Violet City.In order to bring back HO-OH, we
needed someone with the right bond with Pokémon.We asked Mr. Pokémon to give this
Mystery Egg to whoever showed true potential.The Egg was eventually handed from
Mr. Pokémon to Professor Elm, and then to you.However, being pure alone will not be
sufficient to face the power of this Pokémon. I must test you.Are you ready? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00012
lines.text:
Welcome.
My name is Zuki. I met you previously in Violet City.In order to bring back LUGIA, we
needed someone with the right bond with Pokémon.We asked Mr. Pokémon to give this
Mystery Egg to whoever showed true potential.The Egg was eventually handed from
Mr. Pokémon to Professor Elm, and then to you.However, being pure alone will not be
sufficient to face the power of this Pokémon. I must test you.Are you ready? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00013
lines.text: I will test you to see if you are a good\nPokémon Trainer.\rAre you ready? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00014
lines.text: That is fine...\nI will wait for you to get ready.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00015
lines.text:
You are quite strong.You helped me in the Ilex Forest.My name is Naoko. I’m the one that’s
not so good at directions.My eyes witnessed you defeating
Team Rocket when Kurt was in trouble at the SLOWPOKE Well.Allow me to challenge you and your
Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00016
lines.text:
You are quite the Trainer.I remember you chasing off
that Team Rocket Grunt from right here.I must thank you for that.Although, I am actually a Trainer
myself.She who knows the most speaks
the least! I am Miki--the Kimono Girl!Allow me to challenge you and your
Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00017
lines.text:
Excellent fighting spirit!You got me off the ice by pushing me
from the back.I am the one who skates in sandals. I am Sayo--the Kimono Girl!I was listening in the Dragon’s Den
when you passed the test of the Elder.Allow me to challenge you and your
Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00018
lines.text:
I am the last one.You were so dependable at the
Goldenrod Tunnel. I am the one who twirls even underground.I am Kuni--the Kimono Girl!I looked at you in wonder when you
thwarted Team Rocket’s mission to take over the Radio Tower. You must show your strength to me now.Allow me to challenge you and your
Pokémon!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00019
lines.text: Talk to Zuki in the middle\nwhen you are ready.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00020
lines.text: We were not wrong about you.\nYou are indeed worthy of this...\rPlease take it.\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00021
lines.text: Big sisters!\rI just saw the big shadow of a Pokémon\nover the Bell Tower!\rIt could be...\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00022
lines.text: Big sisters!\rI just saw the big shadow of a Pokémon\nin the Whirl Islands’ waters!\rIt could be...\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00023
lines.text: Zuki: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nWe’ll be at the Bell Tower.\fSee you there!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00024
lines.text: Zuki: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nWe’ll be at the Whirl Islands.\fSee you there!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00025
lines.text: What’s the deal with that Team Rocket\nGrunt, messing with my Kimono Girl?\rYou are a Trainer, aren’t you?\fPlease help her!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00026
lines.text: Wonderful!\nYou were so courageous for your age!\rIt was a rare sight to see!\nI want you to have this.\fDon’t be shy--take it!\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00028
lines.text: That’s Surf.\nIt’s a move that lets Pokémon swim\facross water with ease.\r

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00029
lines.text: Not only are the Kimono Girls great\ndancers, they’re also skilled at\fPokémon.\rBut they battle only for good reasons.\rI don’t know if you could defeat them if\nthey showed what they can do...

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00030
lines.text: PSYDUCK: Dau dau!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00031
lines.text: That man’s always with his PSYDUCK.\rSays he wants a Pokémon that can\nSurf and dance.\rIs he trying to make a Pokémon\nthat stars at synchronized swimming?

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00032
lines.text: Oh... Ouch...!\rThis stomachache!\rI wouldn’t let this guy act like that\nwere it not for this pain...!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00033
lines.text: I was supposed to be the hero...!\rSo much for getting close to\na Kimono Girl!\n

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00034
lines.text: Oh... Ouch...!\rThis back pain!\rI wouldn’t let this guy act like that\nwere it not for this pain...!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00035
lines.text: Oh... Ouch...!\rThis toothache!\rI wouldn’t let this guy act like that\nwere it not for this pain...!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00036
lines.text:
The Kimono Girls are so beautiful...But they have to go through rigorous
training.And they have to learn to follow
customs before appearing in public.But if you love something, anything
is possible.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00037
lines.text: To do such a terrible thing to\na Kimono Girl!\rI don’t understand how young people\nbehave these days.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00038
lines.text: Quite the Trainer for your age indeed!

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00039
lines.text: This desk is used for\ncertain programs...

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00040
lines.text: Thank you for your help the other day.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00041
lines.text: We are rehearsing a dance.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00042
lines.text:
Thank you for your help the other day.You have beautifully proven that the
bond between people can be extended to the bond between people and Pokémon...We all appreciate that you have lived up
to our expectations, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!If you feel that this experience has
taught you anything, the people you should thank are not us, but Mr. Pokémon and Professor Elm...

lines.text: We are rehearsing a dance.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00044
lines.text: Thank you for your help the other day.

lines.label: msg_0618_T27R0501_00045
lines.text: I will test how closely you’ve\nbonded with your Pokémon!\r

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00000
lines.text: Ah. You’re on an adventure with\nyour Pokémon?\rWell, what’s an adventure without\ntreasure hunting?\rAm I right, or am I right? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00001
lines.text: Good! You understand the true\nspirit of adventure.\rI like that! Take this with you.

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00003
lines.text:
There are many items lying about
that aren’t obvious.Touch the Dowsing Machine for a while
to see if it makes a high-pitched noise.When it does, you know there is
an item near you.Walking as you use it may make it
easy to find items.Oh yeah--I heard there are items
in Ecruteak’s Burned Tower.

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00004
lines.text: Oh... To each his own, I suppose...

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00005
lines.text: History of Ecruteak\rWant to read it? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00006
lines.text:
In Ecruteak, there were two towers.
Each tower was the roost of powerful flying Pokémon.But one of the towers burned to
the ground.The two Pokémon haven’t been
seen since...Keep reading? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0619_T27R0801_00007
lines.text:
Ecruteak was also home to three
Pokémon that raced around the town.They were said to have been born of
water, lightning, and fire.But they could not contain their
excessive power.So they say the three ran like the
wind off into the grassland.

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00000
lines.text: Hiya, kid!\rI see you’re new in Mahogany Town.\nSince you’re new, you should try a\fyummy RageCandyBar!\rRight now, it can be yours for just\n$300! Want one? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00001
lines.text:
I don’t want to upset you after
buying one from me, but...Buying a RageCandyBar has nothing to
do with whether I’d allow you to pass through here....Johto has many places to visit,
such as the Lighthouse at Olivine and the Pharmacy at Cianwood.Why don’t you slow down and
enjoy sightseeing?

Have you seen this guy with a
black cape?He has been going back and forth
between here and the Lake of Rage saying strange radio waves are being transmitted.Who is he, I wonder.

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00014
lines.text: Are you off to see the GYARADOS\nrampage at the lake?

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00015
lines.text: MAGIKARP have returned to\nLake of Rage.\rThat should be splendid news for the\nanglers there.

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00016
lines.text: Visit Grandma’s shop. She sells\nstuff that nobody else has...\rYou want to buy stuff, right?\nSo buy stuff at my grandma’s!

lines.text: Mahogany Town\nHome of the Ninja

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00018
lines.text: Just a Souvenir Shop\rNothing Suspicious about It\nNo Need to Be Alarmed

lines.label: msg_0620_T28_00019
lines.text: Mahogany Town Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Pryce\fThe Teacher of Winter’s Harshness

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Pryce: Pokémon have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.I, too, have seen and suffered much in
my life.Since I am your elder, let me show you
what I mean.I have been training Pokémon since
before you were born.I do not lose easily.
I, Pryce--the Winter Trainer-- shall demonstrate my power!

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00001
lines.text: Pryce: I am impressed by your prowess.\rWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life’s obstacles.\fYou are worthy of this Badge!\r

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00002
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received\nthe Glacier Badge from Pryce!

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00003
lines.text: Pryce: That Badge will raise the Special\nstats of Pokémon.\rIt also lets your Pokémon use\nWhirlpool to get across\freal whirlpools.\rAnd this... This is a gift from me!\r

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00004
lines.text: Pryce: That TM contains Hail.\rIt summons a hailstorm that lasts for\nfive turns. The hailstorm damages\fall types except Ice.

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Pryce: When the ice and snow melt,\nspring arrives.\rYou and your Pokémon will be together\nfor many years to come.\fCherish your time together!

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Pryce: It is you...\rSince you are here, why don’t we\ntake a picture together? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Pryce: I have advice to give you before\nwe take the picture.\rBreathe in and relax first.\nThen slowly begin to smile.\fAre you ready?\r

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00008
lines.text: Pryce: Let’s see...\nDid we get a good one?

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00009
lines.text: Pryce: That’s OK, too.\nSuit yourself.

lines.label: msg_0622_T28GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Your Photo Album is full.\rAccess your PC to delete\nsome pictures.

lines.label: msg_0623_T28GYM0103_00000
lines.text:
Pryce is a veteran who has trained
Pokémon for some 50 years.As you’ll find, his attacks will make
you shiver in this freezing Gym.Are you ready to be frozen solid?I mean--keep up a hot fighting spirit
against ice!

lines.label: msg_0623_T28GYM0103_00001
lines.text: Pryce is something, but you’re\nsomething else!\rThat was a hot battle that\nspanned the generations!

lines.label: msg_0623_T28GYM0103_00002
lines.text: Mahogany Town Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0623_T28GYM0103_00003
lines.text: Mahogany Town Pokémon Gym\rLeader: Pryce\nCertified Trainer!\f{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}

lines.label: msg_0624_T28PC0101_00000
lines.text: What’s this? Team Rocket has\ncome back?\rI saw some men in black at the\nLake of Rage.

lines.label: msg_0624_T28PC0101_00001
lines.text: I stop my Pokémon from evolving too\nearly.\rI make them learn certain moves before\nI let them evolve.

lines.label: msg_0624_T28PC0101_00002
lines.text: Pokémon do become stronger when they\nevolve, but they also learn moves\fmore slowly.

lines.label: msg_0625_T28R0201_00000
lines.text: I heard that a red GYARADOS appeared\nat the Lake of Rage.\rThat’s odd, since even ordinary\nGYARADOS are rare in that lake...

lines.label: msg_0625_T28R0201_00001
lines.text: My top radio show?\nI’d say Pokémon Music.

lines.label: msg_0625_T28R0201_00002
lines.text: I’ve been hearing laughter on\nthe radio...\fIt’s creepy.

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00000
lines.text: GYARADOS: Gyashaa!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00001
lines.text: DRAGONITE: Gyafooha!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00002
lines.text: That red GYARADOS wasn’t acting right.\nAs I feared, somebody must have forced\fit to evolve...\r

Did you come here because of the
wild tales?You’re {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}?
I’m Lance, a Trainer like you.I heard some rumblings, so I came to
investigate...I saw the way you battled earlier,
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.I can tell that you’re a Trainer
with considerable skill.If you don’t mind, could you help me
investigate? {YESNO 0}

{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00007
lines.text: Oh... Well, if you change your mind,\nplease help me.

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00008
lines.text: Lance: What do you think?\nAre you going to help me? {YESNO 0}

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00009
lines.text: The GYARADOS are angry!\nIt’s a bad omen!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00010
lines.text: Hahah! The MAGIKARP are biting!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00011
lines.text: I heard this lake was made by rampaging\nGYARADOS.\rI wonder if there is any connection\nto their mass outbreak now?

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00012
lines.text: Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a \nred GYARADOS in the Lake of Rage...\rBut I thought GYARADOS were\nusually blue?

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00013
lines.text:
Pryce: The strong rain falling on the
surface seems to be agitating the raging lake.This must have some purpose that we
meet again.Why don’t we exchange our phone
numbers? {YESNO 0}

lines.text: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} registered Pryce\nin the Pokégear!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00015
lines.text: Pryce: I make it a habit to train myself\non Monday mornings to give this lazy\fbody a spine.\rYou could be a good training partner.\nI’ll be waiting for your call!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00016
lines.text: Pryce: That’s OK, too.\nPeople ought to have their own ideas.\fThat’s the way it is.

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00017

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00018
lines.text: Battle with the great catch\nI just got!

lines.text: I can only land the same kind of\nPokémon. No matter how long I fish!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00024
lines.text: When you spot a Trainer, it’s time for\na challenge!\fThat’s the way of Trainers!

lines.label: msg_0626_T29_00027
lines.text: What happened to the red GYARADOS?\rIt’s gone?\nI came all the way for it...\rOK, I challenge you!

lines.label: msg_0627_T29R0101_00000
lines.text: ...You have strayed far...\nHere I have meditated. Inside me,\fa new power has been awakened.\rLet me share my power with your\nPokémon. Take this, child.\r

lines.label: msg_0627_T29R0101_00002
lines.text: Do you see it? It is Hidden Power!\rIt draws out the power of Pokémon\nfor attacking.\rRemember this: its type and power\ndepend on the Pokémon using it.

lines.label: msg_0627_T29R0101_00003
lines.text: You have no room for it...

lines.label: msg_0627_T29R0101_00004
lines.text: I am meditating...

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00000
lines.text:
The Lake of Rage is actually a crater
made by rampaging GYARADOS.The crater filled up with rainwater,
and the lake was formed.That’s the story passed on from my
grandpa’s great-great-grandpa.It used to be that you could catch
lively MAGIKARP there, but...I don’t understand what’s happening.

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00001
lines.text: The Lake of Rage hasn’t been normal\nsince those men wearing black arrived.

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00002
lines.text:
The Lake of Rage is back to normal.
The MAGIKARP have returned.I may yet achieve my dream of seeing
the world’s largest MAGIKARP.Do you have a Rod?
Please help me if you do.

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00003
lines.text: Ah, you have a MAGIKARP!\nLet’s see how big that baby is.\r

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00004
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}.{STRVAR_1 50, 1, 0} inches!\nA MAGIKARP of {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}.{STRVAR_1 50, 1, 0} inches!\rWow! This one is outstanding!\nI tip my hat to you!\rTake this as a memento!\r

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00005
lines.text: The record is the important thing.\nThink of that as a bonus!

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00006
lines.text: {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}.{STRVAR_1 50, 1, 0} inches!\rThat’s wonderful!\n...Or not.\fI’ve seen a MAGIKARP\fof the same size before.

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00007
lines.text: This MAGIKARP is {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}.{STRVAR_1 50, 1, 0} inches.\rBut I’ve already seen a MAGIKARP that\nwas {STRVAR_1 52, 2, 0}.{STRVAR_1 50, 3, 0} inches.

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00008
lines.text: What? That’s not a MAGIKARP!

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00009
lines.text: ...Your Bag is too full!\nNothing will fit...

lines.label: msg_0628_T29R0201_00010
lines.text: Oh... So you didn’t get one good\nenough to show me?\fMaybe next time.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00000
lines.text: I am sorry.\rClair, our Gym Leader, entered\nthe Dragon’s Den behind the Gym.\rI have no idea when our Leader\nwill return.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00001
lines.text: Clair, our Gym Leader, is waiting\nfor you.\rHowever, it would be impossible for\na run-of-the-mill Trainer to win.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00002
lines.text: You defeated Clair?\nThat’s amazing!\rI’ve never heard of her losing to\nanyone other than Lance.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00003
lines.text: No. Only chosen Trainers may train\nhere. Please leave.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00004
lines.text: If Clair allows it, her grandfather--\nour Master--will also.\rYou may enter.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00005
lines.text: My radio’s busted?\nLately, I only get this weird signal.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00006
lines.text: Arooo! Voices in my head!\rHuh? I’m listening to my radio!

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00007
lines.text: Are you going to make your Pokémon\nforget some moves?

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00008
lines.text: Those Trainers called Dragon Tamers\nare all from Blackthorn City.

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00009
lines.text: Wow, you came through the Ice Path?\rYou must be a real hotshot Trainer!

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00010
lines.text: Blackthorn City\nA Quiet Mountain Retreat

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00011
lines.text: Blackthorn City Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Clair\fThe Blessed User of Dragon Pokémon

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00012
lines.text: Move Deleter and Move Tutor House\rA Mysterious House Where You Can Make\nPokémon Forget and Remember Moves

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00013
lines.text: Dragon’s Den Ahead

lines.label: msg_0629_T30_00014
lines.text: Trainer Tips\rWild Pokémon will appear regularly\nif you don’t run, but walk quietly in the\ftall grass.\rIf your party Pokémon are\ntired, it is better to avoid running,\fand go straight to a Pokémon Center.

lines.label: msg_0630_T30FS0101_00000
lines.text: You can’t buy a Max Revive, but it fully\nrestores a fainted Pokémon.\rBeware--it won’t restore PP, the\nPower Points needed for moves.

lines.label: msg_0630_T30FS0101_00001
lines.text: Max Repel keeps weak Pokémon away\nfrom you. It’s the longest lasting of\fthe Repel sprays.

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00000
lines.text:
Yo! Champ in the making!The Gym has unstable footing.
Keep your Pokémon in their Poké Balls.Now, Clair uses the mythical and sacred
Dragon-type Pokémon.You can’t damage them very easily.But you know, they’re supposed
to be weak against Ice-type moves.

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00001
lines.text:
Hey!
You were great to beat Clair!What she says is one thing, but you are
already quite the Trainer. I think...I’d still do what Clair wants you to
do, though.

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00002
lines.text:
Yo! Champ in the making!The Gym has unstable footing.
Keep your Pokémon in their Poké Balls.Now, Clair uses the mythical and sacred
Dragon-type Pokémon.You can’t damage them very easily.But you know, they’re supposed
to be weak against Ice-type moves.

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00003
lines.text:
Clair: I am Clair.The world’s best Dragon-type master.I can hold my own against even the
Pokémon League’s Elite Four.Do you still want to take me on?...Fine.
Let’s do this!As a Gym Leader, I will use my full
power against any opponent!

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00004
lines.text:
Clair: I won’t concede this.I might have lost, but you’re still
not ready for the Pokémon League.I know. You should take the
Dragon-master challenge.Behind this Gym is a place called
Dragon’s Den. There is a small shrine at its heart. Go there.If you can prove that you’ve lost
your lazy ideals, I will admit you are a Trainer worthy of a Gym Badge!

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00005
lines.text: Clair: What’s the matter?\rIs it too much to expect of you?

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00006
lines.text: Clair: You’ve kept me waiting!\rHere! Take this!\r

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00007
lines.text: Clair: That contains Dragon Pulse.\rWell, Dragon Pulse is a kind of...umm...\nNever mind!\rIt’s a huge energy of some kind.\nIf you don’t want it, you don’t\fhave to take it.\r

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00008
lines.text: What is this? You don’t have room?

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00009
lines.text:
Clair: What’s the matter?Aren’t you headed to the
Pokémon League?Your face...it tells me you have some
unfinished business...Wait a sec!
You came from New Bark Town where Professor Elm’s Lab is, right?You may want to go back to
New Bark Town.Whatever you have to face from now,
it’ll be more difficult.But don’t you dare give up!If you do, I’ll feel even worse
about having lost to you!...
Give it your all.

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00010
lines.text: Blackthorn City Pokémon Gym

lines.label: msg_0631_T30GYM0101_00011

lines.text: Deep inside far-off Indigo Plateau is\nthe Pokémon League.\rI hear the best Trainers gather there\nfrom around the country.

lines.text: There was this move I just had\nto teach my Pokémon.\rSo I got the Move Deleter to make it\nforget an HM move.

lines.text: A clan of Trainers who can freely\ncommand Dragon-type Pokémon lives\fright here in Blackthorn.\rAs a result, there are many legends\nabout dragons in this town.

lines.text: Clair and Lance also trained here to\ngain skills as Pokémon Trainers!

You may communicate with other

see!Up to five players can take part,
so try it with your friends!

lines.label: msg_0738_UNION_00163

In a Spin Trade, participants each bring
an Egg for trading with others.Which Egg will you end up with?
What kind of Pokémon is in that Egg? It’s quite exciting and fun!Up to five players can take part, so
try it with your friends!

You may get together with others

of paper at the same time.I’m sure a drawing made by friends
will be a memorable masterpiece!Up to five players can take part,
so try it with your friends!
